zh.tag: 为 AI 代理打造的 HTML 转视频渲染框架
zh.what: HyperFrames 是一个开源框架，可将 HTML、CSS、媒体和可定位动画转换为确定性的 MP4 视频。它支持本地 CLI 使用，也可作为 AI 编码代理的技能，或作为托管创作流程的渲染核心。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的框架代码、CLI 工具、技能包（SKILL.md）、文档、示例和展示页面。核心是让代理通过编写 HTML 来生成视频，并支持可定位动画。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 开发，要求 Node.js >= 22，通过 npm 分发，并集成了 AI 代理技能系统（如 Claude 和 Agents skills）。
zh.hot: 凭借 4.4 万+ Star 和每日新增 220 的热度，它精准切中 AI 代理自动生成视频的需求，将 HTML 编写与视频渲染无缝结合，成为 GitHub Trending 上的明星项目。
uses: AI 代理开发者：希望让代理自动生成视频内容，如产品介绍、教程等。
视频创作者：通过编写 HTML 快速生成可定制、确定性的视频，无需传统编辑软件。
自动化工作流：在 CI/CD 或内容管道中集成视频渲染，实现批量生成。
前端开发者：利用熟悉的 HTML/CSS 技能创建动画和视频效果。

en.tag: Open-source framework turning HTML/CSS into deterministic MP4 videos, built for AI agents
en.what: HyperFrames is an open-source framework that converts HTML, CSS, media, and seekable animations into deterministic MP4 videos. It can be used locally via CLI, as skills for AI coding agents, or as the rendering core behind hosted authoring workflows.
en.content: The repository contains the full framework code, CLI tools, skill packages (SKILL.md), documentation, examples, and showcase pages. The core enables agents to generate videos by writing HTML, with support for seekable animations.
en.stack: Primarily developed in TypeScript, requires Node.js >= 22, distributed via npm, and integrates AI agent skill systems (e.g., Claude and Agents skills).
en.hot: With over 44k stars and 220 daily additions, it precisely meets the demand for AI-agent-driven video generation, seamlessly combining HTML authoring with video rendering, making it a star on GitHub Trending.
uses: AI agent developers: enable agents to automatically generate video content like product intros or tutorials.
Video creators: quickly produce customizable, deterministic videos by writing HTML, without traditional editing software.
Automation workflows: integrate video rendering into CI/CD or content pipelines for batch generation.
Frontend developers: leverage familiar HTML/CSS skills to create animations and video effects.

zh.tag: 微软开源的文件转 Markdown 工具，为 LLM 文本分析准备数据
zh.what: MarkItDown 是一个轻量级 Python 工具，可将 PDF、Office 文档、图片、音频等多种文件格式转换为 Markdown，以便用于大语言模型（LLM）和文本分析流水线。它专注于保留文档结构（如标题、列表、表格、链接），但输出主要面向机器消费，而非高保真的人类阅读。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 Python 包（packages/markitdown），提供命令行工具和 Python API，支持多种转换器（如 PDF、Office、图片 OCR、音频转写等），并包含测试和文档。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.10+，依赖多个库如 pdfminer.six、python-docx、openpyxl、pytesseract 等，可通过 pip 安装。
zh.hot: 作为微软官方项目，star 数已超 18 万，今日新增近千，因其解决了 LLM 应用中的文档预处理痛点，且支持格式广泛。
uses: 数据科学家和 AI 工程师：将各类文档转换为 Markdown，用于 LLM 微调或 RAG 流水线。
知识管理爱好者：将 PDF、网页等转为 Markdown，方便在笔记软件中整理。
办公自动化开发者：批量转换 Office 文档为统一格式，便于后续处理。

en.tag: Microsoft's open-source file-to-Markdown converter for LLM text analysis
en.what: MarkItDown is a lightweight Python utility that converts various file formats (PDF, Office docs, images, audio, etc.) to Markdown for use with LLMs and text analysis pipelines. It focuses on preserving document structure (headings, lists, tables, links), but output is intended for machine consumption rather than high-fidelity human reading.
en.content: The repo contains the core Python package (packages/markitdown) with CLI and Python API, supporting multiple converters (PDF, Office, OCR, audio transcription, etc.), plus tests and docs.
en.stack: Built on Python 3.10+, with dependencies like pdfminer.six, python-docx, openpyxl, pytesseract, etc., installable via pip.
en.hot: As a Microsoft official project, stars exceed 180k with ~900 added today, because it solves document preprocessing pain points for LLM apps and supports many formats.
uses: Data scientists and AI engineers: convert various documents to Markdown for LLM fine-tuning or RAG pipelines.
Knowledge management enthusiasts: turn PDFs, web pages, etc. into Markdown for note-taking apps.
Office automation developers: batch-convert Office documents to a unified format for downstream processing.

zh.tag: AI 编码代理的上下文优化层，削减 98% 工具输出
zh.what: Context Mode 是专为 AI 编码代理设计的上下文窗口优化工具。它通过沙箱化工具输出（减少 98% 的 token 占用）、持久化会话记忆，并借助 MCP 和 hooks 在 17 个平台间强制路由，从而解决 AI 编程中的“上下文另一半”问题。
zh.content: 仓库包含 TypeScript 核心库、MCP 服务器、编辑器/平台扩展（如 VS Code、JetBrains）、CLI 工具、hooks 示例及文档。提供 npm 包、GitHub Marketplace 集成，并附带统计徽章与使用指南。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 构建，依赖 MCP（Model Context Protocol）与平台 hooks，支持 npm 分发与 GitHub Marketplace 安装。
zh.hot: GitHub 星标超 2 万，今日新增 35，位列 TypeScript 日榜第 6。因解决 AI 编码代理的上下文溢出痛点，且被 Microsoft、Google 等大厂团队采用，并登上 Hacker News 榜首。
uses: 使用 Claude Code、Cursor 等 AI 编程工具的开发者，希望减少上下文浪费、提升长任务稳定性。
团队需要跨平台统一管理 AI 代理的上下文与记忆，适用于多 IDE 或 CI 环境。
对 MCP 生态感兴趣，想通过 hooks 定制工具输出过滤与路由的进阶用户。

en.tag: Context optimization layer for AI coding agents, cutting tool output by 98%
en.what: Context Mode is a context window optimization tool for AI coding agents. It sandboxes tool output (98% token reduction), persists session memory, and enforces routing across 17 platforms via MCP and hooks, addressing the 'other half' of the context problem in AI coding.
en.content: The repo contains a TypeScript core library, MCP server, editor/platform extensions (VS Code, JetBrains, etc.), CLI tools, hooks examples, and docs. Includes npm package, GitHub Marketplace integration, with stats badges and usage guides.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, relies on MCP (Model Context Protocol) and platform hooks, distributed via npm and GitHub Marketplace.
en.hot: With 20k+ stars and +35 today, ranking #6 on TypeScript daily trending. It solves context overflow for AI coding agents, adopted by teams at Microsoft, Google, etc., and hit #1 on Hacker News.
uses: Developers using AI coding tools like Claude Code or Cursor who want to reduce context waste and improve long-task stability.
Teams needing unified context and memory management across platforms, suitable for multi-IDE or CI environments.
Advanced users interested in MCP ecosystem, wanting to customize tool output filtering and routing via hooks.

zh.tag: 为AI代理打造的隐身无头浏览器，绕过反爬检测
zh.what: camofox-browser 是一个基于 Camoufox（Firefox 分支）的防检测浏览器服务器，专为 AI 代理设计。它通过 C++ 级别的指纹伪装绕过 Cloudflare 和反爬机制，提供 REST API 供代理使用，可作为 Puppeteer/Playwright 的替代品。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的浏览器服务器实现，提供 REST API、元素引用、会话隔离、Cookie 导入、文件上传、代理支持等功能。附带启动脚本和 npm 包，易于集成。
zh.stack: 基于 JavaScript 和 Node.js，核心引擎是 Camoufox（Firefox 的 C++ 级补丁），通过 REST API 暴露功能。依赖 npm 生态，支持跨平台运行。
zh.hot: 在 AI 代理需要访问真实网页但常被反爬拦截的背景下，该仓库提供了有效的解决方案，今日新增 117 星，总星数达 9236，登上 JavaScript 趋势榜第六。
uses: AI 代理开发者：需要让代理访问受保护网站（如搜索、社交媒体）时，可集成此浏览器绕过检测。
数据采集工程师：用于爬取 Cloudflare 保护的网站，替代易被识别的无头浏览器。
自动化测试人员：作为 Puppeteer/Playwright 的替代，进行需要真实浏览器指纹的测试。
个人 AI 助手项目：如 jo，需要稳定、低内存的浏览器后端。

en.tag: Stealth headless browser for AI agents, bypassing bot detection
en.what: camofox-browser is an anti-detection browser server for AI agents, built on Camoufox (a Firefox fork). It bypasses Cloudflare and bot detection via C++-level fingerprint spoofing, and offers a REST API for agents, serving as a drop-in replacement for Puppeteer/Playwright.
en.content: The repository contains a full browser server implementation with REST API, element refs, session isolation, cookie import, file upload, proxy support, and more. It includes startup scripts and an npm package for easy integration.
en.stack: Built on JavaScript and Node.js, powered by Camoufox (a C++-patched Firefox fork), exposing functionality via REST API. Leverages npm ecosystem and runs cross-platform.
en.hot: With AI agents needing to browse real websites but often blocked by anti-bot measures, this repo offers a working solution, gaining 117 stars today and reaching 9236 total, ranking #6 on the JavaScript trending list.
uses: AI agent developers: integrate this browser to access protected sites (e.g., search, social media) while bypassing detection.
Data scraping engineers: use it to crawl Cloudflare-protected websites, replacing easily fingerprintable headless browsers.
Automation testers: as a drop-in replacement for Puppeteer/Playwright for tests requiring real browser fingerprints.
Personal AI assistant projects: like jo, needing a stable, low-memory browser backend.

zh.tag: 开源跨平台影视聚合播放器，多源搜索与在线播放
zh.what: MoonTV 是一个基于 Next.js 14 构建的影视聚合播放器，支持多资源搜索、在线播放、收藏同步、播放记录和云端存储。它提供 PWA 支持，可安装到桌面或移动端，并具备响应式布局和智能去广告功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Next.js 应用源码，包括前端界面、API 路由、播放器集成（ArtPlayer/HLS.js）、存储适配（Kvrocks/Redis）以及 Docker 部署配置。项目还提供 Zeabur 一键部署模板和详细的配置文件示例。
zh.stack: 技术栈包括 Next.js 14 (App Router)、Tailwind CSS 3、TypeScript 4，播放器使用 ArtPlayer 和 HLS.js，存储支持 Kvrocks/Redis/Upstash，部署依赖 Docker。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub Trending 日榜排名第 5，今日新增 197 星，总星数近万，因其功能全面、部署便捷且完全开源，吸引了大量影视爱好者和自托管用户。
uses: 适合喜欢自托管影视服务的用户，可自行部署并收集播放源。
适合开发者学习 Next.js 14 全栈开发、PWA 及流媒体播放器集成。
适合希望拥有跨平台（桌面/移动/Android TV）统一观影体验的个人用户。

en.tag: Open-source cross-platform movie/TV aggregator player with multi-source search and online playback
en.what: MoonTV is a movie/TV aggregator player built with Next.js 14, supporting multi-source search, online playback, favorites sync, watch history, and cloud storage. It offers PWA support for installation on desktop/mobile, responsive layout, and smart ad-blocking.
en.content: The repository contains the full Next.js application source code, including frontend UI, API routes, player integration (ArtPlayer/HLS.js), storage adapters (Kvrocks/Redis), and Docker deployment configs. It also offers a Zeabur one-click deploy template and detailed config file examples.
en.stack: Tech stack includes Next.js 14 (App Router), Tailwind CSS 3, TypeScript 4, players ArtPlayer and HLS.js, storage via Kvrocks/Redis/Upstash, and deployment via Docker.
en.hot: Ranked #5 on GitHub Trending daily, gaining 197 stars today to reach ~9.7k total, this project attracts movie enthusiasts and self-hosters due to its comprehensive features, easy deployment, and full open-source nature.
uses: Ideal for users who prefer self-hosting media services and want to deploy their own aggregator with custom sources.
Great for developers learning Next.js 14 full-stack development, PWA implementation, and streaming player integration.
Perfect for individuals seeking a unified cross-platform viewing experience (desktop, mobile, Android TV) with sync features.

zh.tag: 为 Claude Code 等 AI 编码代理打造的性能优化与安全增强系统
zh.what: ECC 是一个代理工具链（harness）优化系统，为 Claude Code、Codex、Opencode、Cursor 等 AI 编程代理提供技能、直觉、记忆、安全与研究优先的开发能力。它通过统一的配置与插件机制，增强代理在复杂任务中的表现与可控性。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 JavaScript 库、CLI 工具、GitHub App（ecc-tools）、文档（多语言 README）以及示例配置，支持通过 npm 包（ecc-universal）集成。
zh.stack: 基于 JavaScript/Node.js，依赖 npm 生态，提供 CLI 与 GitHub App 集成，支持多代理框架（Claude Code、Codex 等）。
zh.hot: 凭借 24.4 万 Star 和今日新增 235 星，ECC 成为 AI 代理工具链领域的明星项目，其跨代理兼容性和性能优化特性吸引了大量开发者关注。
uses: AI 编码代理用户：希望增强 Claude Code、Codex 等代理的记忆、安全与技能，提升开发效率。
团队与组织：需要统一管理多个 AI 代理的配置、权限与安全策略，确保合规与可控。
开发者工具链爱好者：对代理性能优化、插件机制和 GitHub App 集成感兴趣，可扩展自定义功能。

en.tag: Performance optimization and security enhancement system for AI coding agents like Claude Code
en.what: ECC is an agent harness optimization system that provides skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development capabilities for AI coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, and Cursor. It enhances agent performance and control through unified configuration and plugin mechanisms.
en.content: The repository includes core JavaScript libraries, CLI tools, a GitHub App (ecc-tools), multi-language documentation, and example configurations, integrable via the npm package (ecc-universal).
en.stack: Built on JavaScript/Node.js, leveraging the npm ecosystem, offering CLI and GitHub App integration, compatible with multiple agent frameworks (Claude Code, Codex, etc.).
en.hot: With 244k stars and 235 new stars today, ECC has become a star project in the AI agent toolchain space, attracting developers with its cross-agent compatibility and performance optimization features.
uses: AI coding agent users: Enhance memory, security, and skills for agents like Claude Code and Codex to boost development productivity.
Teams and organizations: Need unified management of configurations, permissions, and security policies across multiple AI agents for compliance and control.
Developer toolchain enthusiasts: Interested in agent performance optimization, plugin mechanisms, and GitHub App integration for custom extensions.

zh.tag: 为 AI 代理打造的市场营销技能库
zh.what: 这是一个为 AI 代理（如 Claude Code）设计的营销技能集合，涵盖转化率优化、文案写作、SEO、分析和增长工程。它帮助技术营销人员和创始人利用 AI 编码代理自动执行营销任务，并遵循 Agent Skills 规范。
zh.content: 仓库包含多个 Markdown 格式的技能文件，每个技能提供特定营销任务的框架和最佳实践。技能之间相互引用，以 product-marketing 为基础，其他技能先读取它来了解产品、受众和定位。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript 编写，但核心是 Markdown 技能文件。兼容支持 Agent Skills 规范的代理，如 Claude Code、OpenAI Codex、Cursor 等。
zh.hot: 星标数达 4.6 万，今日新增 154，登上 JavaScript 日榜。它填补了 AI 代理在营销领域的空白，将营销专业知识结构化，让 AI 代理能直接应用，因此受到技术营销者和创始人的追捧。
uses: 技术营销人员：希望利用 AI 代理自动执行营销任务，提升效率。
创始人：需要 AI 辅助进行转化优化、文案和 SEO，以驱动增长。
AI 代理开发者：希望集成营销技能到自己的代理中，扩展功能。

en.tag: Marketing skills library for AI agents
en.what: A collection of AI agent skills for marketing tasks, including CRO, copywriting, SEO, analytics, and growth engineering. It enables technical marketers and founders to leverage AI coding agents for marketing automation, following the Agent Skills spec.
en.content: The repo contains multiple Markdown skill files, each providing frameworks and best practices for specific marketing tasks. Skills reference each other, with product-marketing as the foundation that others read first to understand product, audience, and positioning.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, but the core is Markdown skill files. Compatible with agents supporting the Agent Skills spec, such as Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Cursor, and others.
en.hot: With 46k stars and 154 new today, it hit the JavaScript daily trending. It fills a gap by structuring marketing expertise for AI agents, making it directly applicable, thus attracting technical marketers and founders.
uses: Technical marketers: want to automate marketing tasks with AI agents for efficiency.
Founders: need AI assistance for CRO, copywriting, and SEO to drive growth.
AI agent developers: integrate marketing skills into their agents to extend capabilities.

zh.tag: 用群体智能和AI代理，几分钟搭建自主对冲基金
zh.what: AutoHedge 是一个企业级的自主代理对冲基金，能够自动执行市场分析、风险管理和交易执行，减少人工干预。目前支持 Solana 上的全自动交易，未来将支持 Coinbase 等更多交易所。
zh.content: 仓库包含多代理架构（总监、量化、风险、执行代理）、实时市场分析、风险优先设计、结构化输出和企业级日志。提供快速安装和基本使用说明，以及架构图。
zh.stack: 基于 Python，依赖 Jupiter API 获取代币价格和搜索工具，以及 OpenAI/Anthropic 的 API 用于实验性代理。
zh.hot: 结合群体智能和 AI 代理的自主交易概念吸引关注，今日新增 142 星，总星数达 4725，登上 GitHub 趋势榜第 17 名。
uses: 量化交易者或开发者希望快速搭建自动化交易策略
对 AI 代理和群体智能在金融领域应用感兴趣的研究者
需要风险优先和结构化输出的机构级交易系统开发者

en.tag: Build an autonomous hedge fund in minutes with swarm intelligence and AI agents
en.what: AutoHedge is an enterprise-grade autonomous agent hedge fund that automates market analysis, risk management, and trade execution with minimal human intervention. It currently supports full autonomous trading on Solana, with Coinbase and other venues coming soon.
en.content: The repo includes a multi-agent architecture (Director, Quant, Risk, Execution agents), real-time market analysis, risk-first design, structured output, and enterprise logging. It provides quick start installation and usage, plus an architecture diagram.
en.stack: Built with Python, relies on Jupiter API for token price and search tools, and OpenAI/Anthropic APIs for experimental agents.
en.hot: The concept of autonomous trading with swarm intelligence and AI agents is captivating, gaining 142 stars today and reaching 4,725 total, ranking #17 on GitHub Trending.
uses: Quant traders or developers seeking to quickly build automated trading strategies
Researchers interested in AI agents and swarm intelligence applications in finance
Developers needing institutional-grade trading systems with risk-first and structured output

zh.tag: 免注册开源工具精选集，浏览器即开即用
zh.what: 这是一个精心策划的开源工具列表，所有工具都可以直接在浏览器中使用，无需注册、邮箱或追踪。项目本身是一个 React + TypeScript 网站，用于展示这些工具，并支持社区提交新工具。

隐私倡导者关注无追踪、无数据收集的在线服务。

en.tag: Curated open-source tools that work instantly in your browser, no signups
en.what: This is a curated list of open-source tools that work instantly in your browser, with no accounts, emails, or tracking. The project itself is a React + TypeScript website that showcases these tools and allows community submissions.
en.content: The repository contains a React + TypeScript frontend app that displays a categorized list of tools, each with name, description, URL, tags, etc. It also includes contribution guidelines, a tool submission template, and community discussion links.

en.hot: Ranked #12 on GitHub Trending today with 68 new stars, reaching 2897 total. It taps into the demand for no-signup, privacy-friendly tools, and has an active community on Discord and Reddit.

Developers or content creators who want to discover no-login utilities to boost productivity.
Privacy advocates who care about online services with no tracking or data harvesting.

zh.tag: 开源长时程超级智能体框架，研究、编码、创作全能
zh.what: DeerFlow 是一个开源的长时程超级智能体框架，能编排子代理、记忆和沙箱，执行从几分钟到几小时不等的复杂任务。它集成了研究、编码和创作能力，并支持通过技能扩展实现几乎任何功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的后端（Python 3.12+）和前端（Node.js 22+）代码，以及多语言 README（中、英、日、法、俄）。2.0 版本从零重写，与 1.x 分支不共享代码，并提供官方演示网站和姊妹项目 LLM Space。
zh.stack: 后端基于 Python 3.12+，前端基于 Node.js 22+，使用 Makefile 管理构建。推荐配合豆包 Seed-2.0-Code、DeepSeek v3.2 和 Kimi 2.5 等模型使用。
zh.hot: DeerFlow 在 2026 年 2 月 28 日发布 2.0 版本后登上 GitHub Trending 榜首，目前星标数超 8.1 万，今日新增 195。其强大的长时程任务处理能力和字节跳动背书吸引了大量关注。
uses: 开发者构建复杂 AI 代理应用，如自动研究、编码助手等
研究者探索长时程任务规划与执行，借助沙箱和记忆机制
企业用户利用其技能扩展能力，集成到内部工作流中

en.tag: Open-source long-horizon super agent harness for research, coding, and creation
en.what: DeerFlow is an open-source long-horizon super agent harness that orchestrates sub-agents, memory, and sandboxes to handle tasks ranging from minutes to hours. It integrates research, coding, and creation capabilities, and supports extensible skills to do almost anything.
en.content: The repository contains full backend (Python 3.12+) and frontend (Node.js 22+) code, along with multi-language READMEs (Chinese, English, Japanese, French, Russian). Version 2.0 is a ground-up rewrite with no shared code with the 1.x branch, and includes an official demo website and a sister project, LLM Space.
en.stack: Backend is built with Python 3.12+, frontend with Node.js 22+, and Makefile is used for build management. Recommended models include Doubao-Seed-2.0-Code, DeepSeek v3.2, and Kimi 2.5.
en.hot: DeerFlow claimed the #1 spot on GitHub Trending on February 28, 2026, following the 2.0 release, and now has over 81k stars with 195 added today. Its powerful long-horizon task handling and ByteDance backing have drawn significant attention.
uses: Developers building complex AI agent applications like automated research and coding assistants
Researchers exploring long-horizon task planning and execution with sandboxes and memory
Enterprise users leveraging extensible skills to integrate into internal workflows

zh.tag: Codex 技能目录，已弃用，迁移至 OpenAI Plugins
zh.what: 这是一个为 Codex 等 AI 代理提供技能（Skills）的目录仓库，技能是包含指令、脚本和资源的文件夹，代理可发现并使用它们来执行特定任务。该仓库已弃用，当前推荐使用 OpenAI Plugins 仓库。
zh.content: 仓库包含 .system、.curated 和 .experimental 三个技能分类目录，每个技能目录内包含指令文件和可选的 LICENSE.txt。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python，但技能本身是跨语言的指令和脚本集合，依赖 Codex 环境。
zh.hot: 尽管已弃用，但作为 OpenAI 官方仓库仍获得 25621 星，说明开发者对 Agent Skills 标准和高星仓库的关注度极高。
uses: Codex 用户：安装和使用官方策划的技能，如 gh-address-comments。
技能开发者：参考技能目录结构，学习如何创建自定义技能。
研究 Agent 技能标准：了解 Agent Skills 开放标准及其应用。

en.tag: Deprecated skills catalog for Codex; moved to OpenAI Plugins
en.what: This is a catalog repository of skills for AI agents like Codex. Skills are folders of instructions, scripts, and resources that agents can discover and use to perform specific tasks. The repository is deprecated; users are directed to the OpenAI Plugins repository.
en.content: The repository contains three skill categories: .system, .curated, and .experimental. Each skill folder includes instruction files and an optional LICENSE.txt.
en.stack: Primarily Python, but skills are cross-language instruction and script collections, depending on the Codex environment.
en.hot: Despite being deprecated, it has 25,621 stars, showing high developer interest in Agent Skills standards and official OpenAI repositories.
uses: Codex users: install and use curated skills like gh-address-comments.
Skill developers: reference the catalog structure to create custom skills.
Researchers of agent skill standards: learn about the Agent Skills open standard.

zh.tag: 为 AI 与自动化从头构建的无头浏览器
zh.what: Lightpanda 是一个用 Zig 语言从零编写的无头浏览器，专为 AI 代理和自动化任务设计。它不是 Chromium 的分支，也不是 WebKit 的补丁，而是一个全新的浏览器实现，旨在提供极致的性能和资源效率。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的浏览器核心代码，支持通过命令行或包管理器安装，提供 nightly 构建版本。项目还包含基准测试脚本和演示，展示其在内存占用和执行速度上的优势。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Zig 语言开发，支持 Linux 和 macOS 平台，提供 x86_64 和 aarch64 架构的二进制。依赖 glibc，可通过 Homebrew 或 AUR 安装。
zh.hot: 凭借比 Headless Chrome 快约 9 倍、内存占用低 16 倍的基准测试结果，吸引了大量关注。在 GitHub 上已获得 34,854 颗星，今日新增 58 颗，位列日榜第 12 名。
uses: AI 代理开发者：需要一个轻量级、快速的无头浏览器来执行网页抓取和自动化任务。
自动化测试工程师：用于 CI/CD 管道中的端到端测试，减少资源消耗并加快测试速度。
网页爬虫开发者：需要高效抓取大量网页，同时降低内存和 CPU 开销。

en.tag: Headless browser built from scratch for AI agents and automation
en.what: Lightpanda is a headless browser written from scratch in Zig, designed specifically for AI agents and automation. It is not a Chromium fork or a WebKit patch, but a brand new browser implementation focused on extreme performance and resource efficiency.
en.content: The repository contains the complete browser core code, installable via command line or package managers, with nightly builds provided. It also includes benchmark scripts and demos showcasing its advantages in memory usage and execution speed.
en.stack: Developed primarily in Zig, supporting Linux and macOS with x86_64 and aarch64 binaries. It depends on glibc and can be installed via Homebrew or AUR.
en.hot: Attracting attention with benchmark results showing ~9x faster execution and ~16x less memory usage compared to Headless Chrome. It has gained 34,854 stars on GitHub, with 58 added today, ranking 12th on the daily trending list.
uses: AI agent developers needing a lightweight, fast headless browser for web scraping and automation tasks.
Automation test engineers using it in CI/CD pipelines for end-to-end testing, reducing resource consumption and speeding up tests.
Web crawler developers requiring efficient scraping of large numbers of pages with lower memory and CPU overhead.

zh.tag: 基于 WebGPU 的 3D 建筑编辑器，支持分享与本地运行。
zh.what: Pascal Editor 是一个使用 React Three Fiber 和 WebGPU 构建的 3D 建筑编辑器，允许用户创建和分享建筑项目。它提供了完整的编辑工具、3D 渲染运行时，并支持通过 CLI 在本地运行。
zh.content: 仓库是一个 Turborepo monorepo，包含 Next.js 应用、核心包（core）、查看器（viewer）、编辑器（editor）、节点定义（nodes）、CLI 和 MCP 服务器等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，基于 React Three Fiber 和 WebGPU，采用 Turborepo 管理 monorepo，并发布多个 npm 包。
zh.hot: 凭借 WebGPU 带来的高性能 3D 渲染和便捷的本地运行方式，项目在 GitHub 上迅速走红，已获得 22k+ 星标，今日新增 168 星。
uses: 建筑师和设计师：快速创建和分享 3D 建筑概念模型。
开发者：在 React 应用中集成 3D 编辑器或查看器。
教育工作者：用于教学演示或学生项目。

en.tag: A WebGPU-powered 3D architectural editor for creating and sharing projects.
en.what: Pascal Editor is a 3D building editor built with React Three Fiber and WebGPU, enabling users to create and share architectural projects. It offers a full editing toolset, a 3D rendering runtime, and can be run locally via CLI.
en.content: The repository is a Turborepo monorepo containing a Next.js app, core packages (core, viewer, editor, nodes), CLI, and MCP server.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, built on React Three Fiber and WebGPU, managed as a Turborepo monorepo, and published as multiple npm packages.
en.hot: With high-performance 3D rendering via WebGPU and easy local setup, the project has gained 22k+ stars, including 168 today.
uses: Architects and designers: quickly create and share 3D architectural concepts.
Developers: integrate the 3D editor or viewer into React applications.
Educators: use for teaching demonstrations or student projects.

zh.tag: 智能体元框架：编排多智能体、自适应记忆与 RAG
zh.what: Ruflo 是一个用于构建和编排智能体系统的元框架，支持部署多智能体群、协调自主工作流，并构建对话式 AI。它集成了自适应记忆、自学习智能、RAG 检索增强生成，并原生支持 Claude Code、Codex、Hermes 等多种模型。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心框架代码、CLI 工具（npx ruflo）、UI Beta 入口（flo.ruv.io），以及相关的生态组件如 Goal Planner、RuVector Agentic DB 等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，基于 Node.js/npm 生态，集成 Claude Code、Codex 等插件，并依赖 Svelte 构建 UI。
zh.hot: 凭借 7 万+ star 和 8.1M+ 生态下载量，Ruflo 成为智能体编排领域的热门选择，今日新增 136 star，位列日榜第 9。
uses: 开发者快速构建多智能体协作应用，如自动化工作流、对话机器人。
需要自适应记忆和 RAG 能力的 AI 应用，如知识库问答、个性化助手。
希望集成 Claude Code、Codex 等模型的团队，统一管理智能体行为。
研究智能体自学习与元认知的 AI 工程师，探索前沿范式。

en.tag: Agent meta-harness for multi-agent swarms, adaptive memory, RAG, and Claude/Codex integration
en.what: Ruflo is a meta-harness for building and orchestrating agentic systems, enabling deployment of multi-agent swarms, coordination of autonomous workflows, and creation of conversational AI. It features adaptive memory, self-learning intelligence, RAG integration, and native support for Claude Code, Codex, Hermes, and more.
en.content: The repo includes core framework code, CLI tool (npx ruflo), UI Beta entry (flo.ruv.io), and related ecosystem components like Goal Planner and RuVector Agentic DB.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, built on Node.js/npm ecosystem, integrates Claude Code and Codex plugins, and uses Svelte for UI.
en.hot: With 70k+ stars and 8.1M+ ecosystem downloads, Ruflo is a popular choice for agent orchestration, gaining 136 stars today and ranking #9 on the daily trending list.
uses: Developers building multi-agent collaborative apps like automated workflows and chatbots.
AI applications needing adaptive memory and RAG, such as knowledge-base Q&A and personalized assistants.
Teams integrating Claude Code, Codex, etc., to unify agent behavior management.
AI engineers researching self-learning and metacognition in agents for cutting-edge paradigms.

zh.tag: Python 深度学习框架，张量与动态神经网络
zh.what: PyTorch 是一个开源的 Python 机器学习库，提供类似 NumPy 的张量计算，并支持强大的 GPU 加速。它基于自动微分系统构建深度神经网络，支持动态计算图，使模型构建和调试更加灵活。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心库 torch（张量操作）、torch.autograd（自动微分）、torch.jit（脚本化）等模块，以及丰富的文档、教程和构建脚本。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 和 C++ 实现，依赖 CUDA、ROCm 等 GPU 加速库，支持多种硬件后端。
zh.hot: PyTorch 是深度学习领域最流行的框架之一，拥有超过 10 万 star，社区活跃，持续更新，是研究和生产环境的首选。
uses: 研究人员：快速原型设计和实验新模型架构
工程师：部署生产级深度学习模型到各种平台
学生和教师：学习和教授机器学习和深度学习

en.tag: Python deep learning framework with tensors and dynamic neural networks
en.what: PyTorch is an open-source Python machine learning library that provides tensor computation similar to NumPy with strong GPU acceleration. It builds deep neural networks on a tape-based autograd system, supporting dynamic computation graphs for flexible model building and debugging.
en.content: The repository contains core modules like torch (tensor operations), torch.autograd (automatic differentiation), torch.jit (scripting), along with extensive documentation, tutorials, and build scripts.
en.stack: Primarily implemented in Python and C++, with dependencies on CUDA, ROCm, and other GPU acceleration libraries, supporting multiple hardware backends.
en.hot: PyTorch is one of the most popular deep learning frameworks with over 100k stars, active community, and continuous updates, making it a top choice for research and production.
uses: Researchers: rapidly prototype and experiment with novel model architectures
Engineers: deploy production-grade deep learning models to various platforms
Students and educators: learn and teach machine learning and deep learning

zh.tag: 让 AI 像人一样操作浏览器的开源智能体框架
zh.what: Browser Use 是一个开源工具，允许 AI 代理像人类一样使用浏览器，自动执行打开网页、点击按钮、输入文本、填写表单等任务。用户只需描述任务，代理即可完成，例如自动填写求职申请。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 Python 库、示例代码、文档和演示，支持与主流 LLM 集成，并提供云服务（Browser Use Cloud）用于托管和扩展。
zh.stack: 基于 Python，依赖 Playwright 控制浏览器，可接入 OpenAI、Anthropic 等 LLM API，并支持 MCP 协议。
zh.hot: GitHub 星标超 11 万，今日新增 231，因其将 AI 代理与真实浏览器操作结合，极大扩展了自动化边界，成为开发者热门选择。
uses: 开发者构建自动化测试或网页数据采集工具，利用 AI 代理模拟用户操作。
个人用户自动化日常重复性网页任务，如填写表单、管理日程或购物。
企业集成到 RPA 流程，实现智能客服或后台系统的无头浏览器操作。

en.tag: Open-source framework enabling AI agents to control browsers like humans
en.what: Browser Use is an open-source tool that enables AI agents to use a web browser like a human, automating tasks such as opening pages, clicking buttons, typing, and filling forms. Users describe a task, and the agent completes it, e.g., auto-filling job applications.
en.content: The repository contains the core Python library, examples, docs, and demos, with integrations for major LLMs, plus a cloud service for hosting and scaling.
en.stack: Built on Python, uses Playwright for browser control, integrates with LLM APIs like OpenAI and Anthropic, and supports MCP protocol.
en.hot: With over 112k stars and 231 new today, it's hot for bridging AI agents with real browser actions, expanding automation possibilities and gaining rapid developer adoption.
uses: Developers building automated testing or web scraping tools that leverage AI agents to mimic user actions.
Individuals automating repetitive web tasks like form filling, scheduling, or online shopping.
Enterprises integrating into RPA workflows for headless browser operations in customer service or back-office systems.

zh.tag: 模块化节点式 AI 创作引擎，支持图像/视频/3D/音频生成
zh.what: ComfyUI 是一个强大的模块化 AI 引擎，通过图形化节点界面让用户自由组合模型、参数和输出，生成图像、视频、3D 模型和音频等内容。它原生支持最新的开源模型，并可通过合作伙伴节点访问顶级闭源模型。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 ComfyUI 源代码、桌面应用、便携安装包、API 端点、文档和示例工作流。界面截图展示了节点编辑器的使用方式。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 开发，依赖 PyTorch 等深度学习框架，支持 Windows、Linux 和 macOS，并提供本地、桌面和云部署方式。
zh.hot: 拥有 13.1 万 Star，今日新增 139，因其强大的模块化和灵活性成为 AI 创作者的首选工具。社区活跃，持续集成最新模型，生态丰富。
uses: 视觉艺术家和设计师需要精确控制每个模型和参数，实现创意工作流。
开发者和研究者希望将 AI 生成集成到生产管线，利用 API 和自定义节点。
AI 爱好者探索最新开源模型，如 Stable Diffusion 和视频生成模型。
教育者和学生用于学习扩散模型原理和实验不同工作流。

en.tag: Modular node-based AI creation engine for images, video, 3D, audio and more
en.what: ComfyUI is a powerful modular AI engine with a graph/nodes interface, enabling users to combine models, parameters, and outputs to generate images, videos, 3D models, audio, and more. It natively supports the latest open-source models and provides access to top closed-source models via partner nodes.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, desktop app, portable install, API endpoints, documentation, and example workflows. A screenshot shows the node editor interface.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Python, relying on deep learning frameworks like PyTorch, supporting Windows, Linux, and macOS with local, desktop, and cloud deployment options.
en.hot: With 131k stars and 139 added today, it's the go-to tool for AI creators due to its modularity and flexibility. Active community, continuous integration of latest models, and rich ecosystem.
uses: Visual artists and designers who need precise control over every model and parameter for creative workflows.
Developers and researchers integrating AI generation into production pipelines via API and custom nodes.
AI enthusiasts exploring latest open-source models like Stable Diffusion and video generation.
Educators and students learning diffusion model principles and experimenting with workflows.

zh.tag: 公开漏洞 PoC 与漏洞研究合集，吸引新人入行
zh.what: 这是一个公开的漏洞利用概念验证（PoC）和漏洞研究文章的合集仓库。作者发布这些内容时均未被报告，鼓励他人自行报告并获取 CVE 编号。其目的是吸引更多人进入安全领域，并认为这是最有效的方式。
zh.content: 仓库包含多个独立文件夹，每个文件夹对应一个漏洞的 PoC，例如 7-Zip、AnyDesk、c-ares、curl、Discord、Discourse、Docker、Firefox、Flowise、FFmpeg 等。每个文件夹保留原始 README 和跟踪文件，新研究直接作为自包含文件夹添加。
zh.stack: 主要语言为 Python，但 PoC 可能涉及多种语言。作者使用 AI（GPT-5.3）辅助模糊测试工作流，但 PoC 本身为手写，README 由 AI 生成。
zh.hot: 该仓库因公开了多个未披露漏洞的 PoC 而迅速走红，今日新增 74 星，总星数达 4509，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 10 名。其争议性（AI 辅助发现漏洞）和实用性吸引了大量关注。
uses: 安全研究人员：可参考这些 PoC 学习漏洞利用技术，或用于漏洞报告和 CVE 申请。
渗透测试人员：在授权测试中，可借鉴这些 PoC 验证目标系统的安全性。
安全学习者：通过实际漏洞案例了解漏洞成因和利用方法，快速入门漏洞研究。

en.tag: A consolidated archive of public exploit PoCs and vuln research writeups to lure newcomers into security.
en.what: This is a consolidated archive of public exploit PoCs and vulnerability research writeups. At the time of posting, none have been reported, so the author encourages others to report them and take credit for CVEs. The goal is to allure people into the security field, which the author finds the most efficient way.
en.content: The repo contains multiple folders, each corresponding to a PoC for a specific vulnerability, such as 7-Zip, AnyDesk, c-ares, curl, Discord, Discourse, Docker, Firefox, Flowise, FFmpeg, etc. Each folder preserves the original README and tracked files, and new research is added as self-contained folders.
en.stack: Primary language is Python, but PoCs may involve various languages. The author used AI (GPT-5.3) to automate fuzzing workflows, but PoCs are hand-typed, and READMEs are AI-generated.
en.hot: The repo went viral for publishing PoCs for multiple undisclosed vulnerabilities, gaining 74 stars today and reaching 4509 total, ranking 10th on GitHub Trending daily. Its controversial use of AI in fuzzing and practical value drew significant attention.
uses: Security researchers: Reference these PoCs to learn exploitation techniques or for vulnerability disclosure and CVE assignment.
Penetration testers: Use these PoCs to validate the security of target systems in authorized engagements.
Security learners: Understand vulnerability root causes and exploitation methods through real-world cases to quickly enter the field.

zh.tag: 让 Claude 变身安全分析师的 MCP 服务器
zh.what: 这是一个生产级的 MCP 服务器，为 Claude 提供 28 个安全情报工具，覆盖 24 个 API，包括 CVE 查询、EPSS 评分、CISA KEV、MITRE ATT&CK、Shodan、VirusTotal 等。通过一个 triage_cve 编排器，用户只需提问即可获得关联情报和优先级建议。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 MCP 服务器实现，包括架构文档、28 个工具目录、安装指南、API 密钥设置、配置说明和快速上手示例。代码基于 Python 编写，使用 FastMCP 框架。
zh.stack: 技术栈为 Python 3.10+，依赖 FastMCP、httpx、aiosqlite、Pydantic v2 和 defusedxml。
zh.hot: 该项目解决了安全分析师手动查询多个数据库的痛点，通过 MCP 协议将 Claude 变成全光谱安全分析师，节省大量时间。今日新增 37 星，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜 Python 第 9 名，说明开发者对 AI 驱动安全工具的需求强烈。
uses: 安全分析师：快速对 CVE 进行优先级排序和风险评分，减少手动查询多个数据库的时间。
开发人员：在 CI/CD 流程中集成漏洞情报，自动获取补丁和利用信息。
安全运营中心（SOC）团队：通过 Claude 的自然语言交互，加速事件响应和威胁猎捕。

en.tag: MCP server turning Claude into a full-spectrum security analyst
en.what: A production-grade MCP server that gives Claude 28 security intelligence tools across 24 APIs, including CVE lookup, EPSS scoring, CISA KEV, MITRE ATT&CK, Shodan, VirusTotal, and more. With a one-call triage_cve orchestrator, users can ask a question and get correlated intelligence and prioritized recommendations.
en.content: The repo includes a full MCP server implementation with architecture docs, a catalog of 28 tools, installation guide, API key setup, configuration, and quick start examples. The code is Python-based and uses the FastMCP framework.
en.stack: Tech stack is Python 3.10+ with dependencies on FastMCP, httpx, aiosqlite, Pydantic v2, and defusedxml.
en.hot: The project addresses the pain point of manually querying multiple databases for security analysis, turning Claude into a full-spectrum security analyst via MCP and saving significant time. With 37 stars added today and ranking #9 on GitHub Trending for Python, it shows strong developer demand for AI-driven security tools.
uses: Security analysts: quickly prioritize CVEs and assess risk, reducing time spent manually querying multiple databases.
Developers: integrate vulnerability intelligence into CI/CD pipelines to automatically fetch patch and exploit information.
SOC teams: accelerate incident response and threat hunting through natural language interaction with Claude.

zh.tag: Claude Code 的付费媒体运营技能，覆盖12个广告平台

en.content: The repository contains the Rust source code, documentation (e.g., naming conventions), and image assets. en.stack: Primarily Rust, leveraging the MCP protocol to communicate with AI clients. Unlike its Python/TypeScript predecessor, it eliminates dependencies on Node.js, Python, wxPython, etc., requiring only a single static binary (~20-25 MB).
en.hot: With 31 stars added today and a total of 473, it ranks #9 on GitHub Trending for Rust. Its popularity stems from solving pain points in AI PCB design toolchains: minimal deployment, high-performance calls, and the potential to seamlessly integrate AI into professional hardware design workflows.
uses: Hardware engineers: leverage AI to assist in schematic capture, PCB layout/routing, and design review, boosting productivity.
AI application developers: integrate Konnect into custom AI toolchains via MCP for automated hardware design.
