uses: Windows users who want to fully customize their desktop appearance and interaction, from taskbar to window manager.
Developers or power users who want to extend desktop functionality via CSS/JSON themes and plugin system.
People seeking minimal or efficient workflows with customizable virtual desktops and window layouts.

zh.tag: 自主AI渗透测试代理系统
zh.what: PentAGI 是一个全自主的 AI 代理系统，能够执行复杂的渗透测试任务。它利用先进的人工智能技术，为信息安全专业人员、研究人员和爱好者提供强大且灵活的安全测试解决方案。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的系统代码、架构文档、快速入门指南、LLM 提供商配置（如 OpenAI、Anthropic、Ollama 等）、Docker 镜像配置、开发与测试工具（如 ftester）以及社区链接。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，支持多种 LLM 提供商（OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini、AWS Bedrock 等），集成 Docker 进行隔离，并支持 Langfuse 监控和知识图谱（Graphiti）。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 与网络安全结合的热度上升，PentAGI 作为自动化渗透测试的领先项目，在 GitHub 上迅速获得关注，今日新增 89 星，总星数达 22519，位居 Go 语言趋势榜第一。
uses: 安全研究人员：利用 AI 代理自动执行渗透测试，提高效率。
红队与蓝队：在授权环境中进行自动化安全评估。
AI 爱好者：探索 AI 在网络安全领域的实际应用。

en.tag: Autonomous AI agent system for complex penetration testing
en.what: PentAGI is a fully autonomous AI agent system capable of performing complex penetration testing tasks. It leverages advanced AI technologies to provide a powerful and flexible security testing solution for infosec professionals, researchers, and enthusiasts.
en.content: The repository includes full system code, architecture docs, quick start guides, LLM provider configurations (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama), Docker image setup, development and testing tools (like ftester), and community links.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, supports multiple LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, AWS Bedrock, etc.), integrates Docker for isolation, and supports Langfuse monitoring and knowledge graph (Graphiti).
en.hot: With the rising intersection of AI and cybersecurity, PentAGI as a leading autonomous pentesting project has gained rapid traction on GitHub, adding 89 stars today to reach 22,519 total, ranking #1 in Go trending.
uses: Security researchers: leverage AI agents to automate penetration testing and improve efficiency.
Red and blue teams: conduct automated security assessments in authorized environments.
AI enthusiasts: explore practical applications of AI in cybersecurity.

zh.tag: 本地优先的开源 AI 推理引擎，无需 GPU 即可运行多模态模型
zh.what: LocalAI 是一个开源的 AI 推理引擎，允许用户在本地或自有基础设施上运行各种模型，包括 LLM、视觉、语音、图像和视频模型。它无需 GPU 即可运行，并兼容 OpenAI、Anthropic 和 ElevenLabs 的 API，可作为这些服务的直接替代。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心引擎、多个后端模块（如 llama.cpp、vLLM、whisper.cpp、stable-diffusion 等），以及用于 API 兼容、多用户认证、内置 AI 代理和文档的组件。后端按需拉取，保持核心轻量。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 编写，后端集成 C++ 和 Python 的推理引擎（如 llama.cpp、vLLM、whisper.cpp 等），支持多种硬件加速（CUDA、ROCm、Vulkan、Apple Silicon 等）。
zh.hot: LocalAI 在 GitHub 上拥有近 5 万星标，今日新增 40 星，位列 Go 趋势榜第二。其吸引力在于无需 GPU 即可运行任意模型，同时提供与主流 API 的即插即用兼容性，满足了用户对数据隐私和本地部署的需求。
uses: 希望在本地或私有云中运行 AI 模型，避免数据外泄的企业和开发者
没有高端 GPU 硬件，但仍需运行 LLM 或多模态模型的个人开发者
需要兼容 OpenAI API 的本地替代方案，以降低成本和延迟的团队
对 AI 代理、RAG 和工具调用感兴趣，希望自主控制 AI 工作流的用户

en.tag: Open-source, local-first AI engine to run any model on any hardware without GPU
en.what: LocalAI is an open-source AI inference engine that lets you run various models—LLMs, vision, voice, image, and video—on your own hardware without needing a GPU. It offers drop-in API compatibility with OpenAI, Anthropic, and ElevenLabs, making it a privacy-preserving alternative to cloud AI services.
en.content: The repository includes the core engine, multiple backend modules (e.g., llama.cpp, vLLM, whisper.cpp, stable-diffusion), and components for API compatibility, multi-user auth, built-in AI agents, and documentation. Backends are pulled on demand to keep the core lightweight.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, with backends integrating C++ and Python inference engines like llama.cpp, vLLM, and whisper.cpp. Supports various hardware accelerations including CUDA, ROCm, Vulkan, and Apple Silicon.
en.hot: With nearly 49k stars and 40 added today, LocalAI ranks #2 on the Go trending list. Its appeal lies in running any model without a GPU while offering drop-in API compatibility, addressing the growing demand for privacy and on-premises AI deployment.
uses: Enterprises and developers who want to run AI models locally or in private clouds to avoid data leakage
Individual developers without high-end GPUs who still need to run LLMs or multimodal models
Teams needing a local drop-in replacement for OpenAI API to reduce costs and latency
Users interested in AI agents, RAG, and tool use who want full control over their AI workflows

zh.tag: 开源 HTTP 安全研究工具包，Burp Suite 替代品
zh.what: Hetty 是一个用于安全研究的 HTTP 工具包，旨在成为 Burp Suite Pro 等商业软件的开源替代品。它提供中间人代理、HTTP 客户端、请求拦截和范围管理等功能，专为信息安全与漏洞赏金社区设计。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Hetty 的完整源代码，包括代理、HTTP 客户端、Web 管理界面以及基于项目的数据库存储。项目处于积极开发中，并提供详细的文档和安装指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，支持通过 Homebrew、Snap、Scoop 等包管理器安装，并提供 Docker 镜像。
zh.hot: 作为 Burp Suite 的开源替代品，Hetty 吸引了大量安全研究人员的关注，目前拥有 12k+ 星标，今日新增 121 星，位列 GitHub Go 趋势榜第三。
uses: 安全研究人员和渗透测试人员，用于拦截、分析和修改 HTTP 流量。
漏洞赏金猎人，利用其范围管理和高级搜索功能高效工作。
开发人员和教育工作者，用于学习 HTTP 协议和 Web 安全原理。

en.tag: Open-source HTTP toolkit for security research, a Burp Suite alternative
en.what: Hetty is an HTTP toolkit for security research, aiming to be an open-source alternative to commercial software like Burp Suite Pro. It offers MITM proxy, HTTP client, request interception, and scope management, tailored for the infosec and bug bounty community.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of Hetty, including proxy, HTTP client, web-based admin interface, and project-based database storage. The project is under active development with comprehensive documentation and installation guides.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, with installation via package managers like Homebrew, Snap, and Scoop, and Docker images available.
en.hot: As an open-source alternative to Burp Suite, Hetty has gained significant traction among security researchers, with 12k+ stars and 121 stars added today, ranking #3 on GitHub Trending for Go.
uses: Security researchers and penetration testers for intercepting, analyzing, and modifying HTTP traffic.
Bug bounty hunters leveraging scope management and advanced search for efficient work.
Developers and educators for learning HTTP protocol and web security fundamentals.

zh.tag: 开源文件管理与协作平台，主权可控
zh.what: OpenCloud 是一个开源的文件管理、共享与协作平台，强调简单和主权可控。它提供后端服务，支持通过 OpenID Connect 进行身份验证，并将数据存储在文件系统中，无需数据库。
zh.content: 仓库包含 OpenCloud 服务器的 Go 语言后端代码，包括构建所需的资产生成和编译指令，以及初始化与启动服务器的命令。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，采用 OpenID Connect 进行认证，支持外部 IdP（如 Keycloak）或内置的 LibreGraph Connect，数据存储基于文件系统，无数据库依赖。
zh.hot: OpenCloud 在 GitHub 上获得 5910 颗星，今日新增 6 颗，位列 Go 语言趋势榜第四，因其提供主权可控的文件协作解决方案而受到关注。
uses: 寻求自托管文件同步与共享解决方案的个人或企业用户。
需要无数据库、轻量级后端服务的开发者或系统管理员。
关注数据主权和隐私保护的组织，希望避免依赖大型云服务商。
对 Go 语言后端开发感兴趣，希望参与开源社区贡献的开发者。

en.tag: Open-source file management, sharing & collaboration with sovereignty
en.what: OpenCloud is an open-source platform for file management, sharing, and collaboration, emphasizing simplicity and sovereignty. It provides backend services with OpenID Connect authentication and stores data in the filesystem without a database.
en.content: The repository contains the Go backend code for the OpenCloud server, including asset generation and build instructions, as well as commands to initialize and start the server.
en.stack: Developed in Go, uses OpenID Connect for authentication with external IdPs like Keycloak or embedded LibreGraph Connect, and stores data in the filesystem without a database.
en.hot: With 5,910 stars and 6 new stars today, OpenCloud ranks 4th on the Go trending list, gaining attention for its sovereign file collaboration solution.
uses: Individuals or enterprises seeking self-hosted file sync and sharing solutions.
Developers or sysadmins needing a lightweight backend without a database.
Organizations prioritizing data sovereignty and privacy, avoiding big cloud providers.
Developers interested in Go backend development and open source contribution.

zh.tag: Git 原生 AI 会话记录与审计工具
zh.what: Entire CLI 将 AI 代理会话与 Git 提交关联，自动捕获每次代码变更背后的完整上下文。它帮助开发者理解代码为何改变，并能从任何检查点恢复，同时保持 Git 历史整洁。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的 CLI 工具，提供安装脚本、命令参考、插件系统及配置文档，支持与 Claude Code、Codex 等代理集成。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖 Git，支持 macOS、Linux、Windows，可通过 Homebrew、脚本或 Scoop 安装。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 编程代理普及，开发者需要追溯代码变更原因，Entire 填补了 Git 与 AI 会话之间的空白，5k+ stars 印证其需求。
uses: 开发者希望理解 AI 生成的代码变更原因，快速定位问题。
团队需要审计 AI 辅助开发过程，满足合规要求。
开发者想要从失败的 AI 代理会话中恢复，避免重复劳动。

en.tag: Git-native AI session recorder and audit tool
en.what: Entire CLI hooks into Git to capture AI agent sessions, linking them to commits. It provides full context for code changes, enables recovery from checkpoints, and keeps Git history clean.
en.content: The repo contains a Go-based CLI with install scripts, command reference, plugin system, and configuration docs, integrating with agents like Claude Code and Codex.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, requires Git, supports macOS/Linux/Windows, installable via Homebrew, scripts, or Scoop.
en.hot: As AI coding agents proliferate, developers need traceability for code changes; Entire fills the gap between Git and AI sessions, earning 5k+ stars.
uses: Developers who want to understand why AI-generated code changed and quickly debug issues.
Teams needing to audit AI-assisted development for compliance and traceability.
Developers who want to recover from failed AI agent sessions without redoing work.

zh.tag: 容器生态的乐高积木，组装自定义容器系统的开源框架
zh.what: Moby 是 Docker 创建的开源项目，旨在加速软件容器化。它提供一组模块化工具组件和组装框架，让开发者能构建自定义的容器系统，并作为容器爱好者和专业人士交流实验的平台。
zh.content: 仓库包含容器构建工具、容器注册表、编排工具、运行时等组件，以及文档和示例。这些组件可独立使用，也可与其他工具结合，形成完整的容器系统。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Linux 内核特性（如 cgroups、namespaces），并集成 containerd、runc 等底层组件。
zh.hot: 作为 Docker 的上游项目，Moby 拥有超过 7.2 万星标，今日新增 20 星，位列 Go 趋势榜第 6，持续吸引容器开发者关注。
uses: 希望深入理解容器技术原理并参与底层开发的工程师
需要构建定制化容器平台或集成容器组件的系统集成商
对容器生态感兴趣，想通过开源代码学习和实验的爱好者

en.tag: A Lego set for the container ecosystem to assemble custom container-based systems
en.what: Moby is an open-source project created by Docker to enable and accelerate software containerization. It provides a modular set of toolkit components and a framework for assembling them into custom container-based systems, serving as a place for container enthusiasts and professionals to experiment and exchange ideas.
en.content: The repository includes container build tools, a container registry, orchestration tools, a runtime, and more, along with documentation and examples. These components can be used independently or combined with other tools to form complete container systems.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, leveraging Linux kernel features like cgroups and namespaces, and integrating low-level components such as containerd and runc.
en.hot: As the upstream of Docker, Moby has over 72k stars, with 20 new stars today, ranking 6th on the Go trending list, continuing to attract container developers.
uses: Engineers who want to deeply understand container internals and contribute to low-level development
System integrators who need to build custom container platforms or integrate container components
Enthusiasts interested in the container ecosystem who want to learn and experiment with open source code

zh.tag: 面向家庭用户的轻量级物品库存与组织管理系统
zh.what: HomeBox 是一个专为家庭用户设计的库存与组织管理系统，帮助用户管理家中物品、分类、位置和标签。它支持图片上传、文档与保修跟踪、购买与维护记录，并提供强大的搜索功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 后端、嵌入式 Web UI（前端资源）、文档、截图和 Docker 部署配置。提供演示站点和文档链接。
zh.stack: 基于 Go 编写，使用 SQLite 存储数据，前端为嵌入式 Web UI（可能使用 Vue/React 等），支持 Docker 一键部署。
zh.hot: HomeBox 因其简单易用、资源占用低（空闲内存<50MB）和便携性而受欢迎，适合家庭用户自托管。今日新增 9 星，总星数 7116，在 Go 趋势榜排名第 7。
uses: 家庭用户：管理家中物品、保修和文档，方便查找和维护。
自托管爱好者：在 NAS 或树莓派上部署，实现数据自主可控。
极客与 DIY 玩家：记录电子元件、工具等收藏品，支持自定义字段。

en.tag: Lightweight inventory and organization system for home users
en.what: HomeBox is an inventory and organization system designed for home users to manage household items, categories, locations, and tags. It supports image uploads, document and warranty tracking, purchase and maintenance records, and powerful search.
en.content: The repository contains a Go backend, embedded web UI (frontend assets), documentation, screenshots, and Docker deployment configs. Includes links to demo and docs.
en.stack: Written in Go, uses SQLite for storage, embedded web UI (likely Vue/React), supports Docker deployment.
en.hot: HomeBox is popular for its simplicity, low resource usage (<50MB idle memory), and portability, ideal for self-hosting. Gained 9 stars today, total 7116, ranked #7 on Go trending.
uses: Home users: manage household items, warranties, and documents for easy lookup and maintenance.
Self-hosting enthusiasts: deploy on NAS or Raspberry Pi for full data control.
Geeks and DIYers: catalog electronics, tools, and collectibles with custom fields.

zh.tag: GitHub 官方 MCP 服务器，让 AI 直接操作仓库与工作流
zh.what: GitHub MCP Server 是 GitHub 官方的模型上下文协议（MCP）服务器，允许 AI 代理、助手和聊天机器人通过自然语言直接与 GitHub 平台交互。它支持读取仓库和代码文件、管理 issue 和 PR、分析代码以及自动化工作流。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的 MCP 服务器实现，提供远程托管版本和本地运行版本，并附带详细的文档、配置示例和策略治理指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，基于 MCP 协议，支持多种 MCP 宿主（如 VS Code、Claude Desktop、Cursor 等）。
zh.hot: 作为 GitHub 官方项目，它迅速获得 3.2 万+ Star，本月新增 854，跻身 Go 趋势榜前十，反映了 AI 编程助手与 GitHub 深度集成的强烈需求。
uses: 开发者希望让 AI 助手直接管理仓库、issue 和 PR，提升日常开发效率。
团队利用 AI 自动化 CI/CD 流程，监控构建失败并分析代码质量。
AI 工具开发者需要将 GitHub 功能集成到自定义代理或聊天机器人中。

en.tag: GitHub's official MCP server connecting AI to repositories and workflows
en.what: The GitHub MCP Server is GitHub's official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that enables AI agents, assistants, and chatbots to interact directly with the GitHub platform through natural language. It supports reading repositories and code files, managing issues and PRs, analyzing code, and automating workflows.
en.content: The repository contains a Go implementation of the MCP server, offering both a remote hosted version and a local version, along with comprehensive documentation, configuration examples, and policy governance guides.
en.stack: Developed primarily in Go, built on the MCP protocol, and compatible with various MCP hosts such as VS Code, Claude Desktop, and Cursor.
en.hot: As an official GitHub project, it quickly amassed over 32k stars, with 854 new stars this month, ranking in the top 10 Go trending repos, reflecting the strong demand for deep AI coding assistant integration with GitHub.
uses: Developers who want AI assistants to directly manage repositories, issues, and PRs to boost daily productivity.
Teams leveraging AI to automate CI/CD pipelines, monitor build failures, and analyze code quality.
AI tool builders integrating GitHub capabilities into custom agents or chatbots.

zh.tag: 多协议多用户 Xray 可视化管理面板
zh.what: 3X-UI 是一个开源的 Xray-core 服务器高级 Web 控制面板，支持部署、配置和监控多种代理与 VPN 协议。它是 X-UI 项目的增强分支，提供更广泛的协议支持、改进的稳定性和按客户端流量统计等功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Web 面板源码、多语言界面（英文、波斯语、阿拉伯语、中文等）、安装脚本、文档以及用于构建和发布的 GitHub Actions 工作流。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，基于 Xray-core 和前端框架（如 Vue.js），依赖 SQLite 等数据库存储配置。
zh.hot: 凭借 46k+ 星标和持续更新，3X-UI 成为 Xray 用户首选的图形化管理工具，今日新增 44 星，位列 Go 语言趋势榜第 9 名。
uses: 适合个人或小型团队在 VPS 上快速部署和管理多协议代理服务，无需手动编辑配置文件。
需要为多个用户分配独立流量配额、有效期和设备限制的代理服务提供者。
希望利用 AmneziaWG 或 MTProto 等抗审查协议的用户，可通过面板轻松配置。

en.tag: Multi-protocol, multi-user Xray web control panel
en.what: 3X-UI is an advanced open-source web control panel for managing Xray-core servers, enabling deployment, configuration, and monitoring of various proxy and VPN protocols. As an enhanced fork of X-UI, it offers broader protocol support, improved stability, and per-client traffic accounting.
en.content: The repository contains the full web panel source code, multi-language UI (English, Persian, Arabic, Chinese, etc.), installation scripts, documentation, and GitHub Actions workflows for building and releasing.
en.stack: Developed primarily in Go, built on Xray-core and frontend frameworks like Vue.js, with SQLite for configuration storage.
en.hot: With 46k+ stars and active development, 3X-UI is the go-to GUI management tool for Xray users, gaining 44 stars today and ranking #9 on the Go trending list.
uses: Ideal for individuals or small teams to quickly deploy and manage multi-protocol proxy services on a VPS without manual config editing.
For proxy providers needing to assign per-user traffic quotas, expiry dates, and device limits.
Users who want to leverage anti-censorship protocols like AmneziaWG or MTProto with an easy panel setup.

zh.tag: JavaScript 的超集，为大型应用提供类型系统
zh.what: TypeScript 是 JavaScript 的超集，添加了可选的静态类型，支持大型 JavaScript 应用的开发。它编译为可读的、基于标准的 JavaScript，可在任何浏览器、主机和操作系统上运行。
zh.content: 仓库包含 TypeScript 编译器的源代码、文档、测试和构建配置。主要目录包括 src（编译器源码）、tests（测试）、doc（文档）等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 自身编写编译器，构建工具为 Gulp，通过 npm 分发。
zh.hot: TypeScript 已成为大型 JavaScript 项目的标准选择，拥有超过 11 万 star，持续活跃开发，今日新增 34 星，位列 Go 语言趋势榜第 10（尽管主语言标记为 Go，实为 TypeScript 项目）。
uses: 前端开发者：在 React、Vue 等框架中使用 TypeScript 提升代码可维护性
后端开发者：使用 TypeScript 编写 Node.js 应用，获得类型安全
大型团队协作：利用类型系统减少 bug，提高代码可读性和重构效率

en.tag: A typed superset of JavaScript that compiles to clean, standards-based JS
en.what: TypeScript is a superset of JavaScript that adds optional static types, enabling large-scale JavaScript application development. It compiles to readable, standards-based JavaScript that runs on any browser, host, and OS.
en.content: The repository contains the source code of the TypeScript compiler, documentation, tests, and build configuration. Key directories include src (compiler source), tests, and doc.
en.stack: The compiler is written in TypeScript itself, built with Gulp, and distributed via npm.
en.hot: TypeScript has become the standard for large-scale JavaScript projects, with over 110k stars and active development. It gained 34 stars today, ranking #10 on the Go trending list (despite the Go label, it's a TypeScript project).
uses: Frontend developers: Use TypeScript with React, Vue, etc. to improve code maintainability
Backend developers: Write Node.js applications with TypeScript for type safety
Large team collaboration: Leverage the type system to reduce bugs and enhance code readability and refactoring efficiency

zh.tag: 基于 Sing-Box 的高级 Web 管理面板
zh.what: S-UI 是一个用于管理 Sing-Box 代理的高级 Web 面板，提供多协议、多客户端、多入站支持，以及流量路由、订阅链接和系统状态监控等功能。它旨在为用户提供直观的图形界面来配置和控制代理服务，支持多种平台和架构。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的后端服务、Web 前端界面（独立仓库）、安装脚本、Docker 支持及 API 文档。提供多语言界面（英文、波斯语、俄语、越南语、简体中文、繁体中文），并支持暗/亮主题。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，基于 SagerNet/Sing-Box 核心，前端可能使用现代 JS 框架（如 React/Vue），支持 Docker 部署，并提供 REST API。
zh.hot: 近 1 万 Star 表明其作为 Sing-Box 生态中功能丰富的面板受到广泛关注，今日新增 12 星，持续在 Go 趋势榜上活跃。
uses: 需要图形化界面管理 Sing-Box 代理服务的个人用户或小型团队
希望快速部署多协议代理服务并支持订阅链接的用户
对多平台支持（Linux/Windows/macOS）有需求的运维人员
学习和研究 Sing-Box 及代理技术的开发者

en.tag: Advanced web panel built on SagerNet/Sing-Box
en.what: S-UI is an advanced web panel for managing Sing-Box proxy, offering multi-protocol, multi-client, multi-inbound support, along with traffic routing, subscription links, and system status monitoring. It aims to provide an intuitive GUI for configuring and controlling proxy services, supporting multiple platforms and architectures.
en.content: The repository contains a Go backend, a web frontend (separate repo), installation scripts, Docker support, and API docs. It offers multi-language UI (English, Persian, Russian, Vietnamese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese) and dark/light themes.
en.stack: Primarily Go, built on SagerNet/Sing-Box core, frontend likely uses modern JS frameworks (React/Vue), supports Docker deployment, and provides REST API.
en.hot: With nearly 10k stars, it has gained significant traction as a feature-rich panel in the Sing-Box ecosystem; gaining 12 stars today, it remains active on the Go trending list.
uses: Individuals or small teams needing a GUI to manage Sing-Box proxy services
Users who want to quickly deploy multi-protocol proxy with subscription support
Operators requiring multi-platform support (Linux/Windows/macOS)
Developers learning or researching Sing-Box and proxy technologies

zh.tag: 命令行模糊查找神器，交互式终端工具包
zh.what: fzf 是一个通用的命令行模糊查找器，也是交互式终端工具包。它可以帮助用户快速筛选文件、浏览命令历史、预览数据，并通过模糊匹配处理复杂数据集，甚至能构建自定义菜单和工作流。
zh.content: 仓库包含 fzf 的完整源代码、文档、安装脚本、shell 集成（Bash/Zsh/Fish/Nushell）以及 Vim/Neovim 插件。项目以单一二进制文件分发，便于安装和移植。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖较少，可跨平台编译。支持多种终端和编辑器集成，通过事件驱动架构实现可编程性。
zh.hot: fzf 拥有超过 8.2 万星标，是终端用户提升效率的必备工具。其极快的模糊搜索速度和丰富的可定制性，使其在开发者社区中持续流行。
uses: 开发者日常使用：快速查找文件、目录和命令历史，提高终端操作效率。
系统管理员：通过模糊匹配快速筛选日志、进程或配置项，简化运维任务。
脚本编写者：利用 fzf 的可编程接口构建交互式菜单和自动化工作流。
Vim/Neovim 用户：集成插件实现文件跳转和缓冲区切换，提升编辑体验。

en.tag: A command-line fuzzy finder and interactive terminal toolkit
en.what: fzf is a general-purpose command-line fuzzy finder and an interactive terminal toolkit. It helps users quickly filter files, browse command history, preview data, and navigate complex datasets with fuzzy matching, even enabling custom menus and workflows.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, documentation, installation scripts, shell integrations for Bash/Zsh/Fish/Nushell, and Vim/Neovim plugins. The project is distributed as a single binary for easy installation and portability.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go with minimal dependencies, cross-platform compilation supported. Integrates with various shells and editors, featuring an event-driven architecture for programmability.
en.hot: With over 82k stars, fzf is an essential tool for terminal users to boost productivity. Its blazing-fast fuzzy search and extensive customizability keep it popular among developers.
uses: For developers: quickly locate files, directories, and command history to boost terminal efficiency.
For sysadmins: filter logs, processes, or config entries via fuzzy matching to simplify operations.
For scripters: leverage fzf's programmable interface to build interactive menus and automated workflows.
For Vim/Neovim users: integrate the plugin for file jumping and buffer switching to enhance editing.

zh.tag: 单文件开源实时后端，含数据库、认证、文件管理与后台 UI
zh.what: PocketBase 是一个用 Go 编写的开源后端，提供嵌入式 SQLite 数据库、实时订阅、内置用户与文件管理、管理后台 UI 以及简单的 REST 风格 API。它既可以作为独立应用运行，也可以作为 Go 库集成到自定义项目中。
zh.content: 仓库包含 PocketBase 的完整源代码、示例应用（如 examples/base）、官方 SDK 客户端（JavaScript 和 Dart）的链接，以及详细的文档和 API 参考。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 SQLite 作为嵌入式数据库，并支持通过 JavaScript VM 插件进行扩展。
zh.hot: PocketBase 以单文件部署的便捷性和实时功能吸引了大量开发者，star 数已超过 6 万，尽管仍处于活跃开发阶段，但因其简化后端开发流程而广受欢迎。
uses: 独立开发者或小团队快速搭建 MVP 或原型，无需复杂后端基础设施
需要实时数据同步的 Web 或移动应用，如聊天应用、协作工具
希望用 Go 构建自定义后端逻辑，但不想重复造轮子的开发者
教育或学习用途，了解后端架构和实时通信的实践

en.tag: Open-source realtime backend in one file with embedded DB, auth, files, and admin UI
en.what: PocketBase is an open-source backend written in Go, featuring an embedded SQLite database with realtime subscriptions, built-in user and file management, an admin dashboard UI, and a simple REST-ish API. It can be used as a standalone app or as a Go library for custom business logic.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of PocketBase, example apps (e.g., examples/base), links to official SDK clients (JavaScript and Dart), and comprehensive documentation and API references.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, relying on SQLite as the embedded database, and supports extensibility via a JavaScript VM plugin.
en.hot: PocketBase has attracted over 60k stars due to its single-file deployment convenience and realtime capabilities, making backend development simpler, despite being under active development.
uses: For indie developers or small teams to quickly build MVPs or prototypes without complex backend infrastructure
For web or mobile apps requiring realtime data sync, such as chat apps or collaborative tools
For developers who want to build custom backend logic in Go without reinventing the wheel
For educational purposes to learn backend architecture and realtime communication practices

zh.tag: Go 语言优质框架、库与软件精选清单
zh.what: 这是一个精选的 Go 语言框架、库和软件列表，由社区维护，旨在帮助开发者发现高质量的工具。它按功能分类，如命令行、网络、数据库等，并持续更新。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个按功能分类的 README 文件，涵盖音频、认证、命令行、数据库、网络等众多类别，并附有贡献指南和社区链接。
zh.stack: 纯文档项目，基于 Markdown 编写，使用 GitHub Actions 进行自动化检查，依赖 Awesome 列表规范。
zh.hot: 作为 Go 生态最权威的资源索引，长期保持高星，今日新增 99 星，日榜第 7，反映社区对高质量工具发现的持续需求。
uses: Go 开发者寻找特定功能的库或框架时，可快速检索分类清单。
项目选型阶段，用于对比和发现社区推荐的成熟方案。
开源贡献者可通过提交 PR 来推荐或更新项目，参与社区维护。

en.tag: Curated list of awesome Go frameworks, libraries, and software
en.what: A curated list of awesome Go frameworks, libraries, and software, maintained by the community to help developers discover high-quality tools. It is organized by category (CLI, networking, databases, etc.) and continuously updated.
en.content: The repository contains a README file organized by functional categories (audio, authentication, CLI, databases, networking, etc.), along with contribution guidelines and community links.
en.stack: A documentation-only project written in Markdown, with GitHub Actions for automated checks, following the Awesome list guidelines.
en.hot: As the most authoritative resource index in the Go ecosystem, it maintains high stars; today gained 99 stars, ranking 7th on daily trending, reflecting ongoing demand for high-quality tool discovery.
uses: Go developers can quickly search categorized lists when looking for libraries or frameworks for specific features.
During project selection, it helps compare and discover mature solutions recommended by the community.
Open-source contributors can recommend or update projects via pull requests, participating in community maintenance.

zh.tag: V2Ray 社区维护的域名列表，生成 geosite.dat 路由规则
zh.what: 这是一个由社区维护的域名列表项目，用于生成 V2Ray 路由规则所需的 geosite.dat 文件。它本身不评判域名是否应被屏蔽或代理，而是提供灵活的数据供用户按需构建路由规则。
zh.content: 仓库包含 data 目录下的分类域名列表（如 cn、geolocation-!cn、category-ads-all 等），以及用于生成 dlc.dat 的 Go 源码。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Go 模块管理，可生成二进制文件 dlc.dat。
zh.hot: 作为 V2Ray 生态的核心数据源，近万 star 表明其高依赖度；今日新增 6 星并登上 Go 趋势榜，反映持续活跃的社区贡献。
uses: V2Ray/Xray 用户：在路由配置中引用 geosite 规则，实现分流（如直连、代理、广告拦截）。
网络工具开发者：集成 domain-list-community 数据，构建自定义路由或过滤功能。
隐私与反审查研究者：利用分类列表分析域名归属，辅助网络策略制定。

en.tag: Community-managed domain list for V2Ray geosite routing rules
en.what: This is a community-managed domain list project that generates geosite.dat files for V2Ray routing rules. It is not opinionated about whether domains should be blocked or proxied, but provides flexible data for users to build routing rules as needed.
en.content: The repository contains categorized domain lists under the data directory (e.g., cn, geolocation-!cn, category-ads-all) and Go source code to generate dlc.dat.
en.stack: Developed primarily in Go, with Go module dependencies, producing the dlc.dat binary.
en.hot: As a core data source for the V2Ray ecosystem, nearly 10k stars indicate high reliance; with 6 new stars today and trending on Go, it reflects ongoing community activity.
uses: V2Ray/Xray users: reference geosite rules in routing configs for traffic splitting (e.g., direct, proxy, ad blocking).
Network tool developers: integrate domain-list-community data to build custom routing or filtering features.
Privacy and anti-censorship researchers: use categorized lists to analyze domain ownership and assist network policy making.

zh.tag: 把文档变成可查询RAG、自主推理Agent和自维护Wiki的LLM知识平台
zh.what: WeKnora是腾讯开源的LLM知识平台，将原始文档转化为可查询的RAG、自主推理的Agent和自维护的Wiki。它支持多源数据导入、树状文件夹视图、块编辑与版本回滚，并提供交互式知识图谱。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的框架代码、架构文档、API参考、开发者指南，以及多语言README（中英日韩）。核心功能包括RAG快速问答、ReAct Agent、Wiki模式、知识图谱、多源导入（飞书、Notion、语雀、RSS等）和网站嵌入组件。
zh.stack: 主语言为Go，基于LLM能力构建，涉及RAG、ReAct Agent、MCP工具集成、向量检索等技术。支持多种文档格式和外部服务（如飞书、Notion、RSS）。
zh.hot: 上线后迅速获得2万+星标，今日新增105星，位列GitHub Go语言日榜第5。其将文档自动转化为可交互知识图谱和自维护Wiki的能力，解决了企业知识管理的痛点，备受开发者关注。
uses: 企业知识库建设：将内部文档自动整理为可查询的RAG和自维护Wiki，提升员工检索效率。
智能客服与问答系统：利用RAG快速问答能力，构建基于私有知识的对话机器人。
复杂任务自动化：通过ReAct Agent编排检索、工具调用和网络搜索，完成多步骤分析。
个人知识管理：导入个人文档，生成知识图谱和Wiki，辅助学习和研究。

en.tag: Open-source LLM knowledge platform turning documents into queryable RAG, autonomous agent, and self-maintaining Wiki
en.what: WeKnora is an open-source LLM knowledge platform from Tencent that transforms raw documents into a queryable RAG, an autonomous reasoning agent, and a self-maintaining Wiki. It supports multi-source ingestion, tree-structured folder views, chunk editing with revision history, and an interactive knowledge graph.
en.content: The repository contains the full framework code, architecture docs, API reference, developer guide, and multi-language READMEs (EN, CN, JA, KO). Key features include RAG-based Q&A, ReAct Agent, Wiki mode, knowledge graph, multi-source ingestion (Feishu, Notion, Yuque, RSS, etc.), and website embed widgets.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, built on LLM capabilities, incorporating RAG, ReAct Agent, MCP tool integration, and vector retrieval. Supports various document formats and external services like Feishu, Notion, and RSS.
en.hot: Quickly gained over 20k stars with 105 new stars today, ranking #5 on GitHub Go daily trending. Its ability to auto-convert documents into interactive knowledge graphs and self-maintaining wikis addresses enterprise knowledge management pain points, drawing significant developer attention.
uses: Enterprise knowledge base: Automatically organize internal documents into queryable RAG and self-maintaining Wiki to boost employee retrieval efficiency.
Intelligent customer service and Q&A systems: Leverage RAG-based quick Q&A to build chatbots grounded in private knowledge.
Complex task automation: Use ReAct Agent to orchestrate retrieval, tool calls, and web search for multi-step analysis.
Personal knowledge management: Import personal documents to generate knowledge graphs and wikis for learning and research.

zh.tag: 开源点对点文件持续同步工具
zh.what: Syncthing 是一款开源的持续文件同步程序，可在两台或多台计算机之间实时同步文件。它强调数据安全、安全性和易用性，无需中央服务器，通过点对点技术直接连接设备。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心同步引擎、命令行工具、Web GUI 以及 Docker 支持，并提供详细的构建指南和文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Go 标准库及少量第三方库，支持跨平台构建。
zh.hot: 拥有超过 8.8 万星标，因其安全、去中心化的文件同步方案而广受信赖，长期活跃于 GitHub 趋势榜。
uses: 个人用户在多台设备间同步文件，替代云盘服务。
团队或组织在内部网络中同步数据，确保数据私密性。
开发者利用其 API 或命令行工具集成到自动化流程中。

en.tag: Open-source P2P continuous file synchronization tool
en.what: Syncthing is an open-source continuous file synchronization program that syncs files between two or more computers in real-time. It emphasizes data safety, security, and ease of use, operating without a central server via peer-to-peer technology.
en.content: The repository includes the core sync engine, CLI tools, web GUI, Docker support, and comprehensive build guides and documentation.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, relying on the Go standard library and a few third-party libraries, with cross-platform build support.
en.hot: With over 88k stars, it is widely trusted for its secure, decentralized file sync solution and remains consistently popular on GitHub trending.
uses: Individual users syncing files across multiple devices, replacing cloud storage services.
Teams or organizations syncing data over internal networks to ensure privacy.
Developers integrating its API or CLI into automated workflows.

zh.tag: Sunshine 分支：原生分辨率低延迟串流主机
zh.what: Apollo 是一个自托管的桌面串流主机，作为 Artemis(Moonlight Noir) 的服务端，提供低延迟、原生客户端分辨率的游戏串流。它支持 AMD、Intel、Nvidia 显卡的硬件编码及软件编码，并内置虚拟显示器（支持 HDR），自动匹配客户端分辨率与帧率。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Apollo 的完整源代码，基于 Sunshine 项目开发，提供 Web UI 用于配置和客户端配对，内置虚拟显示驱动（SudoVDA）、权限管理、剪贴板同步等功能。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，依赖 SudoVDA 虚拟显示驱动，支持 Windows（虚拟显示目前仅限 Windows），未来计划支持 Linux。
zh.hot: 作为 Sunshine 的活跃分支，Apollo 凭借原生分辨率串流和自动虚拟显示等特性，在 C++ 趋势榜上排名第一，今日新增 14 星，总星数达 10816。
uses: 游戏玩家：在局域网或云端低延迟串流 PC 游戏到手机、平板等设备，享受原生分辨率画质。
云游戏服务商：利用 Apollo 的虚拟显示和权限管理功能，为多客户端提供按需的云游戏串流服务。
双 GPU 笔记本用户：通过 Apollo 的配置优化，解决混合显卡笔记本串流时的显示与性能问题。

en.tag: Sunshine fork: self-hosted low-latency game streaming at native client resolution
en.what: Apollo is a self-hosted desktop stream host that serves as the server for Artemis (Moonlight Noir), offering low-latency game streaming at the client's native resolution. It supports hardware encoding on AMD, Intel, and Nvidia GPUs, plus software encoding, and features a built-in virtual display with HDR that auto-matches client resolution and framerate.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of Apollo, forked from Sunshine, with a web UI for configuration and client pairing, built-in virtual display (SudoVDA), permission management, clipboard sync, and more.
en.stack: Primarily C++, relies on SudoVDA for virtual display, currently Windows-only for virtual display, with Linux support planned.
en.hot: As a popular Sunshine fork, Apollo tops the C++ trending chart with 10.8k stars, gaining 14 today, thanks to its native-resolution streaming and automatic virtual display features.
uses: Gamers: stream PC games to mobile devices over LAN or cloud with low latency and native resolution.
Cloud gaming providers: leverage Apollo's virtual display and permission management for on-demand streaming to multiple clients.
Dual-GPU laptop users: benefit from Apollo's configuration optimizations for hybrid graphics laptops.

zh.tag: 隐私优先的 Chromium 浏览器，无广告无噪音
zh.what: Helium 是一款基于 Chromium 的网页浏览器，强调隐私保护和无偏见广告拦截。它去除了 Google 相关服务，提供简洁、快速的上网体验，目前处于测试阶段。
zh.content: 仓库包含浏览器核心代码、补丁集（来自 ungoogled-chromium 等）以及品牌资源。平台打包和工具链分别存放在独立的仓库中。
zh.stack: 基于 Chromium 和 ungoogled-chromium，使用 C++ 开发，集成 uBlock Origin 的修改版用于广告拦截。
zh.hot: 隐私浏览器需求旺盛，Helium 以无偏见广告拦截和简洁设计吸引用户，star 数已超 2 万，今日新增 111，登上 C++ 趋势榜。
uses: 注重隐私、希望摆脱 Google 追踪的普通用户
开发者可参与贡献，基于 Chromium 的浏览器定制开发
寻求无广告干扰、简洁快速浏览体验的用户

en.tag: Privacy-first Chromium browser with unbiased ad-blocking, no bloat
en.what: Helium is a Chromium-based web browser focused on privacy and unbiased ad-blocking. It removes Google services, offering a clean, fast browsing experience, currently in beta.
en.content: The repo contains the browser core, patchset (from ungoogled-chromium etc.), and branding assets. Platform packaging and tooling are in separate repos.
en.stack: Built on Chromium and ungoogled-chromium, developed in C++, integrates a modified uBlock Origin for ad-blocking.
en.hot: High demand for privacy browsers, Helium attracts users with unbiased ad-blocking and clean design, stars exceed 20k with 111 added today, trending in C++.
uses: Privacy-conscious users who want to avoid Google tracking
Developers interested in contributing to Chromium-based browser customization
Users seeking an ad-free, clean, and fast browsing experience

zh.tag: 多用途模拟框架，保存数十年软件历史
zh.what: MAME 是一个多用途的模拟框架，旨在通过记录硬件及其工作原理来保存数十年的软件历史。它最初是街机模拟器，现已涵盖大量（主要是复古的）计算机、游戏机和计算器。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 MAME 源代码、构建系统（支持 make 和 Windows 项目）、文档、CI 配置以及社区链接。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 SDL2 等库，支持跨平台（Linux、macOS、Windows）。
zh.hot: 作为经典的开源模拟器项目，持续维护且拥有庞大社区，今日新增 4 星，位列 C++ 趋势榜第三。
uses: 复古游戏爱好者：在 PC 上重温街机、家用机等经典游戏。
软件历史研究者：通过模拟器了解早期硬件和软件的工作原理。
开发者：学习大型 C++ 项目的架构与跨平台构建。

en.tag: Multi-purpose emulation framework preserving decades of software history
en.what: MAME is a multi-purpose emulation framework that aims to preserve decades of software history by documenting hardware and how it functions. Originally an arcade emulator, it now covers a wide variety of vintage computers, consoles, and calculators.
en.content: The repository contains the full MAME source code, build system (make and Windows projects), documentation, CI configurations, and community links.
en.stack: Written primarily in C++, relies on SDL2 and other libraries, cross-platform (Linux, macOS, Windows).
en.hot: As a classic open-source emulator with active maintenance and a large community, it gained 4 stars today, ranking #3 on the C++ trending list.
uses: Retro gaming fans: replay classic arcade and console games on PC.
Software history researchers: understand early hardware and software through emulation.
Developers: learn architecture and cross-platform build from a large C++ project.

zh.tag: 开源重制《英雄无敌3》引擎，扩展无限可能
zh.what: VCMI 是《魔法门之英雄无敌 III》的开源引擎重制版，旨在以现代技术重现经典游戏，并提供原版不具备的新功能和扩展能力。它支持多平台，包括 Windows、macOS、Linux、Android 和 iOS。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的引擎源代码、安装指南、翻译文件（通过 Weblate 协作）以及持续集成配置。项目提供每日构建和定期主要版本，并有活跃的社区论坛和 Discord 频道。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，依赖 SDL 等库实现跨平台图形和输入。项目使用 CMake 构建，并集成了 GitHub Actions 进行持续集成。
zh.hot: 作为经典游戏的忠实重制，VCMI 吸引了大量怀旧玩家和技术爱好者。尽管今日新增 star 不多，但累计 5837 星和长期活跃的社区证明了其持久热度。
uses: 怀旧玩家：希望在现代设备上重温《英雄无敌3》的经典战役和地图。
模组开发者：利用扩展引擎创建新的游戏内容、地图和机制。
跨平台用户：在 Android 或 iOS 等移动设备上体验桌面级游戏。
开源贡献者：参与翻译、测试和代码开发，共同完善项目。

en.tag: Open-source engine remake of Heroes of Might & Magic III with extended possibilities
en.what: VCMI is an open-source recreation of the Heroes of Might & Magic III engine, aiming to bring the classic game to modern platforms with new and extended features. It supports Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, and iOS.
en.content: The repository contains the full engine source code, installation guides, translation files (collaborated via Weblate), and CI configurations. It offers daily builds and periodic major releases, with active community forums and a Discord channel.
en.stack: Primarily developed in C++, relying on libraries like SDL for cross-platform graphics and input. The project uses CMake for building and integrates GitHub Actions for CI.
en.hot: As a faithful remake of a classic game, VCMI attracts nostalgic players and tech enthusiasts. Despite modest daily star gains, its cumulative 5837 stars and long-active community demonstrate enduring popularity.
uses: Nostalgic gamers: Relive the classic Heroes III campaigns and maps on modern devices.
Mod developers: Use the extended engine to create new content, maps, and mechanics.
Cross-platform users: Experience desktop-quality gaming on mobile devices like Android or iOS.
Open-source contributors: Participate in translation, testing, and development to improve the project.

zh.tag: 高性能跨平台 PlayStation 1 模拟器
zh.what: DuckStation 是一款专注于可玩性、速度和长期可维护性的 PlayStation 1 模拟器。它旨在尽可能准确，同时保持适合低端设备的性能，默认配置应支持所有可玩游戏。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Qt 前端和基于 Dear ImGui 的全屏/TV UI，以及 CPU 重编译器/JIT、硬件渲染器、纹理替换、PGXP 几何精度增强等功能。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++，支持多种后端 API（D3D11/12、OpenGL、Vulkan、Metal），并针对 x86-64、ARM 和 RISC-V 架构进行优化。
zh.hot: 凭借 10645 星和今日新增 6 星，DuckStation 在 GitHub Trending C++ 日榜排名第 5，因其出色的兼容性、跨平台支持和持续活跃的维护而广受欢迎。
uses: 怀旧游戏玩家：在 PC、Linux 或 Mac 上重温 PS1 经典游戏，支持高分辨率渲染和纹理增强。
模拟器开发者：研究 PS1 模拟技术，参考其 JIT 编译器、硬件渲染和 PGXP 实现。
低端设备用户：在树莓派或 ARM 设备上流畅运行 PS1 游戏，得益于对 ARM 和 RISC-V 的优化。

en.tag: Fast cross-platform PlayStation 1 emulator
en.what: DuckStation is a PlayStation 1 emulator focusing on playability, speed, and long-term maintainability. It aims to be as accurate as possible while maintaining performance suitable for low-end devices, with default settings supporting all playable games.
en.content: The repository includes a full-featured Qt frontend and a fullscreen/TV UI based on Dear ImGui, along with CPU recompiler/JIT, hardware renderers, texture replacement, PGXP geometry precision, and more.
en.stack: Primarily C++, supports multiple backends (D3D11/12, OpenGL, Vulkan, Metal), and optimized for x86-64, ARM, and RISC-V architectures.
en.hot: With 10,645 stars and 6 added today, DuckStation ranks #5 on GitHub Trending C++ daily, popular for its excellent compatibility, cross-platform support, and active maintenance.
uses: Retro gamers: Relive PS1 classics on PC, Linux, or Mac with upscaling and texture enhancements.
Emulator developers: Study PS1 emulation techniques, referencing its JIT, hardware rendering, and PGXP implementations.
Low-end device users: Run PS1 games smoothly on Raspberry Pi or ARM devices, thanks to ARM and RISC-V optimizations.

zh.tag: ESP32 上的 WiFi/蓝牙攻防工具套件
zh.what: ESP32 Marauder 是一套运行在 ESP32 微控制器上的 WiFi 和蓝牙攻击与防御工具，提供网络扫描、数据包嗅探、欺骗攻击等功能。它适用于安全研究、渗透测试和网络调试。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的固件源码、预编译的发布版本、详细的 Wiki 文档以及用于构建和测试的自动化工作流。固件支持通过命令行界面或 Web 界面进行交互。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，基于 ESP32 Arduino 框架，依赖 ESP32 的 WiFi 和蓝牙库。构建系统支持 PlatformIO 和 Arduino IDE。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub 上积累了 12,250 颗星，因其将复杂的网络攻击工具集成到低成本、便携的 ESP32 设备上而备受关注，吸引了安全爱好者和硬件黑客。
uses: 安全研究人员和渗透测试人员评估 WiFi/蓝牙网络安全性
硬件爱好者和创客学习嵌入式网络编程和无线电通信
网络管理员进行无线网络审计和故障排查

en.tag: A suite of WiFi/Bluetooth offensive and defensive tools for ESP32
en.what: ESP32 Marauder is a suite of WiFi and Bluetooth offensive and defensive tools that run on the ESP32 microcontroller, offering features like network scanning, packet sniffing, and spoofing attacks. It is designed for security research, penetration testing, and network debugging.
en.content: The repository contains full firmware source code, precompiled release binaries, comprehensive Wiki documentation, and automated build/test workflows. The firmware can be interacted with via a command-line interface or a web interface.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, based on the ESP32 Arduino framework, leveraging ESP32's WiFi and Bluetooth libraries. Build system supports PlatformIO and Arduino IDE.
en.hot: With 12,250 stars, this project has gained significant attention for packing sophisticated network attack tools into a low-cost, portable ESP32 device, appealing to security enthusiasts and hardware hackers.
uses: Security researchers and penetration testers assessing WiFi/Bluetooth network security
Hardware enthusiasts and makers learning embedded networking and radio communication
Network administrators performing wireless network audits and troubleshooting

zh.tag: NVIDIA 高性能线性代数 CUDA 模板与 Python DSL 库
zh.what: CUTLASS 是 NVIDIA 推出的开源库，提供 CUDA C++ 模板抽象和 Python DSL，用于实现高性能矩阵乘法（GEMM）及相关计算。它支持多种数据类型和架构，并允许用户通过自定义 tile 大小和策略进行调优。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 C++ 模板库、CuTe DSL（Python 接口）、示例代码（如 FP32 模拟）、文档和媒体资源。
zh.stack: 基于 CUDA C++，依赖 NVIDIA GPU 架构（Volta 到 Blackwell），Python DSL 层使用 Python 实现。
zh.hot: CUTLASS 是 GPU 高性能计算领域的标杆项目，star 数超 1 万，今日新增 11，位列 C++ 日榜第 7，因其持续更新（4.8.0）和新增 Python DSL 降低使用门槛而备受关注。
uses: 高性能计算研究人员和性能工程师，用于开发和优化自定义 GPU 内核。
深度学习框架开发者，需要集成高效 GEMM 运算。
学生和初学者，通过 Python DSL 快速学习 GPU 编程和内核设计。

en.tag: NVIDIA's CUDA templates & Python DSLs for high-performance linear algebra
en.what: CUTLASS is an open-source library from NVIDIA providing CUDA C++ template abstractions and Python DSLs for high-performance matrix multiplication (GEMM) and related computations. It supports various data types and architectures, allowing customization via tiling and algorithmic policies.
en.content: The repository contains core C++ template library, CuTe DSL (Python interface), examples (e.g., FP32 emulation), documentation, and media assets.
en.stack: Built on CUDA C++, targeting NVIDIA GPU architectures (Volta to Blackwell), with Python DSL layer implemented in Python.
en.hot: CUTLASS is a benchmark project in GPU HPC, with over 10k stars and 11 new today, ranking #7 on C++ daily trending. Its continuous updates (4.8.0) and new Python DSL lowering the entry barrier attract attention.
uses: HPC researchers and performance engineers developing and optimizing custom GPU kernels.
Deep learning framework developers needing efficient GEMM integration.
Students and beginners using Python DSL to quickly learn GPU programming and kernel design.

zh.tag: 跨平台 C++ 音频应用与插件开发框架
zh.what: JUCE 是一个开源的跨平台 C++ 应用程序框架，用于开发桌面和移动应用，特别专注于音频软件，支持 VST、VST3、AU、AUv3、AAX 和 LV2 等插件格式。它提供了丰富的 UI 组件和音频处理模块，简化了专业音频软件的开发。
zh.content: 仓库包含 JUCE 框架的完整源代码，包括核心模块（如音频、UI、图形）、示例项目、Projucer 项目生成工具（需自行构建）以及 CMake 构建支持。目录结构清晰，分为 modules、examples、extras 等部分。
zh.stack: 基于 C++17（启用 Windows MIDI 服务时需 C++20），支持 CMake 3.22+ 和 Projucer 构建。依赖平台 SDK（如 Xcode、Visual Studio、Android Studio），并利用各平台的图形和音频 API。
zh.hot: JUCE 是音频开发领域的标杆框架，拥有近 9k 星标，今日新增 5 星并登上 C++ 日榜第 8，持续吸引音频开发者关注。
uses: 音频插件开发者：创建 VST/AU/AAX 等格式的合成器、效果器。
跨平台应用开发者：构建桌面和移动端的音频或多媒体应用。
音乐技术研究者：利用其模块化设计快速原型验证算法。
教学与学习：通过示例和文档学习 C++ 音频编程。

en.tag: Cross-platform C++ framework for audio apps and plugins
en.what: JUCE is an open-source cross-platform C++ application framework for building desktop and mobile applications, with a strong focus on audio software. It supports major plugin formats like VST, VST3, AU, AUv3, AAX, and LV2, and provides extensive UI components and audio modules to streamline development.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the JUCE framework, including core modules (audio, UI, graphics), example projects, the Projucer project generator (build from source), and CMake build support. The structure is organized into modules, examples, extras, etc.
en.stack: Built on C++17 (C++20 when using Windows MIDI services), supports CMake 3.22+ and Projucer. Relies on platform SDKs (Xcode, Visual Studio, Android Studio) and leverages native graphics and audio APIs.
en.hot: JUCE is a benchmark framework in audio development, with nearly 9k stars. It gained 5 stars today and ranked #8 on the C++ daily trending list, consistently attracting audio developers.
uses: Audio plugin developers: create synthesizers, effects in VST/AU/AAX formats.
Cross-platform app developers: build desktop and mobile audio or multimedia apps.
Music technology researchers: use modular design for rapid algorithm prototyping.
Educators and learners: study C++ audio programming via examples and docs.

zh.tag: 自托管游戏串流服务端，配合 Moonlight 使用
zh.what: Sunshine 是一个自托管的游戏串流服务端，兼容 Moonlight 客户端。它允许用户将 PC 上的游戏和应用串流到其他设备，支持低延迟和高画质。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++ 源代码、构建脚本、文档和图标资源。提供多种安装方式，如 Docker、Flatpak、Windows 安装包等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，依赖 FFmpeg、CUDA 等编解码库。支持 Windows、Linux 和 macOS 平台。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub 上拥有超过 4 万星标，本月新增 1103 星，位列 C++ 月榜第 22 名。其受欢迎程度源于对 NVIDIA GameStream 的替代需求，以及开源社区对自托管串流方案的青睐。
uses: 游戏玩家：将 PC 游戏串流到局域网内的其他设备，如笔记本、手机或电视。
远程办公或学习：远程访问高性能 PC 上的应用，实现移动办公。
开源爱好者：自建串流服务，摆脱对商业服务的依赖，保障隐私和自由度。

en.tag: Self-hosted game streaming host for Moonlight
en.what: Sunshine is a self-hosted game stream host that works with Moonlight clients. It enables users to stream games and applications from their PC to other devices with low latency and high quality.
en.content: The repository contains full C++ source code, build scripts, documentation, and icon assets. Multiple installation methods are available, including Docker, Flatpak, Windows installers, etc.
en.stack: Primarily developed in C++, relying on FFmpeg, CUDA, and other codec libraries. Supports Windows, Linux, and macOS platforms.
en.hot: With over 40,000 stars and 1,103 new stars this month, ranking 22nd on the C++ monthly trending list, its popularity stems from the need for a replacement for NVIDIA GameStream and the community's preference for self-hosted streaming solutions.
uses: Gamers: stream PC games to other devices on the local network, such as laptops, phones, or TVs.
Remote work or study: remotely access applications on a high-performance PC for mobile productivity.
Open-source enthusiasts: self-host streaming services to avoid commercial dependencies, ensuring privacy and freedom.

zh.tag: 免费强大的 UCI 国际象棋引擎，AI 与算法爱好者的经典之作
zh.what: Stockfish 是一个免费且强大的 UCI 国际象棋引擎，能够分析棋局并计算最佳走法。它本身不包含图形界面，需要配合第三方 GUI 使用。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++ 源代码、Makefile 构建文件、NNUE 神经网络权重文件，以及 README、许可证和作者列表等文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，支持多种硬件指令集和平台，采用 NNUE 神经网络评估，依赖 Makefile 构建系统。
zh.hot: 作为顶级开源国际象棋引擎，持续吸引开发者关注，今日新增 20 星，位居 C++ 趋势榜第四，彰显其长久影响力。
uses: 国际象棋爱好者或棋手，希望使用强大引擎分析棋局或与 GUI 配合进行训练。
AI 与算法研究者，可学习其搜索算法、评估函数及 NNUE 的实现。
开发者可基于 Stockfish 构建自己的国际象棋应用或服务。

en.tag: A free and powerful UCI chess engine, a classic for AI and algorithm enthusiasts
en.what: Stockfish is a free and powerful UCI chess engine that analyzes positions and computes optimal moves. It does not include a GUI, requiring third-party interfaces for interaction.
en.content: The repository contains the full C++ source code, a Makefile for building, NNUE neural network weights, and documentation files like README, license, and authors.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, supporting various CPU architectures and platforms, utilizing NNUE neural network evaluation, and built with Makefile.
en.hot: As a top open-source chess engine, it consistently attracts developers, gaining 20 stars today and ranking 4th on the C++ trending list, reflecting its enduring influence.
uses: Chess enthusiasts or players who want a powerful engine for analysis or training with a GUI.
AI and algorithm researchers interested in studying search algorithms, evaluation functions, and NNUE implementation.
Developers who want to build chess applications or services on top of Stockfish.

zh.tag: 零解析直接读的高效跨平台序列化库
zh.what: FlatBuffers 是一个跨平台的序列化库，旨在实现最大内存效率。它允许直接访问序列化数据而无需先解析或解包，同时保持很好的向前/向后兼容性。
zh.content: 仓库包含 flatc 编译器（用于从 schema 生成代码）、多种语言的运行时库（C++、C#、Go、Java、JavaScript、TypeScript、Python、Rust 等），以及示例和测试。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，支持通过 CMake 构建，并针对多种语言提供代码生成和运行时支持。
zh.hot: 虽然今日新增 star 不多，但作为 Google 出品的经典库，累计 26k+ star，在需要高性能序列化的场景（如游戏、移动应用）中持续受到关注。
uses: 游戏开发中需要快速加载和低内存占用的资源格式
移动应用或嵌入式系统对性能和内存敏感的场景
需要跨语言、跨平台且支持向前向后兼容的数据交换

en.tag: Memory-efficient cross-platform serialization with zero-copy access
en.what: FlatBuffers is a cross-platform serialization library architected for maximum memory efficiency. It allows direct access to serialized data without parsing/unpacking first, while maintaining excellent forward/backward compatibility.
en.content: The repository includes the flatc compiler (for generating code from schemas), runtime libraries for multiple languages (C++, C#, Go, Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Rust, etc.), along with samples and tests.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, built with CMake, and supports code generation and runtime for many languages.
en.hot: Despite modest daily stars, as a classic Google library with 26k+ total stars, it remains relevant for high-performance serialization in games and mobile apps.
uses: Game development requiring fast loading and low-memory resource formats
Performance- and memory-sensitive scenarios in mobile or embedded systems
Cross-language, cross-platform data exchange with forward/backward compatibility

zh.tag: 本地AI服务器，让GPU/NPU跑起云端级模型
zh.what: Lemonade 是一个本地 AI 服务器，提供与云端 API 类似的功能，但完全免费且私密。它支持在用户的 NPU 和 GPU 上运行最新的聊天、编程、语音和图像生成模型，并兼容 OpenAI、Anthropic 和 Ollama 等标准 API。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Lemonade Server（可安装为服务，连接数百个应用）和 Embeddable Lemonade（可嵌入应用的便携二进制），并提供模型管理器、内置聊天/图像/语音界面以及移动端应用。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，针对 AMD Ryzen AI、Radeon 和 Strix Halo 进行了优化，支持 Windows、Linux、macOS 和 Docker。
zh.hot: 随着本地 AI 需求增长，Lemonade 提供免费、私密的云端替代方案，且兼容主流 API，吸引了大量开发者。其 5654 星标和持续增长表明社区对本地 AI 服务器的强烈兴趣。
uses: 开发者希望在自己的 PC 上运行 AI 模型，避免云端费用和数据隐私问题。
应用开发者需要将多模态本地 AI 集成到自己的软件中，以提供离线智能功能。
对 AI 感兴趣的用户希望在本地尝试最新模型，无需复杂配置。

en.tag: Local AI server that runs cloud-grade models on your own GPU/NPU
en.what: Lemonade is a local AI server that offers cloud-API-like capabilities, but 100% free and private. It runs the latest models for chat, coding, speech, and image generation on your own NPU and GPU, and is compatible with standard OpenAI, Anthropic, and Ollama APIs.
en.content: The repo includes Lemonade Server (a service you can connect to hundreds of apps) and Embeddable Lemonade (a portable binary for embedding into your own app), along with a model manager, built-in chat/image/speech interfaces, and mobile apps.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, optimized for AMD Ryzen AI, Radeon, and Strix Halo, with support for Windows, Linux, macOS, and Docker.
en.hot: With the rise of local AI demand, Lemonade offers a free, private alternative to cloud APIs and is compatible with major APIs, attracting many developers. Its 5,654 stars and steady growth reflect strong community interest in local AI servers.
uses: Developers who want to run AI models on their own PCs to avoid cloud costs and data privacy issues.
App developers needing to embed multimodal local AI into their software for offline intelligence.
AI enthusiasts who want to try the latest models locally without complex setup.

zh.tag: 开源跨平台数字音频工作站，音乐制作一站式工具
zh.what: LMMS 是一款开源、跨平台的数字音频工作站，用于音乐创作。它集成了钢琴卷帘、节拍音序器、歌曲编辑器和混音器，支持作曲、编曲和混音。内置 15 多种合成器插件，并支持 VST2 和 SoundFont2 格式。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的源代码、构建脚本、文档和资源。核心功能包括歌曲编辑器、模式编辑器、钢琴卷帘、混音器，以及多种乐器和效果插件，支持自动化、MIDI 导入导出等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 Qt 框架，支持跨平台构建（Windows、macOS、Linux）。使用 CMake 构建系统，并集成多种音频和插件标准。
zh.hot: 作为老牌开源音乐制作软件，LMMS 持续获得关注，今日新增 7 星，总星数达 10340，在 C++ 趋势榜上位列第 13。其强大的功能和免费开源特性吸引了大量音乐爱好者和开发者。
uses: 音乐制作人、作曲家和编曲者，用于创作电子音乐、嘻哈、配乐等
音频编程爱好者和开发者，希望学习或扩展数字音频工作站功能
教育场景，用于音乐制作教学和学生学习音频工程
预算有限的独立音乐人，替代昂贵的商业 DAW 软件

en.tag: Open-source cross-platform DAW for music production
en.what: LMMS is an open-source, cross-platform digital audio workstation for music production. It includes an advanced Piano Roll, Beat Sequencer, Song Editor, and Mixer for composing, arranging, and mixing music. It comes with 15+ synthesizer plugins by default, along with VST2 and SoundFont2 support.
en.content: The repository contains full source code, build scripts, documentation, and resources. Key features include Song Editor, Pattern Editor, Piano Roll, Mixer, and various instrument/effect plugins, with automation, MIDI import/export, etc.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, relies on Qt framework, supports cross-platform builds (Windows, macOS, Linux). Uses CMake build system and integrates various audio and plugin standards.
en.hot: As a long-standing open-source music production software, LMMS continues to gain attention, with 7 stars today and a total of 10,340 stars, ranking #13 on the C++ trending list. Its powerful features and free/open-source nature attract many music enthusiasts and developers.
uses: Music producers, composers, and arrangers for creating electronic music, hip-hop, soundtracks, etc.
Audio programming enthusiasts and developers looking to learn or extend DAW functionality
Educational settings for teaching music production and audio engineering
Independent musicians on a budget seeking a free alternative to expensive commercial DAWs

zh.tag: 全球首款免费开源的 PS3 模拟器与调试器
zh.what: RPCS3 是一款用 C++ 编写的 PlayStation 3 模拟器和调试器，支持 Windows、Linux、macOS 和 FreeBSD。它允许用户在 PC 上运行 PS3 游戏，并提供调试功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含模拟器的完整源代码、构建脚本、文档（如 BUILDING.md）以及 Wiki 链接。项目还设有 Discord 服务器和论坛，用于讨论和兼容性报告。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++，依赖图形驱动和 Visual C++ 运行库。构建环境配置详见 BUILDING.md。
zh.hot: 作为 PS3 模拟器的先驱，RPCS3 持续吸引关注，本月新增 317 星，总星数达 19651，位列 C++ 趋势榜第 14 名。其活跃的社区和不断改进的兼容性是其热度来源。
uses: 游戏玩家：在 PC 上体验 PS3 独占游戏，无需主机硬件。
开发者：研究 PS3 架构，参与模拟器开发或逆向工程。
测试人员：贡献游戏兼容性报告，帮助改进模拟器。

en.tag: World's first free & open-source PS3 emulator/debugger
en.what: RPCS3 is a PlayStation 3 emulator and debugger written in C++, supporting Windows, Linux, macOS, and FreeBSD. It allows users to run PS3 games on PC and provides debugging capabilities.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the emulator, build scripts, documentation (e.g., BUILDING.md), and links to the Wiki. The project also has a Discord server and forums for discussion and compatibility reports.
en.stack: Primarily C++, relies on graphics drivers and Visual C++ redistributables. Build environment setup is detailed in BUILDING.md.
en.hot: As a pioneer PS3 emulator, RPCS3 continues to attract attention, gaining 317 stars this month to reach 19,651 total, ranking 14th on the C++ trending list. Its active community and improving compatibility drive its popularity.
uses: Gamers: Experience PS3 exclusive titles on PC without console hardware.
Developers: Study PS3 architecture, contribute to emulator development or reverse engineering.
Testers: Submit game compatibility reports to help improve the emulator.

zh.tag: 基于 Firefox 的极简浏览器，追求专注与高效
zh.what: Zen Browser 是一款基于 Firefox 的开源浏览器，旨在通过简洁的界面和强大的自定义功能提升用户的生产力。它提供更干净的浏览体验，减少干扰，让用户专注于内容。
zh.content: 仓库包含浏览器源代码、文档、贡献指南以及用于构建和发布的配置文件。主要目录包括 docs/（文档与资产）和 src/（核心实现）。
zh.stack: 基于 Mozilla Firefox（当前版本 155.0.1），主要使用 C++ 和 JavaScript（Firefox 的底层技术），并利用 GitHub Actions 进行自动化构建。
zh.hot: 凭借 4.4 万+ 的 star 数，Zen 浏览器因其对隐私和极简设计的承诺而备受关注，在追求高效浏览的用户中迅速走红。
uses: 适合希望减少干扰、提升专注力的日常用户。
适合喜欢深度自定义浏览器界面和功能的爱好者。
适合关注隐私和开源替代品的 Firefox 用户。

en.tag: A Firefox-based browser for a calmer, more focused internet experience
en.what: Zen Browser is an open-source browser built on Firefox, designed to boost productivity with a clean interface and powerful customization. It offers a calmer, distraction-free browsing experience.
en.content: The repository contains the browser's source code, documentation, contribution guidelines, and build/release configuration. Key directories include docs/ (documentation and assets) and src/ (core implementation).
en.stack: Built on Mozilla Firefox (currently version 155.0.1), primarily using C++ and JavaScript (Firefox's underlying tech), with GitHub Actions for automated builds.
en.hot: With over 44k stars, Zen Browser has gained traction for its privacy-focused, minimalist design, appealing to users seeking a more efficient browsing experience.
uses: For everyday users seeking a distraction-free, focused browsing experience.
For enthusiasts who enjoy deep customization of browser UI and features.
For Firefox users interested in privacy-focused, open-source alternatives.

zh.tag: 开源精灵动画编辑器，Aseprite 的 GPL 分支
zh.what: LibreSprite 是一款免费开源的像素艺术与动画编辑工具，支持实时预览、洋葱皮、图层与帧动画、平铺绘制等专业功能。它源自 Aseprite 在转向专有许可前的最后一个 GPLv2 版本，并独立发展。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++ 源代码、跨平台构建配置（Linux/Windows/macOS/Android）、安装与贡献指南，以及主题资源等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 CMake 构建系统，并集成 GitHub Actions 进行多平台持续集成。
zh.hot: 作为 Aseprite 的开源替代品，它吸引了大量寻求免费像素艺术工具的创作者，star 数达 8357，并持续出现在趋势榜上。
uses: 独立游戏开发者制作像素风格角色与动画
像素艺术家创作游戏素材或艺术插画
教育场景中教授动画原理与像素艺术
需要跨平台开源工具且不愿付费的用户

en.tag: Open-source animated sprite editor, a GPL fork of Aseprite
en.what: LibreSprite is a free and open-source pixel art and animation editor with real-time preview, onion skinning, layers and frames, tiled drawing, and pixel-precise tools. It originates from the last GPLv2 commit of Aseprite before its license change, and is now independently developed.
en.content: The repository contains the full C++ source code, cross-platform build configurations (Linux/Windows/macOS/Android), installation and contributing guides, and theming resources.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, built with CMake, and uses GitHub Actions for multi-platform CI.
en.hot: As a free alternative to Aseprite, it attracts many creators seeking open-source pixel art tools, with 8,357 stars and ongoing presence on trending lists.
uses: Indie game developers creating pixel-art characters and animations
Pixel artists producing game assets or artistic illustrations
Educators teaching animation principles and pixel art
Users needing a cross-platform open-source tool without cost

zh.tag: 基于 Vulkan 的 Direct3D 翻译层，让 Windows 游戏在 Linux 上流畅运行
zh.what: DXVK 是一个基于 Vulkan 的 Direct3D 8/9/10/11 翻译层，允许使用 Wine 在 Linux 上运行 3D 应用程序。它将 Direct3D API 调用转换为 Vulkan，从而提供更好的性能和兼容性。
zh.content: 仓库包含 DXVK 的源代码、构建脚本和文档。主要组件是 DLL 文件（d3d8.dll, d3d9.dll, d3d10core.dll, d3d11.dll, dxgi.dll），用户将其复制到 Wine 前缀中并配置 DLL 覆盖即可使用。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 Vulkan API 和 Wine 环境。构建系统采用 Meson，支持多种平台。
zh.hot: DXVK 是 Linux 游戏生态的关键组件，被 Steam Play、Lutris 等工具广泛使用。尽管今日新增 star 不多，但长期积累的 17972 个 star 反映了其在 Linux 玩家中的高认可度。
uses: Linux 玩家希望通过 Wine 运行 Windows 游戏，获得更好的性能和兼容性。
游戏开发者或测试人员需要在 Linux 上测试 Direct3D 游戏。
使用 Steam Play、Lutris、Bottles 等工具的用户，这些工具自动集成 DXVK。

en.tag: Vulkan-based translation layer for Direct3D, enabling Windows games on Linux
en.what: DXVK is a Vulkan-based translation layer for Direct3D 8/9/10/11, allowing 3D applications to run on Linux via Wine. It translates Direct3D API calls to Vulkan, offering better performance and compatibility.
en.content: The repository contains source code, build scripts, and documentation for DXVK. The main components are DLL files (d3d8.dll, d3d9.dll, d3d10core.dll, d3d11.dll, dxgi.dll) that users copy into a Wine prefix and configure DLL overrides.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, depends on Vulkan API and Wine environment. Build system uses Meson, supporting multiple platforms.
en.hot: DXVK is a key component in the Linux gaming ecosystem, widely used by Steam Play, Lutris, and other tools. Despite modest daily star growth, its 17,972 stars reflect high recognition among Linux gamers.
uses: Linux gamers who want to run Windows games via Wine with better performance and compatibility.
Game developers or testers who need to test Direct3D games on Linux.
Users of Steam Play, Lutris, Bottles, etc., which integrate DXVK automatically.

zh.tag: 本地模型推理服务器，让 AI 代理离线运行
zh.what: Magnitude 是一个开源推理服务器，能自动检测你的硬件配置，推荐并运行最适合的本地模型，并接入你正在使用的 AI 代理（如 Pi、OpenCode、Claude Code 等）。它让代理完全离线、私密且免费地运行，无需 API 密钥或令牌费用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 CLI 工具（@magnitudedev/cli）、推理服务器核心、模型管理功能（下载、调优、运行），以及支持多种代理的集成层。提供交互式设置向导和文档，帮助用户快速配置本地模型。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 编写，通过 npm 分发 CLI。支持 macOS、Linux（Windows 通过 WSL），依赖本地硬件资源进行模型推理，兼容多种代理框架。
zh.hot: 今日新增 161 星，总星数达 1950，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜。它解决了 AI 代理依赖云端 API 的痛点，提供免费、私密、离线的本地推理方案，吸引大量开发者关注。
uses: 开发者希望让 Claude Code、Codex 等代理完全本地运行，保护代码隐私并节省 API 成本。
硬件配置不高的用户，需要自动推荐并优化适合自己设备的本地模型。
追求离线工作的场景，如无网络环境或对数据安全要求高的团队。

en.tag: Open-source inference server to run local models with your existing AI agents
en.what: Magnitude is an open-source inference server that profiles your hardware, recommends and runs the best local models, and plugs into the AI agents you already use (e.g., Pi, OpenCode, Claude Code). It enables fully offline, private, and free agent operation without API keys or token costs.
en.content: The repo includes a CLI tool (@magnitudedev/cli), the inference server core, model management (download, tune, run), and integrations for multiple agents. It offers an interactive setup wizard and documentation for quick configuration.
en.stack: Written primarily in TypeScript, distributed via npm. Supports macOS and Linux (Windows via WSL), leverages local hardware for inference, and integrates with various agent frameworks.
en.hot: Gained 161 stars today, reaching 1,950 total, and hit #14 on GitHub Trending. It addresses the pain point of cloud-dependent AI agents by offering free, private, offline local inference, attracting many developers.
uses: Developers who want agents like Claude Code or Codex to run fully locally, protecting code privacy and saving API costs.
Users with modest hardware who need automatic recommendations and tuning of local models for their devices.
Offline-first scenarios, such as no-network environments or teams with strict data security requirements.

zh.tag: AI 代理技能，一键生成可验证的交互式系统架构图
zh.what: Archify 是一个 AI 代理技能，可将代码库或系统描述转化为精美的交互式系统地图。它支持五种图表类型、四种预设、明暗主题和内置品牌标识，并能生成自包含的 HTML 文件，方便演示和分享。
zh.content: 仓库包含技能定义、文档、示例和生成器代码，支持通过 npx 命令安装到 Raven、Cursor、Claude Code 等代理。提供项目页面、场景指南和画廊，展示不同用例。
zh.stack: 主要基于 HTML，使用 TypeScript 生成确定性校验的 JSON IR，并输出 HTML、PNG、SVG、WebM 等格式。依赖 npx 进行安装，支持多种 AI 代理平台。
zh.hot: 凭借 18k+ 星标和日增千星的势头，Archify 满足了开发者对可视化架构文档的迫切需求，尤其在 AI 辅助开发场景下，能快速生成可验证的图表，提升代码审查和沟通效率。
uses: 开发者希望在代码审查前快速生成架构对比图，确保变更可验证。
技术写作者或架构师需要为系统设计生成交互式演示文档，便于向团队或客户展示。
AI 代理用户希望将代码库映射为可视化图表，以便更直观地理解系统结构和数据流。

en.tag: Agent skill that turns codebases into beautiful, verifiable interactive architecture diagrams
en.what: Archify is an agent skill that transforms a codebase or system description into a polished, interactive system map. It supports five diagram types, four presets, dark/light themes, and built-in brand marks, producing self-contained HTML files for easy presentation and sharing.
en.content: The repository contains skill definitions, documentation, examples, and generator code, installable via npx into agents like Raven, Cursor, and Claude Code. It includes a project page, scenario guide, and gallery showcasing various use cases.
en.stack: Primarily HTML-based, using TypeScript to generate deterministically checked JSON IR, outputting HTML, PNG, SVG, WebM, and more. Installed via npx, compatible with multiple AI agent platforms.
en.hot: With 18k+ stars and a daily gain of 1k, Archify addresses the urgent need for visual architecture documentation, especially in AI-assisted development, enabling quick generation of verifiable diagrams that boost code review and communication efficiency.
uses: Developers who want to quickly generate architecture comparison diagrams before code review to ensure changes are verifiable.
Technical writers or architects needing interactive presentation documents for system designs to share with teams or clients.
AI agent users who want to map codebases into visual diagrams for better understanding of system structure and data flow.

zh.tag: 开源终端编码代理，兼容任意 LLM 后端
zh.what: OpenClaude 是一个开源的编码代理 CLI，支持云端和本地模型提供商。它允许用户通过统一的终端工作流使用 OpenAI 兼容 API、Gemini、GitHub Models、Codex OAuth、Ollama 等，同时保留提示、工具、代理、MCP、斜杠命令和流式输出等功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 CLI 工具、文档、设置指南、VS Code 扩展支持以及社区资源。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 构建，依赖 Node.js 环境，支持多种 LLM 提供商 API。
zh.hot: 凭借 31k+ stars 和日增 80 的势头，OpenClaude 凭借其‘随处运行、使用任何东西’的灵活性和对多种模型后端的支持，迅速成为开发者首选。
uses: 开发者希望在终端中统一管理多种 LLM 提供商，无需切换工具。
团队需要将编码代理集成到 CI/CD 或自动化工作流中。
喜欢使用 Ollama 等本地模型进行离线开发的用户。

en.tag: Open-source terminal coding agent for any LLM backend
en.what: OpenClaude is an open-source coding-agent CLI for cloud and local model providers. It lets you use OpenAI-compatible APIs, Gemini, GitHub Models, Codex OAuth, Codex, Ollama, Atomic Chat, and other supported backends while keeping one terminal-first workflow: prompts, tools, agents, MCP, slash commands, and streaming output.
en.content: The repository includes the full CLI tool, documentation, setup guides, VS Code extension support, and community resources.
en.stack: Built primarily with TypeScript, requires Node.js, and integrates with multiple LLM provider APIs.
en.hot: With 31k+ stars and 80 daily additions, OpenClaude's flexibility to run anywhere and use any model backend has made it a top choice for developers.
uses: Developers who want to manage multiple LLM providers from one terminal without switching tools.
Teams looking to integrate a coding agent into CI/CD or automated workflows.
Users who prefer local models like Ollama for offline development.

zh.tag: 一键开启沉浸式多智能体课堂
zh.what: OpenMAIC 是一个开源的多智能体交互式课堂平台，让用户通过点击即可获得沉浸式的多智能体学习体验。它模拟真实课堂环境，由多个 AI 智能体扮演不同角色（如教师、学生），进行互动教学。
zh.content: 仓库包含前端界面（Next.js/React）、后端逻辑（LangGraph 编排）、智能体配置、部署模板（Vercel）、文档和社区资源。支持 OpenClaw 集成和 Lemonade 本地 AI。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript，使用 Next.js 16、React 19、LangGraph 1.1 构建，支持多种 LLM 提供商（如 OpenAI、Anthropic）的 API 密钥配置。
zh.hot: 凭借创新的多智能体教学理念和极简的一键部署体验，在 GitHub 上迅速走红，24 小时内新增 907 星，总星数突破 2.2 万，位列 Trending 日榜第 5。
uses: 教育工作者：快速搭建 AI 驱动的互动课堂，探索新型教学模式。
AI 开发者：研究多智能体协作与交互，参考其架构和实现。
学习者：通过沉浸式多智能体对话，获得个性化学习体验。
开源爱好者：部署和定制自己的智能体课堂，参与社区贡献。

en.tag: One-click immersive multi-agent learning classroom
en.what: OpenMAIC is an open-source multi-agent interactive classroom platform that provides an immersive learning experience with one click. It simulates a real classroom where multiple AI agents play different roles (e.g., teacher, students) to conduct interactive teaching.
en.content: The repo includes frontend UI (Next.js/React), backend logic (LangGraph orchestration), agent configurations, deployment templates (Vercel), documentation, and community resources. Supports OpenClaw integration and Lemonade local AI.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, using Next.js 16, React 19, LangGraph 1.1, and supports multiple LLM providers (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic) via API keys.
en.hot: Its innovative multi-agent teaching concept and one-click deployment experience have made it viral on GitHub, gaining 907 stars in 24 hours, surpassing 22k total stars, and ranking #5 on the daily trending list.
uses: Educators: Quickly set up AI-driven interactive classrooms to explore new teaching models.
AI developers: Study multi-agent collaboration and interaction, referencing its architecture and implementation.
Learners: Gain personalized learning experiences through immersive multi-agent dialogues.
Open-source enthusiasts: Deploy and customize their own agent classroom, contributing to the community.

zh.tag: Google 时序预测基础模型，支持多变量与协变量
zh.what: TimesFM 是 Google Research 开发的预训练时序基础模型，用于时间序列预测。它采用 decoder-only 架构，在大量时序数据上预训练，能够进行零样本预测。最新 3.0 版本支持原生多变量预测和协变量，并在多个基准上排名第一。
zh.content: 仓库包含模型源码、预训练权重（Hugging Face）、示例和文档。代码结构分版本管理，最新 3.0 在根目录，旧版本归档在 v1 子目录。
zh.stack: 基于 PyTorch 实现，依赖 Hugging Face Transformers 等。提供 pip 包安装，支持 Python。
zh.hot: 近期发布 3.0 版本，带来多变量预测和协变量支持，在三大基准上排名第一，引发社区关注。今日新增 1618 star，总星标超 3 万。
uses: 时间序列预测研究者：用于零样本预测和模型对比实验
数据科学家：快速进行多变量预测，无需大量训练数据
企业应用开发者：集成到 BigQuery ML 或 Vertex AI 进行规模化预测

en.tag: Google's pretrained time-series foundation model for forecasting, with multivariate & covariate support
en.what: TimesFM is a pretrained time-series foundation model by Google Research for time-series forecasting. It uses a decoder-only architecture pretrained on diverse time-series data, enabling zero-shot forecasting. The latest 3.0 version natively supports multivariate forecasting and covariates, ranking #1 on multiple benchmarks.
en.content: The repo contains model source code, pretrained weights (on Hugging Face), examples, and docs. Code is organized by version; latest 3.0 is at root, older versions archived under v1.
en.stack: Implemented in PyTorch, leveraging Hugging Face Transformers. Installable via pip, Python-based.
en.hot: The recent 3.0 release with native multivariate forecasting and covariates, achieving #1 on three major benchmarks, has sparked interest. Gained 1,618 stars today, total over 30k.
uses: Time-series researchers: for zero-shot forecasting and model benchmarking
Data scientists: for quick multivariate forecasting without extensive training data
Enterprise developers: integrating with BigQuery ML or Vertex AI for scalable forecasting

zh.tag: 2小时从零训练64M超小语言模型，全流程开源教程
zh.what: MiniMind 是一个从零开始训练超小语言模型（64M参数）的开源项目，仅需3块钱成本和2小时即可在单张消费级GPU上完成训练。项目覆盖从数据清洗、预训练到SFT、RLHF、Agentic RL等完整链路，并扩展了视觉、多模态等变体。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的训练代码、模型结构定义、数据预处理脚本、训练教程和多个模型变体（如MiniMind-V、MiniMind-O）。所有核心算法均用PyTorch原生实现，不依赖高层封装库。
zh.stack: 基于Python和PyTorch，从零实现Transformer、MoE、LoRA、DPO、PPO等算法，不依赖transformers/trl等库。
zh.hot: 以极低成本（3元/2小时）训练LLM的颠覆性理念，加上全流程开源和教程性质，吸引了大量希望深入理解LLM的开发者。56k星标和日增近500星，说明其精准切中了个人开发者复现大模型的需求。
uses: LLM初学者：通过从零实现和训练，深入理解大模型内部机制，而非仅使用现成库。
个人开发者/研究者：在消费级GPU上快速实验预训练、微调、RLHF等全流程。
教育场景：作为高校或培训机构的AI课程实战项目，低成本复现前沿技术。
对模型压缩和高效训练感兴趣者：探索64M小模型的性能边界和扩展方向。

en.tag: Train a 64M LLM from scratch in 2h with full pipeline, open-source tutorial
en.what: MiniMind is an open-source project to train a tiny 64M-parameter LLM from scratch, costing only $0.4 and 2 hours on a single consumer GPU. It covers the full pipeline from data cleaning, pretraining to SFT, RLHF, Agentic RL, and extends to vision and multimodal variants.
en.content: The repo contains full training code, model architecture definitions, data preprocessing scripts, tutorials, and several model variants (e.g., MiniMind-V, MiniMind-O). All core algorithms are implemented natively in PyTorch without high-level wrappers.
en.stack: Built with Python and PyTorch, implementing Transformer, MoE, LoRA, DPO, PPO from scratch, without relying on libraries like transformers/trl.
en.hot: The disruptive idea of training an LLM for just $0.4 and 2 hours, combined with full open-source pipeline and tutorial nature, attracts developers eager to understand LLMs deeply. With 56k stars and ~500 daily additions, it hits the need for personal reproduction of LLMs.
uses: LLM beginners: gain deep understanding of LLM internals by implementing and training from scratch, not just using off-the-shelf libraries.
Individual developers/researchers: quickly experiment with pretraining, fine-tuning, RLHF on consumer GPUs.
Educational settings: as a hands-on project for AI courses, reproducing cutting-edge techniques at low cost.
Those interested in model compression and efficient training: explore the performance limits of 64M small models.

zh.tag: 双足机器人强化学习训练环境，sim2real 全流程
zh.what: 这是为 Microduck 双足机器人设计的强化学习训练环境，基于 MuJoCo Warp 和 PPO 算法，在仿真中训练行走、跌倒恢复等技能，并导出 ONNX 部署到真实机器人。仓库封装了完整的 sim2real 流程，包括执行器物理、域随机化和奖励设计经验。
zh.content: 包含训练脚本、任务注册表（如行走、跌倒恢复等）、ONNX 导出工具、策略发布脚本，以及 Hugging Face Jobs 远程训练支持。还有 AGENTS.md 记录经验总结。

en.tag: Open-source SEO suite with AI agent & MCP integration for self-hosting
en.what: OpenSEO is an open-source alternative to Semrush and Ahrefs, offering keyword research, rank tracking, competitor insights, backlink audits, and site audits. It uses a pay-as-you-go model with your own DataForSEO API key instead of expensive subscriptions. It also exposes an MCP server and reusable Agent Skills so AI agents like Claude Code and OpenClaw can interact directly with SEO data.
en.content: The repository contains a full-stack application with a modern UI, supporting Docker and Cloudflare self-hosting, along with a built-in MCP server and pre-built Agent Skills (e.g., keyword-research, competitor-analysis, link-prospecting). Documentation covers API key setup, Google Search Console integration, SEO cost references, and local development guides.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, it features a modern frontend UI, relies on the DataForSEO API for search data, and communicates with external AI agents via the MCP protocol. It supports Docker containerization and Cloudflare edge hosting.
en.hot: It gained rapid traction as a free, pay-as-you-go, self-hostable alternative to expensive and bloated SEO suites; with 4,405 stars and 2,187 added this month alone—ranking 17th on GitHub's monthly TypeScript trending list—its native MCP and AI Agent support has further driven interest from developers and growth teams.
uses: Indie developers and small teams —— Avoid expensive subscriptions by using your own API key for low-cost SEO monitoring and keyword research.
AI engineers and agent builders —— Feed real-time SEO data into Claude Code, OpenClaw, or other agents via MCP for automated content strategy.
Growth and marketing teams —— Use pre-built Agent Skills to quickly run competitor analysis, link prospecting, and rank tracking.
Privacy-conscious organizations —— Self-host via Docker or Cloudflare to maintain full control over data and costs.

zh.tag: 无需 Tailscale 账号的端到端加密 netcat
zh.what: Tailcat 是 Tailscale 开源组件的重混，用于在 Tailscale 数据平面上实现类似 netcat 的功能，但不需要 Tailscale 控制平面。它提供点对点的 WireGuard 加密隧道，并通过 DERP 进行 NAT 穿透和后备中继。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 库（可导入为 github.com/tailscale/tailcat）和 CLI 工具（cmd/tailcat），以及一个实验性的浏览器 WebAssembly 演示。
zh.stack: 基于 Go 编写，使用 Tailscale 的 magicsock 数据平面和 WireGuard 加密，依赖 DERP 服务器进行中继。
zh.hot: 本周新增 3762 星，总星数达 6233，因其无需账号即可实现安全传输的创新理念而备受关注。
uses: 需要快速在两台机器间传输文件或文本，但不想配置复杂 VPN 或 SSH 隧道的开发者。
希望在不修改系统路由表或 DNS 的情况下，获得端到端加密连接的安全研究人员。
对 Tailscale 内部数据平面机制感兴趣，想学习或扩展其开源组件的 Go 开发者。

en.tag: A netcat-like tool with end-to-end encryption, no Tailscale account needed
en.what: Tailcat is a remix of Tailscale open source pieces to act like netcat, but over Tailscale's data plane without Tailscale's control plane. It provides point-to-point WireGuard-encrypted tunnels with DERP for NAT traversal and relay.
en.content: The repo contains a Go library (importable as github.com/tailscale/tailcat) and a CLI tool (cmd/tailcat), plus an experimental in-browser WebAssembly demo.
en.stack: Written in Go, leveraging Tailscale's magicsock data plane and WireGuard encryption, with DERP servers for relay.
en.hot: Gained 3762 stars this week, reaching 6233 total, due to its innovative concept of secure transfer without an account.
uses: Developers needing quick file or text transfer between two machines without complex VPN or SSH tunnel setup.
Security researchers wanting end-to-end encrypted connections without altering system routing tables or DNS.
Go developers interested in Tailscale's internal data plane mechanisms, for learning or extending open source components.

zh.tag: 一条命令微调大模型，无需SSH和复杂配置
zh.what: Soup 是一个命令行工具，旨在简化大语言模型的微调和后训练流程。用户只需编写一个 YAML 配置文件，然后执行一条命令即可完成训练，无需管理 SSH 或处理复杂的配置。它支持在普通笔记本电脑 GPU（如 4GB 显存）上训练 8B 参数的模型。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Python 包（soup-cli），提供命令行接口、配置解析、训练引擎（基于分层流式训练）以及文档和示例。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.10-3.12，使用 PyTorch 等深度学习框架，支持多种模型架构，通过 pip 安装。
zh.hot: 以 4198 星且单日新增 326 星登上趋势榜，因其大幅降低了 LLM 微调的门槛，让普通开发者也能在消费级硬件上训练大模型。
uses: 希望在自己的笔记本上微调大模型的研究者和开发者
需要快速迭代模型原型、不想折腾基础设施的 AI 工程师
教学场景中用于演示 LLM 微调流程的教师和学生

en.tag: Fine-tune LLMs with one command, no SSH or config hell
en.what: Soup is a command-line tool that simplifies fine-tuning and post-training of large language models. Users write a single YAML config and run one command to train, without SSH or complex configuration. It supports training 8B models on a 4GB laptop GPU.
en.content: The repo contains the Python package (soup-cli) with CLI, config parsing, training engine (layer streaming), plus docs and examples.
en.stack: Built on Python 3.10-3.12, uses PyTorch and other deep learning frameworks, supports various model architectures, installed via pip.
en.hot: With 4,198 stars and +326 today, it trends by dramatically lowering the barrier to LLM fine-tuning, enabling developers to train on consumer hardware.
uses: Researchers and developers who want to fine-tune LLMs on their laptops
AI engineers who need rapid prototyping without infrastructure hassle
Educators and students demonstrating LLM fine-tuning workflows

zh.tag: 把任意 AI 代理变成科学家的技能库，覆盖生物、化学、医学等 163 个技能
zh.what: 这是一个开源的科学 Agent 技能库，提供 163 个即用型技能和 100+ 科学数据库，覆盖生物学、化学、医学和药物发现。它兼容 Cursor、Claude Code、Codex 等主流 AI 代理，并遵循开放的 Agent Skills 标准，让任何 AI 代理都能执行科学任务。
zh.content: 仓库包含技能定义、测试用例、文档和示例，以及一个可选的本地 AI 协同科学家工具 K-Dense BYOK。技能以标准格式组织，便于集成和扩展。

开发者：为 AI 代理集成科学技能，构建垂直领域应用。
教育者：在教学中使用 AI 辅助科学探索，提升学生参与度。

en.tag: Turn any AI agent into an AI Scientist with 163 validated skills and 100+ scientific databases.
en.what: An open-source library of scientific Agent Skills, offering 163 ready-to-use skills and 100+ scientific databases across biology, chemistry, medicine, and drug discovery. It works with Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, and other AI agents, following the open Agent Skills standard, enabling any agent to perform scientific tasks.

zh.tag: 用任意大模型语音/文字操控 Blender 3D 的社区插件
zh.what: 这是一个 MCP（模型上下文协议）服务器，将 Blender 3D 与任意大语言模型连接起来。通过自然语言提示，用户可以创建、修改和操作 3D 场景，实现 AI 辅助的 3D 建模。

AI 开发者：探索 MCP 在创意工具中的应用，构建自定义工作流。
教育工作者：在教学中演示 AI 辅助设计，激发学生兴趣。
Blender 初学者：无需精通复杂操作，即可实现创意想法。

en.tag: Community plugin to control Blender 3D with any LLM of your choice
en.what: This is an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that connects Blender 3D to any large language model. Users can create, modify, and manipulate 3D scenes through natural language prompts, enabling AI-assisted 3D modeling.
en.content: The repository includes a Python-based MCP server (run via uvx), a Blender addon (to start the server within Blender), and comprehensive documentation and tutorials.

AI developers: Explore MCP applications in creative tools and build custom workflows.
Educators: Demonstrate AI-assisted design in teaching to inspire students.
Blender beginners: Realize creative ideas without mastering complex operations.

zh.tag: 截图秒变前端代码的AI工具
zh.what: 这是一个利用AI将截图、设计稿、Figma设计甚至屏幕录制转换为干净、可运行的前端代码（如HTML/Tailwind/React/Vue）的工具。用户只需上传图片或录制视频，即可获得对应的功能原型或代码实现。

产品经理或设计师验证UI概念，无需手动编写代码
