en.tag: Turn screenshots into clean frontend code with AI
en.what: This is a tool that uses AI to convert screenshots, mockups, Figma designs, and even screen recordings into clean, functional frontend code (e.g., HTML/Tailwind/React/Vue). Users upload an image or recording and get a working prototype or code implementation.
en.content: The repo includes a React/Vite frontend and a FastAPI backend, supporting multiple stacks (HTML+Tailwind, React+Tailwind, Vue+Tailwind, etc.) and integrating several AI models (e.g., Gemini, GPT, Claude) for code generation and image processing.
en.stack: Primarily Python (FastAPI) backend with React/Vite frontend, relying on AI model APIs from OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and Replicate for image generation/editing.
en.hot: With 75.5K stars and +326 today, this tool is popular for its intuitive 'screenshot-to-code' capability, significantly lowering the barrier for frontend development, especially for rapid prototyping.
uses: Frontend developers quickly convert design mockups or screenshots into usable HTML/CSS/React code
Product managers or designers validate UI concepts without manually writing code
Educational settings for teaching frontend development by visually demonstrating code generation

zh.tag: AI 代理技能安全扫描器，安装前检测漏洞与恶意模式
zh.what: SkillSpector 是一个安全扫描器，用于检测 AI 代理技能中的漏洞、恶意模式和风险。它支持扫描 Claude Code、Codex 和 MCP 技能，帮助用户判断技能是否安全可安装。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Python 包、命令行工具、文档和扩展指南，提供多格式输入扫描、两阶段分析（静态+LLM）、实时漏洞查询、多种输出格式和风险评分等功能。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.12+，使用 AST 分析、YARA 签名、OSV.dev API 等，可选集成 LLM 进行语义评估，支持 SARIF 报告输出。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 代理技能生态爆发，安全问题凸显，SkillSpector 填补了技能安全扫描的空白，由 NVIDIA 背书，star 数迅速增长至 1.6 万。
uses: 开发者在安装第三方 AI 技能前，快速验证其安全性
安全团队集成到 CI/CD 流程，自动扫描技能仓库
AI 代理用户评估 Claude Code、Codex 等技能的可信度

en.tag: Security scanner for AI agent skills, detecting vulnerabilities before install
en.what: SkillSpector is a security scanner that detects vulnerabilities, malicious patterns, and risks in AI agent skills. It supports scanning skills for Claude Code, Codex, and MCP, helping users decide if a skill is safe to install.
en.content: The repository contains a Python package, CLI tool, documentation, and extension guides, offering multi-format input scanning, two-stage analysis (static + LLM), live vulnerability lookups, multiple output formats, and risk scoring.
en.stack: Built on Python 3.12+, uses AST analysis, YARA signatures, OSV.dev API, optional LLM semantic evaluation, and supports SARIF report output.
en.hot: As the AI agent skill ecosystem explodes, security concerns rise; SkillSpector fills the gap for skill scanning, backed by NVIDIA, with stars quickly growing to 16k.
uses: Developers quickly verify safety before installing third-party AI skills
Security teams integrate into CI/CD to automatically scan skill repos
AI agent users assess trustworthiness of skills for Claude Code, Codex, etc.

zh.tag: 数学视频动画引擎，3Blue1Brown 出品
zh.what: Manim 是一个用于创建精确编程动画的引擎，专为制作解释性数学视频而设计。它由 3Blue1Brown 的作者开发，用于制作其 YouTube 视频中的动画。
zh.content: 仓库包含 ManimGL 的源代码，包括核心动画模块、场景类、图形对象和渲染器。还提供了示例场景和文档。

视频创作者：为科普内容添加精确的数学动画
开发者：学习或扩展动画引擎，定制自己的数学可视化

en.tag: Animation engine for explanatory math videos by 3Blue1Brown
en.what: Manim is an engine for precise programmatic animations, designed for creating explanatory math videos. It was developed by the author of 3Blue1Brown for animating those videos.
en.content: The repository contains the source code for ManimGL, including core animation modules, scene classes, mobjects, and renderers. It also includes example scenes and documentation.
en.stack: Built on Python 3.10+, with dependencies on FFmpeg, OpenGL, and optional LaTeX. Pango is required on Linux.

Video creators: add precise math animations to science content
Developers: learn or extend the animation engine for custom math visualizations

zh.tag: 全自动去除语言模型审查的优化工具
zh.what: Heretic 是一个无需昂贵后训练即可移除 Transformer 语言模型审查（安全对齐）的工具。它结合方向消融（abliteration）与基于 TPE 的参数优化器，自动寻找高质量消融参数，同时最小化拒绝次数和与原始模型的 KL 散度，从而保留模型智能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Python 实现、命令行界面、自动优化流程、支持多种模型架构（稠密、MoE、混合如 Qwen3.5），并提供示例配置和基准测试结果。
zh.stack: 基于 Python，依赖 PyTorch、Transformers、Optuna（TPE 优化器）等，实现方向消融和参数优化。
zh.hot: 2.87 万星标，日增 150，登上日榜第 6。它让非专家也能一键去除模型审查，且效果媲美人工调优，引发广泛关注。
uses: AI 研究人员和开发者，希望快速去除模型审查而不损失性能。
对模型安全对齐机制感兴趣，想探索方向消融技术的实践者。
需要定制模型行为、去除内容限制的普通用户，无需深入理解内部原理。

en.tag: Fully automatic censorship removal for language models via TPE-based optimization
en.what: Heretic is a tool that removes censorship (safety alignment) from transformer-based language models without expensive post-training. It combines directional ablation (abliteration) with a TPE-based parameter optimizer to automatically find high-quality parameters that minimize refusals and KL divergence from the original model, preserving intelligence.
en.content: The repository contains a full Python implementation, CLI, automatic optimization pipeline, support for dense, MoE, and hybrid models (e.g., Qwen3.5), along with example configs and benchmark results.
en.stack: Built with Python, leveraging PyTorch, Transformers, and Optuna for TPE-based optimization, implementing directional ablation.
en.hot: With 28.7k stars and +150 daily, ranking #6 on the daily trend, it enables non-experts to decensor models with one command, rivaling manual abliteration, sparking wide interest.
uses: AI researchers and developers seeking to remove model censorship quickly without performance loss.
Practitioners interested in safety alignment mechanisms and directional ablation techniques.
General users who need to customize model behavior or remove content restrictions without deep technical knowledge.

zh.tag: 用编码智能体剪辑视频，全开源

教程制作者：将原始录屏自动剪辑成带字幕和调色的成品教程。

Tutorial makers: turn raw screen recordings into finished tutorials with subtitles and color grading.
Developers: automate video pipelines with coding agents, customizing ffmpeg chains and animations.

en.what: draw.io is a JavaScript-based client-side editor for general diagramming, supporting flowcharts, network diagrams, UML, mind maps, and more. It runs entirely in the browser without a backend, and is also available as a desktop app.
en.content: The repository contains the full editor source code, including the frontend UI, shape libraries, templates, and icon sets. It also provides a Docker image, desktop version, and deployable WAR files.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, built on the mxGraph library. Supports modern browsers and integrates various third-party libraries (all Apache 2.0 compatible).
en.hot: Gained 153 stars this week, ranking #13 on the trend list. As a long-standing open-source diagramming tool, it receives steady updates, has a large user base, and enjoys a solid reputation.
uses: Software developers drawing architecture diagrams, flowcharts, and UML diagrams
Product managers and designers creating wireframes and prototypes
Educators making instructional diagrams and mind maps
Enterprise teams needing a self-hosted diagramming solution

zh.tag: 自托管监控工具，界面美观，功能强大
zh.what: Uptime Kuma 是一个易于使用的自托管监控工具，用于监控 HTTP(s)、TCP、Ping、DNS 等服务的在线状态。它提供美观、响应式的界面，并支持多种通知方式，如 Telegram、Discord 等。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的监控工具源代码，包括前端界面（Vue.js）、后端服务（Node.js）、Docker 部署配置，以及多语言翻译文件和通知组件。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript，前端基于 Vue.js，后端使用 Node.js，支持 Docker 部署，并集成了多种通知服务。
zh.hot: 拥有超过 9 万 star，因其自托管、开源免费且功能丰富而广受欢迎，今日新增 51 星，持续活跃。

需要监控多个网站或 API 并希望自定义通知方式的用户
对数据隐私敏感，希望数据完全掌握在自己手中的用户

en.tag: A fancy self-hosted monitoring tool with a beautiful UI
en.what: Uptime Kuma is an easy-to-use self-hosted monitoring tool for tracking the uptime of HTTP(s), TCP, Ping, DNS, and other services. It features a fancy, reactive UI and supports notifications via Telegram, Discord, and 90+ other services.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the monitoring tool, including the frontend UI (Vue.js), backend service (Node.js), Docker deployment configs, and translation files and notification components.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, with a Vue.js frontend and Node.js backend, Docker deployment support, and integration with numerous notification services.
en.hot: With over 90k stars, it's popular for being self-hosted, open-source, and feature-rich, gaining 51 stars today and remaining highly active.

Users who need to monitor multiple websites or APIs and want customizable notifications
Users who are privacy-conscious and want full control over their data

zh.tag: 超高效消息流平台，Rust 实现，主打极速与持久化
zh.what: Apache Iggy 是一个用 Rust 编写的持久化消息流平台，旨在提供极致的性能和效率。它支持流、主题、分区和消费者组，可实现高吞吐、低延迟的消息传递，并具备数据持久化能力。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 核心服务器、命令行客户端（iggy-cli）、多种语言的 SDK（Rust、JavaScript、Python、Java、.NET），以及示例和文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，基于 Tokio 异步运行时，支持 TCP 和 QUIC 传输协议，并利用 Sled 或内存存储作为持久化后端。
zh.hot: 本周新增 194 星，总星数达 4792，位列 GitHub Trending Rust 周榜第一。其“激光速度”的定位和 Apache 背书吸引了大量关注，且多语言 SDK 降低了使用门槛。
uses: 需要高吞吐、低延迟消息传递的实时数据管道和事件驱动架构。
作为微服务间通信的可靠消息中间件，替代 Kafka 或 RabbitMQ 的轻量级选择。
对数据持久化和流处理有严格要求的物联网、金融或游戏后端场景。

en.tag: Hyper-efficient persistent message streaming platform in Rust, laser-fast
en.what: Apache Iggy is a persistent message streaming platform written in Rust, designed for extreme performance and efficiency. It supports streams, topics, partitions, and consumer groups, enabling high-throughput, low-latency messaging with data persistence.
en.content: The repository contains the Rust core server, a CLI client (iggy-cli), SDKs for multiple languages (Rust, JavaScript, Python, Java, .NET), plus examples and documentation.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, built on the Tokio async runtime, supports TCP and QUIC transport protocols, and uses Sled or in-memory storage for persistence.
en.hot: Gained 194 stars this week, reaching 4,792 total, ranking #1 on GitHub Trending Rust weekly. Its 'laser speed' positioning and Apache backing attract attention, and multi-language SDKs lower the adoption barrier.
uses: Real-time data pipelines and event-driven architectures requiring high throughput and low latency.
A lightweight alternative to Kafka or RabbitMQ for reliable messaging between microservices.
IoT, financial, or gaming backends with strict requirements for data persistence and stream processing.

zh.tag: Rust 即时模式 GUI 库，跨 Web 与原生
zh.what: egui 是一个用 Rust 编写的即时模式 GUI 库，旨在成为最简单易用的 Rust GUI 解决方案。它支持 Web、原生桌面以及游戏引擎集成，让开发者能够快速构建交互界面。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心库 egui、官方框架 eframe、示例代码、集成指南及文档。核心 API 提供布局、控件、绘图等功能，并支持主题切换。
zh.stack: 纯 Rust 实现，无 unsafe 代码；依赖少，可编译到 WebAssembly，支持与游戏引擎集成。
zh.hot: 本周新增 216 星，总星数达 30.4k，位居 Rust 周榜第七。其易用性和跨平台能力吸引了大量 Rust 开发者。
uses: Rust 开发者希望快速构建桌面或 Web 应用界面
游戏引擎开发者需要内置调试工具或编辑器 UI
需要轻量级 GUI 且避免复杂框架的嵌入式或工具开发

en.tag: Easy-to-use immediate mode GUI library in Rust for web and native
en.what: egui is an immediate mode GUI library written in Rust, aiming to be the easiest-to-use GUI library for Rust. It runs on web, natively, and inside game engines, enabling rapid development of interactive interfaces.
en.content: The repository contains the core egui library, the official eframe framework, examples, integration guides, and documentation. The core API offers layout, widgets, painting, and theme switching.
en.stack: Pure Rust, no unsafe code; minimal dependencies, compiles to WebAssembly, and integrates with game engines.
en.hot: Gained 216 stars this week, reaching 30.4k total, ranking 7th on Rust weekly. Its ease of use and cross-platform capability attract many Rust developers.
uses: Rust developers wanting to quickly build desktop or web app UIs
Game engine developers needing built-in debug tools or editor UI
Embedded or tool development requiring a lightweight GUI without complex frameworks

zh.tag: 为无服务器计算打造的安全快速微型虚拟机
zh.what: Firecracker 是一种开源虚拟化技术，专为创建和管理安全、多租户的容器及函数服务而设计。它通过轻量级虚拟机（microVM）结合硬件虚拟化的安全隔离与容器的速度灵活性，为无服务器计算提供高效运行环境。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Firecracker 的虚拟化监视器（VMM）核心代码，基于 KVM 创建和运行 microVM，并附有构建、测试、运行及生产环境配置的文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言开发，依赖 Linux KVM 虚拟化技术，支持在 Unix/Linux 系统上通过 Docker 构建。
zh.hot: Firecracker 由 AWS 开发并开源，支撑 AWS Lambda 和 Fargate 等核心服务，凭借极低开销和高安全性在无服务器领域广受关注，目前已有 36k+ stars。
uses: 无服务器平台开发者：需要安全、快速启动的微VM来运行函数或容器工作负载。
容器运行时集成：如 Kata Containers 等，利用 Firecracker 提供更强的隔离性。
云基础设施团队：构建多租户环境，降低资源开销并提高硬件利用率。

en.tag: Secure and fast microVMs for serverless computing
en.what: Firecracker is an open-source virtualization technology purpose-built for creating and managing secure, multi-tenant container and function-based services. It runs workloads in lightweight microVMs that combine hardware virtualization security with container speed and flexibility, enabling efficient serverless computing.
en.content: The repository contains the core VMM code of Firecracker, which uses KVM to create and run microVMs, along with documentation for building, testing, running, and production host setup.
en.stack: Developed primarily in Rust, relies on Linux KVM for virtualization, and can be built on Unix/Linux systems with Docker.
en.hot: Developed by AWS and open-sourced, Firecracker powers AWS Lambda and Fargate, gaining popularity for its minimal overhead and high security in serverless computing, with 36k+ stars.
uses: Serverless platform developers: need secure, fast-booting microVMs for function or container workloads.
Container runtime integrators: such as Kata Containers, leveraging Firecracker for stronger isolation.
Cloud infrastructure teams: building multi-tenant environments to reduce overhead and increase hardware utilization.

zh.tag: 开源 Loom 替代品，美观可分享的屏幕录制工具
zh.what: Cap 是一款开源的屏幕录制工具，旨在替代 Loom。它提供快速录制、本地编辑、即时分享链接、评论、字幕、分析、团队工作区等功能，并支持自定义域名、S3 存储和完全自托管。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面应用（macOS/Windows）、Web 仪表盘、编辑器等组件，支持即时模式和工作室模式两种录制方式。
zh.stack: 桌面应用使用 Rust 和 Tauri 构建，前端可能涉及 Web 技术，支持 S3 兼容存储。
zh.hot: 作为 Loom 的开源替代品，Cap 提供数据所有权和自托管选项，吸引了大量关注，今日新增 121 星，总星数超过 2.1 万。
uses: 产品演示、教程和客户更新等需要屏幕录制的场景
团队异步协作，如代码审查、设计反馈和异步站会
注重数据隐私和自托管的企业用户

en.tag: Open source Loom alternative for beautiful, shareable screen recordings
en.what: Cap is an open-source screen recording tool designed as a Loom alternative. It offers fast recording, polished local editing, instant share links, comments, transcripts, analytics, team workspaces, custom domains, custom S3 storage, and full self-hosting.
en.content: The repository includes desktop apps for macOS/Windows, a web dashboard, and an editor, supporting both Instant Mode and Studio Mode for recording.
en.stack: Desktop apps are built with Rust and Tauri, frontend likely uses web technologies, and it supports S3-compatible storage.
en.hot: As an open-source Loom alternative, Cap attracts attention with data ownership and self-hosting options, gaining 121 stars today and over 21k total.
uses: For product demos, tutorials, and client updates requiring screen recordings
For async team collaboration like code reviews, design feedback, and async standups
For enterprises prioritizing data privacy and self-hosting

zh.tag: 基于 aircrack-ng 的图形化 WiFi 安全审计工具
zh.what: Airgorah 是一款 WiFi 安全审计软件，能够捕获附近的 WiFi 流量、发现连接到接入点的客户端、执行去认证攻击、捕获握手包并破解接入点密码。它基于 aircrack-ng 工具套件，使用 Rust 编写，并提供 GTK4 图形界面。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的核心逻辑、GTK4 图形界面（crates/gui）、以及通过 polkit 提权的特权代理（airgorah-agent）。提供安装和使用文档（wiki），并附带应用图标和截图。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言，图形部分基于 GTK4（gtk4-rs）。依赖 aircrack-ng 工具套件，需要支持监听模式和包注入的无线网卡。
zh.hot: 本周新增 1180 星，总星数达 3001，位列 GitHub Trending（Rust）周榜第二。其图形化界面降低了 WiFi 安全审计的门槛，且基于 Rust 性能与安全性俱佳，吸引了大量安全爱好者和研究者。
uses: 网络安全研究人员：用于测试自家 WiFi 网络的安全性，发现漏洞。
渗透测试人员：在授权测试中快速捕获握手包并破解密码。
Rust 开发者：学习如何使用 GTK4 构建跨平台 GUI 应用。
WiFi 爱好者：探索无线网络协议与安全机制。

en.tag: GUI WiFi security auditing tool based on aircrack-ng
en.what: Airgorah is a WiFi security auditing software that captures nearby WiFi traffic, discovers clients connected to access points, performs deauthentication attacks, captures handshakes, and cracks access point passwords. It is based on the aircrack-ng suite, written in Rust, and features a GTK4 GUI.
en.content: The repository contains Rust core logic, a GTK4 GUI (crates/gui), and a privileged agent (airgorah-agent) that elevates via polkit. It includes installation and usage documentation (wiki), along with app icons and screenshots.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, with GUI based on GTK4 (gtk4-rs). It depends on the aircrack-ng suite and requires a wireless card supporting monitor mode and packet injection.
en.hot: Gained 1,180 stars this week, reaching 3,001 total, ranking #2 on GitHub Trending (Rust) weekly. Its GUI lowers the barrier to WiFi security auditing, and being Rust-based offers performance and safety, attracting security enthusiasts and researchers.
uses: Security researchers: to test the security of their own WiFi networks and discover vulnerabilities.
Penetration testers: to quickly capture handshakes and crack passwords during authorized tests.
Rust developers: to learn how to build cross-platform GUI apps with GTK4.
WiFi enthusiasts: to explore wireless protocols and security mechanisms.

zh.tag: 开源智能间隔重复记忆卡软件
zh.what: Anki 是一款基于间隔重复算法的智能记忆卡软件，帮助用户高效记忆。它通过科学安排复习时间，提高长期记忆保留率。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Anki 桌面版的全部源代码，包括核心算法、用户界面、同步功能等。代码结构清晰，包含文档和贡献指南。

zh.hot: 作为广受欢迎的记忆工具，Anki 拥有超过 3 万 star，今日新增 33 个，持续受到学习者青睐。
uses: 语言学习者：利用间隔重复高效记忆单词和短语。
医学生和法学生：记忆大量专业术语和知识点。
终身学习者：复习任何需要长期记忆的内容。
开发者：学习 Rust 和大型项目架构的绝佳案例。

en.tag: Open-source smart spaced repetition flashcard software
en.what: Anki is a smart flashcard program that uses spaced repetition to help users memorize effectively. It schedules reviews at optimal intervals to enhance long-term retention.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code for Anki's computer version, including core algorithms, user interface, and synchronization features. It is well-organized with documentation and contribution guidelines.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, with TypeScript and Python, relying on the Qt framework.
en.hot: As a widely-used memorization tool, Anki has over 30k stars, with 33 added today, continuing to attract learners.
uses: Language learners: efficiently memorize vocabulary and phrases with spaced repetition.
Medical and law students: memorize vast amounts of terminology and knowledge points.
Lifelong learners: review any content that requires long-term retention.
Developers: an excellent case study for learning Rust and large-scale project architecture.

zh.tag: 开源2D创作工具，节点式图形引擎
zh.what: Graphite 是一个免费开源的 2D 矢量与光栅图形引擎，提供非破坏性编辑工作流，结合图层合成与节点式生成设计。它旨在成为集平面设计、数字绘画、动态图形于一体的全能型创作工具箱，目前处于 alpha 阶段。
zh.content: 仓库包含编辑器前端、节点图核心、渲染引擎及文档；代码以 Rust 编写，提供网页版编辑器，并规划了照片编辑、动态图形、数字绘画等模块。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言，基于节点图架构，可能涉及 WebAssembly 和图形渲染库。
zh.hot: 凭借 2.7 万星标和社区驱动开发，Graphite 作为开源替代品吸引了设计师和开发者，其节点式非破坏性工作流和游戏引擎式架构备受关注。
uses: 平面设计师和插画师寻找免费开源的设计工具，可替代商业软件。
对节点式生成艺术和程序化设计感兴趣的创意编程爱好者。
希望参与开源图形引擎开发、贡献代码或文档的 Rust 开发者。

en.tag: Open-source 2D content creation with node-based procedural graphics engine
en.what: Graphite is a free, open-source 2D vector and raster graphics engine offering a fully nondestructive editing workflow that combines layer-based compositing with node-based generative design. It aims to become an all-in-one toolbox for graphic design, digital art, and motion graphics, currently in alpha.
en.content: The repository contains the editor frontend, node graph core, rendering engine, and documentation; code is written in Rust, with a web-based editor and planned modules for photo editing, motion graphics, digital painting, etc.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, built around a node graph architecture, likely using WebAssembly and graphics rendering libraries.
en.hot: With 27k stars and community-driven development, Graphite attracts designers and developers as an open-source alternative, praised for its node-based nondestructive workflow and game-engine-like architecture.
uses: Graphic designers and illustrators seeking a free, open-source alternative to commercial design software.
Creative coders interested in node-based generative art and procedural design.
Rust developers wanting to contribute to an open-source graphics engine project.

zh.tag: 基于 GPUI 的 Rust 跨平台桌面 UI 组件库
zh.what: GPUI Kit 是一个用于构建高性能跨平台桌面应用的 Rust 框架，提供 60+ 生产级 UI 组件和完整的数据、布局、编辑能力。它基于 Zed 编辑器使用的 GPUI 构建，并支持 JavaScript 扩展。
zh.content: 仓库包含三个子 crate：gpui-base（无样式行为、状态和基础设施）、gpui-shell（JavaScript 扩展）、gpui-component（完整样式化 UI 系统）。主 crate 重新导出所有层，应用只需依赖 gpui-kit 即可。
zh.stack: 基于 Rust 和 GPUI（Zed 编辑器使用的 GPU 加速 UI 框架），支持 macOS、Windows、Linux，集成 Tree-sitter、LSP 等。
zh.hot: 凭借 13.9K stars 和日增 179 登顶 Rust 日榜，因为它是首个将 GPUI 从 Zed 中解耦并打包成通用组件库的项目，填补了 Rust 桌面 UI 生态的空白。
uses: Rust 开发者希望用 Rust 构建跨平台桌面应用，并追求高性能和原生体验。
需要数据表格、虚拟列表、代码编辑器等复杂组件的桌面应用开发场景。
希望复用 Zed 编辑器 UI 能力但不想直接依赖 Zed 的团队。
对 GPUI 感兴趣，想学习其架构或基于 gpui-base 自定义 UI 系统的开发者。

en.tag: Rust desktop UI component library built on GPUI for cross-platform apps
en.what: GPUI Kit is a Rust framework for building high-performance cross-platform desktop apps, offering 60+ production-ready UI components and full data, layout, and editing capabilities. It is built on GPUI, the UI framework used by Zed editor, and supports JavaScript extensions.
en.content: The repo contains three sub-crates: gpui-base (unstyled behavior, state, and infrastructure), gpui-shell (JavaScript extensions), and gpui-component (complete styled UI system). The main crate re-exports all layers, so apps only need to depend on gpui-kit.
en.stack: Built on Rust and GPUI (GPU-accelerated UI framework used by Zed editor), supports macOS, Windows, Linux, integrates Tree-sitter, LSP, etc.
en.hot: With 13.9K stars and +179 today, it tops the Rust daily chart as the first project to decouple GPUI from Zed and package it as a general-purpose component library, filling a gap in the Rust desktop UI ecosystem.
uses: Rust developers who want to build cross-platform desktop apps with high performance and native feel.
Desktop app development requiring complex components like data tables, virtual lists, and code editors.
Teams that want to reuse Zed's UI capabilities without depending on Zed directly.
Developers interested in GPUI, learning its architecture, or building custom UI systems on gpui-base.

zh.tag: Git 兼容、简单强大的版本控制系统
zh.what: Jujutsu 是一款为软件项目设计的版本控制系统，旨在简化代码复制、变更跟踪和发布流程。它从底层设计上就注重易用性，无论新手还是经验丰富的开发者，都能轻松上手。其独特之处在于将用户界面和版本控制算法与存储系统解耦，从而支持多种后端存储。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Jujutsu 源代码、文档、安装指南、教程和开发路线图。项目使用 Rust 编写，并包含用于构建和测试的配置。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言开发，依赖 Git 作为存储层，但扩展了自定义存储以保存书签等元数据。
zh.hot: 本周新增 185 颗星，总星数达 31,429，在 GitHub Trending 周榜（Rust）中位列第 13。其 Git 兼容性和创新的设计吸引了大量关注。
uses: 适合希望简化版本控制工作流的开发者，尤其是那些对 Git 复杂性感到困扰的用户。
适用于需要与现有 Git 工具链兼容，同时探索更高效 VCS 理念的团队。
对于研究版本控制系统的学生和研究者，Jujutsu 提供了独特的架构参考。

en.tag: A Git-compatible VCS that is both simple and powerful
en.what: Jujutsu is a version control system for software projects, designed to simplify copying code, tracking changes, and publishing changes. It is built from the ground up to be easy to use for both novices and experienced developers. Its key innovation is decoupling the user interface and version control algorithms from storage systems, enabling multiple backends.
en.content: The repository contains the full Jujutsu source code, documentation, installation guides, tutorials, and a development roadmap. The project is written in Rust and includes build and test configurations.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Rust, it uses Git repositories as a storage layer but extends with custom storage for bookmarks and other metadata.
en.hot: With 185 new stars this week and a total of 31,429, it ranks #13 on the GitHub Trending weekly (Rust). Its Git compatibility and innovative design have attracted significant attention.
uses: For developers seeking a simplified version control workflow, especially those frustrated by Git's complexity.
For teams needing compatibility with existing Git tools while exploring more efficient VCS concepts.
For students and researchers studying version control systems, Jujutsu offers a unique architectural reference.

zh.tag: 跨平台安卓去臃肿工具，提升隐私与性能
zh.what: 这是一个用 Rust 编写的跨平台图形界面工具，通过 ADB 帮助用户移除非 root 安卓设备上的无用系统应用，从而改善隐私、安全性和电池寿命。它是 UAD 项目的独立分支，专注于去除不必要的系统应用以提升效率。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 源码、资源文件（如应用列表 JSON）、截图和文档（Wiki）。主要组件包括核心逻辑、GUI 界面和更新检查模块。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言，依赖 ADB（Android Debug Bridge）与设备通信，并可能使用 GUI 框架（如 egui 或 GTK）。
zh.hot: 本周新增 112 星，总星数 9072，位列 Rust 周榜第 14。它满足了用户对隐私和性能优化的需求，且无需 root，界面友好。
uses: 适合希望移除安卓手机预装应用、提升隐私和电池寿命的普通用户。
适合技术爱好者或开发者，希望深入了解系统应用并自定义去臃肿列表。
适合需要批量管理多台安卓设备的企业或测试人员。

en.tag: Cross-platform Android debloater for privacy & performance
en.what: A cross-platform GUI tool written in Rust that uses ADB to debloat non-rooted Android devices by removing unnecessary system apps, improving privacy, security, and battery life. It is a detached fork of the UAD project.
en.content: The repository contains Rust source code, resources (like app list JSON), screenshots, and documentation (Wiki). Key components include core logic, GUI, and update checker.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, relies on ADB for device communication, and likely uses a GUI framework such as egui or GTK.
en.hot: Gained 112 stars this week, total 9072, ranking #14 on Rust weekly. It meets users' needs for privacy and performance optimization without root, with a user-friendly GUI.
uses: For regular users who want to remove bloatware to improve privacy and battery life.
For tech enthusiasts or developers who want to customize the debloat list.
For enterprises or testers managing multiple Android devices.

zh.tag: 跨 50+ 编程工具的 AI 技能统一管理桌面应用
zh.what: Skills Manager 是一个轻量级桌面应用，用于统一管理、同步和组织 AI 代理的技能（skills），支持 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Copilot、Gemini CLI 等 50 多种编程工具。它提供一个集中的技能库，用户可以从 Git 仓库、本地文件夹、压缩包或 skills.sh 市场安装技能，并支持全局、代理、项目等多种工作区。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的桌面应用源码，提供技能库、市场浏览、全局/代理/项目工作区、备份与多设备同步等功能，并配有界面截图和概念图。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 开发，可能涉及 Tauri 或类似框架，依赖 Git 和文件系统操作，支持跨平台。
zh.hot: 本周新增 228 星，总星数达 4283，登上 GitHub Trending 周榜（Rust）第 13 名。AI 编程工具激增，跨工具管理技能的需求旺盛，该应用填补了这一空白。
uses: AI 编程工具用户：统一管理 Claude Code、Cursor 等工具的技能，避免重复配置。
开发者团队：通过备份与多设备同步，确保团队成员技能配置一致。
技能开发者：在市场中发布技能，并利用工作区测试和部署。

en.tag: A lightweight desktop app to manage, sync, and organize AI agent skills across 50+ coding tools
en.what: Skills Manager is a lightweight desktop app to manage, sync, and organize AI agent skills across 50+ coding tools like Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, and Gemini CLI. It provides a unified skill library, allowing users to install skills from Git repos, local folders, archives, or the skills.sh marketplace, with support for global, agent, and project workspaces.
en.content: The repository contains the Rust-based desktop app source code, featuring a unified skill library, marketplace browsing, global/agent/project workspaces, backup and multi-device sync, along with UI screenshots and a concept map.
en.stack: Built primarily with Rust, likely using Tauri or similar framework, with dependencies on Git and file system operations, supporting cross-platform.
en.hot: Gained 228 stars this week, reaching 4,283 total, and ranked #13 on GitHub Trending (Rust) weekly. With the proliferation of AI coding tools, the need to manage skills across tools is high, and this app fills that gap.
uses: AI coding tool users: centrally manage skills for Claude Code, Cursor, etc., avoiding duplicate configurations.
Development teams: ensure consistent skill configurations across members via backup and multi-device sync.
Skill developers: publish skills to the marketplace and use workspaces for testing and deployment.

zh.tag: 为AI代理压缩命令输出的CLI代理，节省高达90%token
zh.what: RTK是一个高性能的CLI代理，在命令输出进入LLM上下文之前进行过滤和压缩，可减少60-90%的token消耗。它拦截shell命令，将冗长的输出转换为紧凑格式，例如将ls输出转为带文件计数的树形结构，仅保留git diff的关键变更等。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个用Rust编写的单一二进制文件，支持100多种命令，如ls、cat、grep、git、cargo test等。还提供安装脚本、文档（包括架构说明）和多语言README。
zh.stack: 纯Rust实现，零依赖，单一二进制文件，开销小于10ms。
zh.hot: 随着AI编程助手普及，token成本成为痛点，RTK能大幅削减成本，且安装简单、性能高，因此迅速走红。
uses: 使用Claude Code、Codex等AI编程助手的开发者，希望减少token消耗和费用。
需要处理大量命令行输出的DevOps工程师，通过压缩日志和状态信息提高效率。
对Rust高性能工具感兴趣的开发者，可学习其架构和实现。

en.tag: CLI proxy that compresses command output for AI agents, cutting token usage by up to 90%
en.what: RTK is a high-performance CLI proxy that filters and compresses command output before it reaches the LLM context, reducing token consumption by 60-90%. It intercepts shell commands and converts verbose output into compact formats, such as turning ls output into a tree with file counts and keeping only essential changes from git diff.
en.content: The repository contains a single Rust binary supporting over 100 commands like ls, cat, grep, git, cargo test, etc. It also includes installation scripts, documentation (including architecture), and multilingual READMEs.
en.stack: Pure Rust implementation, zero dependencies, single binary, overhead under 10ms.
en.hot: As AI coding assistants become popular, token costs are a pain point. RTK significantly cuts costs, is easy to install, and performs well, hence its rapid rise.
uses: Developers using AI coding assistants like Claude Code or Codex who want to reduce token usage and costs.
DevOps engineers dealing with large command outputs, improving efficiency by compressing logs and status info.
Developers interested in high-performance Rust tools, who can learn from its architecture and implementation.

zh.tag: 一站式邮件与协作服务器，安全可扩展
zh.what: Stalwart 是一个用 Rust 编写的开源邮件与协作服务器，支持 IMAP、JMAP、SMTP、CalDAV、CardDAV 和 WebDAV 等协议。它旨在提供安全、快速、健壮且可扩展的邮件服务，适合自托管用户和企业部署。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的服务器实现，涵盖邮件收发、日历、联系人、文件同步等功能模块，并附有文档、安装指南和 CI 配置。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言，依赖 Tokio 等异步运行时，支持 SQLite、PostgreSQL 等数据库后端，并集成多种加密与认证库。
zh.hot: 凭借全面的协议支持和 Rust 的高性能，Stalwart 在自托管社区中备受关注，14.4k 星标且日增 27，登上 Rust 趋势榜第二。
uses: 自托管用户：希望完全掌控邮件数据，避免依赖第三方服务。
企业 IT 部门：需要集成邮件、日历、联系人等协作功能的统一服务器。
开发者：对 Rust 邮件服务器实现感兴趣，或希望扩展定制功能。

en.tag: All-in-one mail & collaboration server, secure and scalable
en.what: Stalwart is an open-source mail and collaboration server written in Rust, supporting protocols like IMAP, JMAP, SMTP, CalDAV, CardDAV, and WebDAV. It aims to provide secure, fast, robust, and scalable email services for self-hosters and enterprises.
en.content: The repository contains a full server implementation covering email, calendar, contacts, file sync, along with docs, installation guides, and CI configs.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, using async runtimes like Tokio, supporting SQLite/PostgreSQL backends, and integrating crypto and auth libraries.
en.hot: With comprehensive protocol support and Rust's performance, Stalwart gains traction in self-hosting community, 14.4k stars and +27 today, #2 on Rust trending.
uses: Self-hosters who want full control over email data and avoid third-party services.
Enterprise IT teams needing a unified server for email, calendar, contacts, and collaboration.
Developers interested in Rust mail server implementations or extending custom features.

zh.tag: 用 Rust 实现的 Python 3 解释器
zh.what: RustPython 是一个用 Rust 语言编写的 Python 3 解释器，支持 CPython >= 3.14.0 的语法和功能。它旨在将 Python 的易用性与 Rust 的性能和安全性相结合，可作为独立程序运行，也可嵌入到其他应用中。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的解释器源码、标准库的 Rust 实现（部分使用 Python 标准库的镜像）、交互式 shell、WebAssembly 演示，以及构建和测试所需的配置。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言，依赖 Cargo 进行构建，支持 WebAssembly 编译，并利用 symlinks 管理 Python 库。
zh.hot: RustPython 在 GitHub 上拥有 22k+ 星标，因其作为 Rust 生态中成熟的 Python 解释器而备受关注，展示了 Rust 在系统编程之外的广泛应用。
uses: 对 Rust 与 Python 结合感兴趣的语言实现者或学习者
需要在 Rust 项目中嵌入 Python 脚本的开发者
希望探索 Python 解释器内部机制的研究人员

en.tag: A Python 3 interpreter written in Rust
en.what: RustPython is a Python 3 interpreter written in Rust, supporting syntax and features of CPython >= 3.14.0. It aims to combine Python's ease of use with Rust's performance and safety, and can be run as a standalone program or embedded in other applications.
en.content: The repository contains the full interpreter source code, Rust implementations of the standard library (with some Python standard library mirrors), an interactive shell, a WebAssembly demo, and configuration for building and testing.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, built with Cargo, supports WebAssembly compilation, and uses symlinks to manage Python libraries.
en.hot: With 22k+ stars on GitHub, RustPython is notable as a mature Python interpreter in the Rust ecosystem, demonstrating Rust's versatility beyond systems programming.
uses: Language implementers or learners interested in combining Rust and Python
Developers needing to embed Python scripting in Rust projects
Researchers wishing to explore the internals of Python interpreters

zh.tag: 一键切换 Antigravity 账号的桌面管理工具
zh.what: Antigravity Tools 是一款专为开发者和 AI 爱好者设计的桌面应用，用于管理 Antigravity 账号并实现一键无缝切换。它还能将 Web 端 Session 转化为标准 API，充当本地 AI 中转站。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Tauri v2 + React 前端和 Rust 后端，提供图形界面进行账号管理、协议转换和请求调度。
zh.stack: 基于 Tauri v2、React 和 Rust，使用现代桌面应用框架，支持跨平台。
zh.hot: 凭借 3 万+ Star 和日增 84 的热度，它解决了 AI 账号管理的痛点，提供高效便捷的本地中转方案。
uses: 需要管理多个 Antigravity 账号的开发者，可一键切换，提升效率。
希望将 Web Session 转为 API 的 AI 爱好者，用于本地集成和调用。
追求低成本、高稳定 AI 中转服务的用户，可结合赞助商服务使用。

en.tag: One-click Antigravity account manager & switcher desktop app
en.what: Antigravity Tools is a desktop app for developers and AI enthusiasts to manage Antigravity accounts and switch between them seamlessly with one click. It also converts web sessions into standard APIs, acting as a local AI relay.
en.content: The repo contains a Tauri v2 + React frontend and Rust backend, offering a GUI for account management, protocol conversion, and request routing.
en.stack: Built with Tauri v2, React, and Rust, leveraging a modern desktop framework for cross-platform support.
en.hot: With over 30k stars and 84 daily additions, it addresses AI account management pain points with an efficient local relay solution.
uses: Developers managing multiple Antigravity accounts can switch with one click for efficiency.
AI enthusiasts wanting to convert web sessions into APIs for local integration and calls.
Users seeking low-cost, stable AI relay services can leverage sponsor offerings.

zh.tag: Rust 生态精选资源大全，从应用到库一网打尽
zh.what: 这是一个精心整理的 Rust 代码和资源列表，旨在帮助开发者发现高质量的 Rust 项目。它按类别（如应用、开发工具、库等）组织，涵盖了从操作系统到机器学习的广泛领域。

uses: Rust 新手寻找学习资源和入门项目
开发者快速查找特定领域的 Rust 库或工具
贡献者希望提交自己或他人的优秀 Rust 项目

en.tag: The definitive curated list of Rust code and resources, covering apps to libraries
en.what: A curated list of Rust code and resources, helping developers discover high-quality Rust projects. It is organized by categories such as applications, development tools, and libraries, covering a wide range of fields from operating systems to machine learning.
en.content: The repository contains a README with categorized sections like Applications, Development tools, and Libraries, listing relevant project links under each. It also includes contribution guidelines and automated checks.
en.stack: Primarily Markdown with GitHub Actions for automated validation; no specific runtime dependencies.
en.hot: As one of the most authoritative resource lists in the Rust community, nearly 60k stars continue to attract new and veteran developers, with 36 stars added today, keeping it on the daily trending list.
uses: Rust beginners looking for learning resources and starter projects
Developers quickly finding Rust libraries or tools for specific domains
Contributors who want to submit their own or others' excellent Rust projects

zh.tag: 增量解析系统，为编程工具提供语法树
zh.what: Tree-sitter 是一个解析器生成器和增量解析库，能够为源代码构建具体的语法树，并在编辑时高效更新。它旨在通用、快速、健壮且无依赖，适用于任何编程语言，即使在语法错误时也能提供有用结果。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心解析库（纯 C 编写）、Rust 和 WebAssembly 绑定，以及命令行界面，还有大量语言语法定义。
zh.stack: 核心运行时用纯 C 编写，无依赖；提供 Rust 和 WebAssembly 绑定，以及用于生成解析器的 Rust 工具。
zh.hot: 拥有 2.6 万+ 星标，是编辑器（如 Neovim、Atom）和开发工具的基础组件，本周新增 85 星，持续受到开发者关注。
uses: 文本编辑器开发者：集成增量解析，实现实时语法高亮和代码折叠。
静态分析工具开发者：利用语法树进行代码分析、重构和格式化。
语言服务器实现者：为 IDE 提供准确的语法感知功能。

en.tag: Incremental parsing system for programming tools
en.what: Tree-sitter is a parser generator tool and an incremental parsing library that builds concrete syntax trees for source files and efficiently updates them as files are edited. It aims to be general, fast, robust, and dependency-free, parsing any language and providing useful results even with syntax errors.
en.content: The repository includes the core parsing library (written in pure C), Rust and WebAssembly bindings, a command-line interface, and numerous language grammar definitions.
en.stack: The core runtime is written in pure C with no dependencies; it offers Rust and WebAssembly bindings, and a Rust-based tool for generating parsers.
en.hot: With over 26k stars, it's a foundational component for editors (e.g., Neovim, Atom) and dev tools, gaining 85 stars this week and maintaining steady developer interest.
uses: Text editor developers: integrate incremental parsing for real-time syntax highlighting and code folding.
Static analysis tool developers: leverage syntax trees for code analysis, refactoring, and formatting.
Language server implementers: provide accurate syntax-aware features for IDEs.

zh.tag: 实时服务编排与可观测性平台
zh.what: iii 是一个实时服务编排与可观测性平台，让开发者能够轻松地组合、扩展并实时监控整个技术栈中的每个服务。它通过统一的运行时表面，将队列、定时任务、HTTP、状态管理、可观测性、代理和沙箱等集成到一个系统中。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心运行时、CLI 工具、多种 SDK（如 npm、PyPI、crates.io）、Docker 镜像以及控制台界面。提供快速开始指南、添加工作节点、Agent Skills 和资源文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 开发，提供 Docker 容器化部署，支持多种语言 SDK（JavaScript、Python、Rust），并集成 Discord 社区。
zh.hot: iii 在 GitHub 上获得 18,679 星，本周新增 45 星，位列 Rust 周榜第五。它解决了服务集成碎片化问题，提供零集成的共享运行时，吸引了大量关注。
uses: 后端开发者：希望简化微服务编排和集成，减少点对点连接。
DevOps 工程师：需要实时监控和可观测性，快速定位服务问题。
AI 应用开发者：利用内置的代理和沙箱能力构建智能服务。

en.tag: Real-time service composition, extension, and observability platform
en.what: iii is a real-time service orchestration and observability platform that lets developers effortlessly compose, extend, and monitor every service in their stack in real time. It unifies queues, cron, HTTP, state, observability, agents, and sandboxes into a single live system surface.
en.content: The repository includes the core runtime, CLI tools, multiple SDKs (npm, PyPI, crates.io), Docker images, and a console UI. It provides quick start guides, adding workers, agent skills, and resource documentation.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Rust, with Docker containerization, multi-language SDKs (JavaScript, Python, Rust), and Discord community integration.
en.hot: With 18,679 stars and 45 new stars this week, iii ranks #5 on the Rust weekly trending list. It addresses service integration fragmentation with a zero-integration shared runtime, drawing significant attention.
uses: Backend developers looking to simplify microservice orchestration and reduce point-to-point integrations.
DevOps engineers needing real-time monitoring and observability to quickly diagnose service issues.
AI application developers leveraging built-in agents and sandbox capabilities for intelligent services.

zh.tag: 用 Rust 和 async 打造下一代嵌入式框架
zh.what: Embassy 是一个面向嵌入式应用开发的现代框架，利用 Rust 语言及其异步特性，让开发者能够更快地编写安全、正确且节能的嵌入式代码。它提供了硬件抽象层（HAL）、异步执行器等组件，旨在替代传统 RTOS。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Embassy 的核心库，如 embassy-time（时间管理）、embassy-executor（异步执行器），以及多个硬件抽象层（HAL），例如 embassy-stm32、embassy-nrf、embassy-rp 等，覆盖主流微控制器系列。
zh.stack: 基于 Rust 语言，使用 async/await 语法，无需动态内存分配，编译时生成状态机。支持多种微控制器架构，包括 ARM Cortex-M 和 RISC-V。
zh.hot: Embassy 凭借 Rust 的安全性和异步的高效性，成为嵌入式开发的热门选择。本周新增 44 颗星，总星数达 9800，位列 GitHub 趋势榜（Rust）第 21 名，反映出社区对现代嵌入式框架的强烈需求。
uses: 适用于希望用 Rust 开发安全、可靠嵌入式应用的开发者，尤其是对内存安全和并发性有高要求的场景。
适用于需要替代传统 RTOS 的实时系统，利用 async 实现高效的多任务处理，降低功耗。
适用于物联网设备、可穿戴设备等资源受限的嵌入式项目，追求代码简洁和性能优化。

en.tag: Next-gen embedded framework with Rust and async
en.what: Embassy is a modern framework for embedded applications, leveraging Rust and its async features to enable faster development of safe, correct, and energy-efficient embedded code. It provides hardware abstraction layers (HALs), an async executor, and more, aiming to replace traditional RTOS.
en.content: The repository contains the core Embassy libraries, such as embassy-time (time management) and embassy-executor (async executor), along with multiple HALs like embassy-stm32, embassy-nrf, embassy-rp, covering major microcontroller families.
en.stack: Built on Rust with async/await, requiring no dynamic memory allocation, transforming tasks into state machines at compile time. Supports various MCU architectures including ARM Cortex-M and RISC-V.
en.hot: Embassy is a popular choice for embedded development due to Rust's safety and async's efficiency. With 44 new stars this week and 9800 total, ranking #21 on GitHub Trending (Rust), it reflects strong community demand for modern embedded frameworks.
uses: For developers who want to build safe and reliable embedded applications in Rust, especially where memory safety and concurrency are critical.
For real-time systems that need an alternative to traditional RTOS, using async for efficient multitasking and lower power consumption.
For resource-constrained embedded projects like IoT devices and wearables, seeking concise code and optimized performance.

zh.tag: 命令行下载 App Store 的 ipa 包工具
zh.what: ipatool 是一个命令行工具，允许用户从 App Store 搜索 iOS、iPadOS、tvOS 和 visionOS 应用，并下载其 ipa 文件。它支持认证、搜索、购买和列出已购应用等操作。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的命令行工具源码，提供 auth、search、purchase、list-purchases 等子命令，支持文本和 JSON 输出格式，并附带演示 GIF 和详细文档。
zh.stack: 使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 App Store 的 API，支持 Windows、Linux 和 macOS，可通过 Homebrew 安装。
zh.hot: 该工具为开发者和安全研究人员提供了便捷的 ipa 下载方式，在 GitHub 上获得 1 万+ star，今日新增 58 个，登上日榜第 8 名。
uses: iOS 开发者需要获取 ipa 包进行测试或分析
安全研究人员分析应用包内容
需要备份或归档 App Store 应用的用户

en.tag: CLI tool to search and download ipa packages from App Store
en.what: ipatool is a command-line tool that allows users to search for iOS, iPadOS, tvOS, and visionOS apps on the App Store and download their ipa files. It supports authentication, searching, purchasing, and listing purchased apps.
en.content: The repository contains the source code of a Go-based CLI tool with subcommands like auth, search, purchase, and list-purchases, supporting text and JSON output formats, along with a demo GIF and detailed documentation.
en.stack: Developed in Go, it relies on the App Store API and supports Windows, Linux, and macOS, installable via Homebrew.
en.hot: This tool provides a convenient way for developers and security researchers to download ipa files, gaining over 10k stars on GitHub with 58 new stars today, ranking 8th on the daily trending list.
uses: iOS developers needing ipa packages for testing or analysis
Security researchers analyzing app package contents
Users who want to back up or archive App Store apps

zh.tag: 用众包提示词增强人类的开源AI框架
zh.what: Fabric 是一个开源框架，旨在通过 AI 增强人类能力。它提供模块化系统，利用众包提示词解决特定问题，可在任何地方使用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的命令行工具、提示词模式集合（patterns）、文档、示例和 REST API 服务器。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖 AI 模型 API（如 OpenAI），支持命令行和 REST API 接口。
zh.hot: 拥有 43.7k 星标，今日新增 103，因其解决了 AI 集成问题，将提示词组织为可复用模式，受到开发者追捧。
uses: 开发者希望将 AI 提示词系统化并集成到工作流中
命令行爱好者寻求高效使用 AI 的模块化工具
团队需要共享和标准化 AI 提示词以提升协作效率

en.tag: Open-source framework for augmenting humans with crowdsourced AI prompts
en.what: Fabric is an open-source framework for augmenting humans using AI. It provides a modular system for solving specific problems using a crowdsourced set of AI prompts that can be used anywhere.
en.content: The repository contains a Go-based CLI, a collection of prompt patterns, documentation, examples, and a REST API server.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, it relies on AI model APIs (e.g., OpenAI) and provides both CLI and REST API interfaces.
en.hot: With 43.7k stars and 103 added today, it's popular for solving AI integration by organizing prompts into reusable patterns, appealing to developers.
uses: Developers looking to systematize AI prompts and integrate them into workflows
CLI enthusiasts seeking modular tools for efficient AI usage
Teams needing to share and standardize AI prompts for better collaboration

zh.tag: 本地一键跑 Kubernetes 集群
zh.what: minikube 是一个在 macOS、Linux 和 Windows 上本地运行 Kubernetes 集群的工具。它的主要目标是成为本地 Kubernetes 应用开发的最佳工具，并支持所有适合的 Kubernetes 特性。
zh.content: 仓库包含 minikube 的源代码、文档、示例和 CI 配置。它提供命令行工具，支持多集群、负载均衡、仪表板、GPU 等特性，并可通过插件扩展。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Kubernetes 组件和 Docker/containerd 等容器运行时。
zh.hot: 作为 Kubernetes 官方子项目，minikube 是本地开发的标准选择，拥有超过 3.2 万 star，持续活跃。
uses: 开发者希望在本地快速搭建 Kubernetes 环境进行应用开发与测试
学习 Kubernetes 的初学者需要一个轻量级的本地集群进行实践
CI/CD 流水线需要临时启动 Kubernetes 集群进行集成测试

en.tag: Run Kubernetes locally with one command
en.what: minikube is a tool that runs a Kubernetes cluster locally on macOS, Linux, and Windows. Its primary goals are to be the best tool for local Kubernetes application development and to support all Kubernetes features that fit.
en.content: The repository contains the source code, documentation, examples, and CI configuration for minikube. It provides a CLI tool with features like multi-cluster, load balancer, dashboard, GPU support, and extensible addons.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, it depends on Kubernetes components and container runtimes like Docker and containerd.
en.hot: As an official Kubernetes subproject, minikube is the standard choice for local development, with over 32k stars and continuous activity.
uses: Developers who want to quickly set up a Kubernetes environment locally for application development and testing
Beginners learning Kubernetes who need a lightweight local cluster for hands-on practice
CI/CD pipelines that need to spin up a temporary Kubernetes cluster for integration tests

zh.tag: 可编程的异构LLM推理路由层，构建混合模型系统
zh.what: vLLM Semantic Router 是一个可编程的路由层，用于在异构 LLM 基础设施上构建 Mixture-of-Models 系统。它评估请求信号、用户偏好和应用策略，为每个请求选择或组合合适的模型路径，从而在不硬编码路由逻辑的情况下优化质量、成本、延迟、隐私和安全性。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 实现的路由器核心、安装脚本、文档站点（website/）、以及示例和配置。提供在线 Playground 和 Hugging Face 集成，支持 v0.3 Themis 等版本发布。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 vLLM 生态，可能集成 Hugging Face 模型和云/边缘计算资源。
zh.hot: 随着 LLM 应用多样化，对混合模型路由的需求增长，该仓库提供可编程路由方案，今日新增 28 星，登上 Go 趋势榜第 3 名。
uses: 需要优化 LLM 推理成本与延迟的工程团队，通过路由策略动态选择模型。
构建多模型系统（MoM）的开发者，希望根据请求内容智能组合模型输出。
关注数据隐私的企业，利用路由将敏感数据保留在本地或私有云。
研究人员探索信号驱动的路由算法，可基于此进行实验和扩展。

en.tag: Programmable routing layer for heterogeneous LLM inference to build Mixture-of-Models systems
en.what: vLLM Semantic Router is a programmable routing layer for building Mixture-of-Models systems across heterogeneous LLM infrastructure. It evaluates request signals, user preferences, and application policies to select or compose the right model path for each request, improving quality, cost, latency, privacy, and safety without hard-coding routing logic.
en.content: The repository contains the Go-based router core, installation scripts, documentation site (website/), examples, and configurations. It offers an online Playground and Hugging Face integration, with releases like v0.3 Themis.
en.stack: Developed primarily in Go, leveraging the vLLM ecosystem, with potential integrations with Hugging Face models and cloud/edge compute resources.
en.hot: As LLM applications diversify, the need for Mixture-of-Models routing grows; this repo offers a programmable solution, gaining 28 stars today and ranking #3 on Go trending.
uses: Engineering teams optimizing LLM inference cost and latency by dynamically routing requests to appropriate models.
Developers building Mixture-of-Models systems who want to intelligently compose model outputs based on request content.
Enterprises concerned with data privacy, using routing to keep sensitive data within local or private cloud boundaries.
Researchers exploring signal-driven routing algorithms, can experiment and extend based on this project.

zh.tag: 为 Ansible、Terraform 等 DevOps 工具提供现代 UI 和 API
zh.what: Semaphore UI 是一个开源的 DevOps 工具管理界面，让用户通过 Web 界面轻松运行 Ansible playbook、Terraform/OpenTofu 代码、Bash 和 PowerShell 脚本。它支持任务调度、失败通知和访问控制，适合需要从终端部署转向可视化管理的团队。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Go 后端和 Web 前端，提供项目管理、任务模板、调度、库存和变量组等核心功能。支持 Docker 安装，并提供在线演示和多种云市场镜像。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，前端可能涉及 JavaScript 框架，依赖 Docker 进行容器化部署，支持 Ansible、Terraform/OpenTofu、PowerShell 等工具集成。
zh.hot: 随着 DevOps 实践普及，团队需要更友好的操作界面，Semaphore UI 填补了这一需求。尽管本周新增 star 不多，但总星数超过 1.4 万，且进入 Go 语言周榜，说明其持续受到关注。
uses: DevOps 工程师：通过 Web 界面管理 Ansible 和 Terraform 任务，减少命令行操作。
中小型团队：需要集中管理基础设施自动化，但不想部署复杂 CI/CD 系统。
运维人员：利用调度和通知功能，自动化日常部署任务并快速响应失败。

en.tag: Modern UI and API for Ansible, Terraform, PowerShell, and other DevOps tools
en.what: Semaphore UI is an open-source web interface for managing popular DevOps tools, allowing users to easily run Ansible playbooks, Terraform/OpenTofu code, Bash and PowerShell scripts. It supports task scheduling, failure notifications, and access control, ideal for teams transitioning from terminal-based deployment to visual management.
en.content: The repository contains a full Go backend and web frontend, offering core features like project management, task templates, schedules, inventory, and variable groups. It supports Docker installation and provides an online demo and marketplace images.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, with a frontend likely using a JavaScript framework. It relies on Docker for containerized deployment and integrates with tools like Ansible, Terraform/OpenTofu, and PowerShell.
en.hot: As DevOps practices become widespread, teams need more user-friendly interfaces, and Semaphore UI fills this gap. Despite modest weekly star growth, its total stars exceed 14k and it ranks on the Go weekly trending list, indicating sustained interest.
uses: DevOps engineers: manage Ansible and Terraform tasks via a web UI, reducing CLI usage.
Small to medium teams: need centralized infrastructure automation without complex CI/CD systems.
Operations staff: leverage scheduling and notifications to automate routine deployments and respond to failures quickly.

zh.tag: 拦截AI爬虫的HTTP请求守卫
zh.what: Anubis 是一个用 Go 编写的反向代理，通过工作量证明（Proof-of-Work）挑战来验证 HTTP 请求是否来自真实用户，从而阻止 AI 爬虫和恶意机器人访问网站。它能够识别并过滤掉那些不遵守 robots.txt 的 AI 抓取工具，保护网站内容不被未经授权的抓取。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的代理服务器核心代码、Web 界面（用于展示挑战页面）、Docker 部署配置、文档和示例配置。项目结构清晰，包含 cmd、internal、web 等目录，并提供预构建的 Docker 镜像。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖标准库和少量第三方库（如 chi 路由器）。支持 Docker 部署，并集成 Prometheus 监控指标。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 爬虫日益泛滥，网站管理员急需有效的防护工具。Anubis 以 2.2 万星标和每日新增 100+ 的速度迅速走红，成为 GitHub Go 趋势榜常客，反映了社区对反爬虫解决方案的强烈需求。
uses: 网站管理员：保护个人博客或小型网站免受 AI 爬虫抓取内容
开发者：集成到现有服务中，作为反向代理层过滤恶意机器人
运维团队：通过 Docker 快速部署，为多个站点提供统一防护

en.tag: HTTP request guardian that blocks AI crawlers
en.what: Anubis is a Go-based reverse proxy that uses Proof-of-Work challenges to verify if HTTP requests come from real users, thereby blocking AI crawlers and malicious bots. It identifies and filters out AI scraping tools that ignore robots.txt, protecting website content from unauthorized scraping.
en.content: The repository contains the Go proxy server core code, a web interface for displaying challenge pages, Docker deployment configs, documentation, and example configurations. The project has a clear structure with cmd, internal, web directories, and provides pre-built Docker images.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, using the standard library and a few third-party libraries (e.g., chi router). Supports Docker deployment and integrates Prometheus metrics.
en.hot: With the proliferation of AI crawlers, website administrators urgently need effective protection tools. Anubis has gained 22k stars and adds 100+ daily, becoming a regular on GitHub Go trending, reflecting the community's strong demand for anti-crawler solutions.
uses: Website admins: Protect personal blogs or small sites from AI crawlers scraping content
Developers: Integrate into existing services as a reverse proxy layer to filter malicious bots
Ops teams: Deploy quickly via Docker to provide unified protection for multiple sites

zh.tag: 为AI代理打造的即时、并发、安全、轻量级沙箱服务
zh.what: CubeSandbox 是一个高性能的沙箱服务，基于 RustVMM 和 KVM 构建，为 AI 代理提供硬件级隔离的运行环境。它能在 60 毫秒内创建沙箱，内存开销小于 5MB，支持单节点部署和轻松扩展到多节点集群。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的沙箱服务实现，包括 RustVMM 和 KVM 集成、E2B 兼容的 API、Python SDK（PyPI 包）、文档、快速入门指南和变更日志。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，底层依赖 RustVMM 和 KVM 实现硬件级虚拟化。提供 Python SDK，兼容 E2B SDK。
zh.hot: 凭借极快的启动速度（60ms）和极低的内存开销（<5MB），以及 E2B 兼容性，迅速获得开发者关注，GitHub 日榜 Go 语言第 2 名，star 数已超 1.1 万。
uses: AI 代理开发者：需要安全、隔离的环境来执行代码或运行工具，确保代理行为可控。
平台工程师：构建多租户沙箱服务，用于代码执行、数据处理或安全测试。
教育场景：为学生提供安全的编程练习环境，避免影响宿主机。

en.tag: Instant, concurrent, secure & lightweight sandbox service for AI agents
en.what: CubeSandbox is a high-performance sandbox service built on RustVMM and KVM, providing hardware-isolated runtime environments for AI agents. It can create a sandbox in under 60ms with less than 5MB memory overhead, supporting single-node deployment and easy scaling to multi-node clusters.
en.content: The repository contains the full sandbox service implementation, including RustVMM and KVM integration, E2B-compatible API, Python SDK (PyPI package), documentation, quickstart guide, and changelog.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, leveraging RustVMM and KVM for hardware-level virtualization. Provides a Python SDK and is compatible with the E2B SDK.
en.hot: With ultra-fast startup (60ms) and low memory overhead (<5MB), plus E2B compatibility, it quickly gained developer attention, ranking #2 on GitHub Trending for Go and amassing over 11k stars.
uses: AI agent developers: need secure, isolated environments to execute code or run tools, ensuring agent behavior is controlled.
Platform engineers: build multi-tenant sandbox services for code execution, data processing, or security testing.
Educational scenarios: provide students with safe programming practice environments without affecting the host machine.

zh.tag: 通用代理平台，支持多协议与多平台
zh.what: sing-box 是一个通用代理平台，提供高性能的网络代理功能，支持多种代理协议（如 Shadowsocks、VMess、Trojan 等）和平台（包括 Windows、macOS、Linux、Android 等）。它旨在为用户提供灵活、可配置的代理解决方案，适用于各种网络环境。
zh.content: 仓库包含 sing-box 的源代码、构建脚本、文档（位于 sing-box.sagernet.org）以及许可证信息。项目使用 Go 语言编写，提供命令行工具，可通过配置文件进行定制。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖多种网络库，支持多平台编译。
zh.hot: sing-box 因其强大的功能和灵活性在 GitHub 上获得 37k+ 星标，今日新增 30 星，位列 Go 语言趋势榜第 19 名，持续受到网络代理用户的关注。
uses: 适合需要科学上网或绕过网络限制的个人用户，提供稳定高效的代理服务。
适用于开发者或系统管理员，用于搭建自定义代理服务器或集成到现有网络架构中。
适合对隐私和安全性有较高要求的用户，通过代理加密流量保护数据。

en.tag: Universal proxy platform supporting multiple protocols and platforms
en.what: sing-box is a universal proxy platform that provides high-performance network proxying capabilities, supporting multiple proxy protocols (such as Shadowsocks, VMess, Trojan, etc.) and platforms (including Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, etc.). It aims to offer flexible and configurable proxy solutions for various network environments.
en.content: The repository contains the source code, build scripts, documentation (hosted at sing-box.sagernet.org), and license information. The project is written in Go and provides a command-line tool that can be customized via configuration files.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, leveraging various networking libraries, and supports cross-platform compilation.
en.hot: sing-box has gained 37k+ stars on GitHub due to its powerful features and flexibility, with 30 new stars today, ranking 19th on the Go trending list, continuing to attract attention from proxy users.
uses: Ideal for individual users needing to bypass network restrictions or access blocked content, providing stable and efficient proxy services.
Suitable for developers or system administrators to set up custom proxy servers or integrate into existing network infrastructure.
Great for users with high privacy and security requirements, encrypting traffic to protect data.

zh.tag: 可扩展的覆盖网络工具，兼顾性能、简单与安全
zh.what: Nebula 是一个可扩展的覆盖网络工具，旨在让分布在世界各地的计算机无缝连接。它基于 Noise 协议框架，使用证书认证节点身份，并通过灯塔节点实现 NAT 穿透，支持从少量到数万台设备的组网。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Nebula 的核心代码，包括证书管理、加密通信、安全组、灯塔节点等模块，以及适用于 Linux、Windows、macOS、FreeBSD 等平台的构建文件。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Noise 协议框架、椭圆曲线 Diffie-Hellman 密钥交换和 AES-256-GCM 加密。
zh.hot: Nebula 在 GitHub 上拥有 18k+ stars，今日新增 25 个，位列 Go 趋势榜第五，因其高性能、简单易用和安全性受到广泛关注。
uses: 适用于需要跨地域、跨云服务商安全组网的开发者和运维人员。
适合构建分布式系统或边缘计算场景，需要低延迟、高安全性的网络连接。
可用于个人或企业快速搭建虚拟专用网络，替代传统 VPN 方案。

en.tag: A scalable overlay networking tool focusing on performance, simplicity, and security
en.what: Nebula is a scalable overlay networking tool that enables seamless connection of computers worldwide. Built on the Noise Protocol Framework, it uses certificates for node authentication and lighthouse nodes for NAT traversal, supporting networks from a few to tens of thousands of devices.
en.content: The repository contains the core code of Nebula, including modules for certificate management, encrypted communication, security groups, lighthouse nodes, and build files for Linux, Windows, macOS, FreeBSD, etc.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, leveraging the Noise Protocol Framework, Elliptic-curve Diffie-Hellman key exchange, and AES-256-GCM encryption.
en.hot: With over 18k stars and 25 new stars today, ranking 5th on the Go trending list, Nebula gains attention for its high performance, simplicity, and security.
uses: For developers and operators needing secure networking across regions and cloud providers.
Ideal for distributed systems or edge computing requiring low-latency, high-security connections.
Can be used to quickly set up virtual private networks for individuals or enterprises, replacing traditional VPN solutions.

zh.tag: 私有证书颁发机构与ACME服务器，实现自动化证书管理
zh.what: step-ca 是一个在线证书颁发机构（CA），用于安全、自动化的证书管理，支持 X.509 和 SSH 证书。它作为 step CLI 的服务端组件，帮助 DevOps 团队轻松签发和管理 TLS 证书，并支持 ACME 协议实现自动化。
zh.content: 仓库包含 step-ca 服务器的源代码、文档和示例，提供 ACME 服务器、证书签发与管理功能，并支持多种 ACME 挑战类型。
zh.stack: 基于 Go 语言开发，依赖 ACME 协议和标准加密库，与 step CLI 配套使用。
zh.hot: 随着 DevOps 对自动化证书管理的需求增长，step-ca 提供了开源的私有 CA 解决方案，star 数稳定增长，本周新增 48 星，位列 Go 周榜第 18 名。
uses: DevOps 工程师需要自动化管理 TLS 证书，用于虚拟机、容器、API 等场景。
安全团队希望建立私有 CA 以签发浏览器信任的证书，同时满足合规要求。
开发人员需要为 Kubernetes 集群或微服务架构签发和管理证书。
希望实现 SSH 证书自动化，结合 SSO 进行身份验证的团队。

en.tag: Private CA & ACME server for automated X.509 and SSH certificate management
en.what: step-ca is an online certificate authority for secure, automated certificate management, supporting both X.509 and SSH certificates. It serves as the server counterpart to the step CLI, enabling DevOps teams to easily issue and manage TLS certificates with ACME support.
en.content: The repository contains the source code, documentation, and examples for the step-ca server, offering an ACME server, certificate issuance and management, and support for various ACME challenge types.
en.stack: Developed in Go, leveraging ACME protocol and standard cryptographic libraries, designed to work with the step CLI.
en.hot: With the growing need for automated certificate management in DevOps, step-ca offers an open-source private CA solution, steadily gaining stars with +48 this week, ranking #18 on the Go weekly trending list.
uses: DevOps engineers needing automated TLS certificate management for VMs, containers, APIs, etc.
Security teams looking to establish a private CA for issuing browser-trusted certificates while meeting compliance.
Developers requiring certificate issuance and management for Kubernetes clusters or microservices.
Teams aiming to automate SSH certificates with SSO-based identity verification.

zh.tag: 自托管聚合仪表盘，把订阅源集中一处
zh.what: Glance 是一个轻量级、高度可定制的自托管仪表盘，用于集中展示 RSS、Reddit、Hacker News、天气、YouTube 等订阅源。它通过美观简洁的界面，让用户在一个页面中快速浏览所有信息流。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的核心服务、YAML 配置文件示例、文档（配置、主题、预配置页面）、社区组件目录以及 Docker 部署支持。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖少量 JavaScript（原生），生成单一可执行文件（<20MB），支持多平台和 Docker 容器。
zh.hot: 凭借极低的资源占用、丰富的组件生态和高度可定制性，Glance 在自托管社区广受欢迎，目前已收获 36,682 颗星，今日新增 22 颗。
uses: 自托管爱好者：搭建个人信息中心，整合 RSS、新闻、天气等订阅源。
开发者和技术爱好者：监控 GitHub、Hacker News、Reddit 等技术社区动态。
追求效率的用户：通过自定义布局和主题，打造专属的极简仪表盘。

en.tag: Self-hosted dashboard aggregating all your feeds in one place
en.what: Glance is a lightweight, highly customizable self-hosted dashboard that aggregates feeds like RSS, Reddit, Hacker News, weather, YouTube, and more. It presents all your information streams in a beautiful, streamlined interface for quick browsing.
en.content: The repository contains the Go-based core service, YAML configuration examples, documentation (configuration, themes, preconfigured pages), community widgets directory, and Docker deployment support.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, with minimal vanilla JavaScript, producing a single binary under 20MB for multiple OS/architectures, and a small Docker container.
en.hot: With its low resource usage, extensive widget ecosystem, and high customizability, Glance has gained popularity in the self-hosting community, amassing 36,682 stars with 22 added today.
uses: Self-hosting enthusiasts: build a personal dashboard to aggregate RSS, news, weather, and more.
Developers and tech enthusiasts: monitor GitHub, Hacker News, Reddit, and other tech communities.
Productivity-focused users: create a minimal, personalized dashboard with custom layouts and themes.

zh.tag: 自托管 CPA/CLIProxyAPI 管理面板与 AI 网关可观测性仪表盘
zh.what: 这是一个自托管的 CPA/CLIProxyAPI 管理面板，提供 AI 网关的可观测性仪表盘，用于监控请求、用量、成本、配额、失败和账户健康。它支持管理提供商、凭证、OAuth、插件和配置，并将请求历史、成本分析和账户自动化数据存储在本地。
zh.content: 仓库包含仪表盘、请求监控、用量分析、凭证管理和健康检查等界面，以及文档和 Docker 部署配置。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，支持 Docker 部署，前端可能使用 Web 技术构建。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub 日榜上排名第六，拥有 3033 颗星，因其解决了 AI 网关管理中的关键痛点，如成本追踪和账户健康监控，受到开发者关注。
uses: 适用于使用 CPA/CLIProxyAPI 的开发者，需要监控 AI 请求成本和配额。
适合管理多个 AI 提供商凭证和账户健康的管理员。
用于需要本地存储请求历史和成本分析的企业或团队。

en.tag: Self-hosted CPA/CLIProxyAPI management panel and AI gateway observability dashboard
en.what: It is a self-hosted management panel for CPA/CLIProxyAPI, offering an AI gateway observability dashboard for requests, usage, cost, quota, failures, and account health. It manages providers, credentials, OAuth, plugins, and configuration while keeping persistent request history, cost analytics, and account automation in local storage.
en.content: The repository includes dashboard, request monitoring, usage analytics, credential management, and health inspection interfaces, along with documentation and Docker deployment configuration.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, supports Docker deployment, and the frontend is likely built with web technologies.
en.hot: Ranked 6th on GitHub Trending with 3033 stars, it gained attention for addressing key pain points in AI gateway management, such as cost tracking and account health monitoring.
uses: For developers using CPA/CLIProxyAPI who need to monitor AI request costs and quotas.
For administrators managing multiple AI provider credentials and account health.
For enterprises or teams requiring local storage of request history and cost analytics.

zh.tag: Go 语言的极速 Express 风格 Web 框架
zh.what: Fiber 是一个受 Express 启发的 Go Web 框架，基于最快的 HTTP 引擎 Fasthttp 构建。它旨在通过零内存分配和高性能来简化快速开发过程，同时保持与 Express 相似的 API 风格。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的框架源码、路由、中间件、上下文处理等，并提供详细的文档、基准测试和示例。
zh.stack: 使用 Go 语言编写，依赖 Fasthttp 作为 HTTP 引擎，支持 Go modules，并集成测试、覆盖率、代码质量等工具。
zh.hot: Fiber 凭借其极高性能和 Express 风格 API 吸引了大量 Go 开发者，star 数已超 4 万，本周新增 39，持续活跃于 GitHub 趋势榜。
uses: 适合希望用 Go 快速构建高性能 REST API 的后端开发者。
适合从 Node.js/Express 迁移到 Go 的团队，降低学习曲线。
适合需要高并发、低延迟 Web 服务的微服务架构场景。

en.tag: Lightning-fast, Express-inspired web framework for Go
en.what: Fiber is an Express-inspired web framework for Go, built on top of Fasthttp, the fastest HTTP engine for Go. It aims to ease fast development with zero memory allocation and high performance, while keeping an API style similar to Express.
en.content: The repository contains the full framework source code, routing, middleware, context handling, along with extensive documentation, benchmarks, and examples.
en.stack: Written in Go, relies on Fasthttp as the HTTP engine, supports Go modules, and integrates testing, coverage, and code quality tools.
en.hot: Fiber attracts many Go developers with its high performance and Express-like API, amassing over 40k stars with 39 new this week, remaining active on GitHub trending.
uses: Backend developers who want to build high-performance REST APIs quickly in Go.
Teams migrating from Node.js/Express to Go, reducing learning curve.
Microservices architectures requiring high concurrency and low latency web services.

zh.tag: 跨平台开源备份工具，支持加密、压缩与去重
zh.what: Kopia 是一款快速且安全的开源备份/恢复工具，支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux。它允许用户创建加密快照，并将其保存到本地、网络或云存储中，提供 CLI 和 GUI 两种界面。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Kopia 的完整源代码、文档、图标资源以及用于构建和测试的配置文件。项目采用 Go 编写，并提供了详细的安装指南和用户文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖包括用于加密的库、存储后端适配器以及 GUI 框架（如 Fyne 或类似）。
zh.hot: Kopia 在 GitHub 上拥有超过 1.4 万星标，本周新增 66 星，位列 Go 语言周榜第 15 名。其受欢迎的原因在于提供了企业级功能（如端到端加密、去重）且完全免费开源，同时支持多平台。
uses: 个人用户需要可靠且加密的备份解决方案，保护重要文件和数据。
系统管理员或 IT 专业人员希望自动化备份流程，并集成到现有脚本或 CI/CD 管道中。
对数据隐私有高要求的企业或组织，需要端到端加密和合规性备份。

en.tag: Cross-platform open-source backup tool with encryption, compression, and deduplication
en.what: Kopia is a fast and secure open-source backup/restore tool for Windows, macOS, and Linux. It lets users create encrypted snapshots of their data and save them to local, network, or cloud storage, with both CLI and GUI available.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, documentation, icons, and build/test configuration files for Kopia. The project is written in Go and includes detailed installation guides and user documentation.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, with dependencies on encryption libraries, storage backend adapters, and GUI frameworks (such as Fyne or similar).
en.hot: Kopia has over 14k stars on GitHub, with 66 new stars this week, ranking #15 on the Go weekly trending list. Its popularity stems from offering enterprise-grade features like end-to-end encryption and deduplication, while being free, open-source, and cross-platform.
uses: Individuals needing a reliable and encrypted backup solution to protect important files and data.
System administrators or IT professionals looking to automate backup processes and integrate with existing scripts or CI/CD pipelines.
Enterprises or organizations with high data privacy requirements, needing end-to-end encryption and compliance-friendly backups.

zh.tag: 分布式存储系统，支持对象存储、文件系统与 Iceberg 表
zh.what: SeaweedFS 是一个简单且高度可扩展的分布式文件系统，旨在存储数十亿文件并快速服务。它通过一个统一的二进制文件同时提供 S3 对象存储、POSIX 文件系统和 Iceberg 表（数据湖）功能，所有数据存储在同一套存储之上。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心的 weed 二进制文件、文档（wiki）、示例配置、Docker 镜像支持，以及客户端库（如 Java、Go 等）。项目采用 Apache 2.0 许可，并接受 Patreon 赞助。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 gRPC 进行通信，支持多种存储后端（如本地磁盘、云存储）。提供 S3 API 兼容接口和 FUSE 挂载支持。
zh.hot: 本周新增 137 颗星，总星数达 34,465，位列 Go 语言周榜第 19 名。其独特的 O(1) 磁盘访问设计和多协议支持吸引了大量关注。
uses: 需要存储海量小文件并追求高吞吐的场景，如日志存储、图片存储等。
希望同时使用对象存储和文件系统，并需要与 S3 兼容的应用。
构建数据湖或需要 Iceberg 表格式支持的大数据平台。

en.tag: Distributed storage for S3 objects, POSIX FS, and Iceberg tables
en.what: SeaweedFS is a simple and highly scalable distributed file system designed to store billions of files and serve them fast. A single weed binary provides an S3 object store, a POSIX file system, and a lakehouse with Iceberg tables, all over the same data.
en.content: The repository contains the core weed binary, documentation (wiki), example configurations, Docker image support, and client libraries (e.g., Java, Go). It is Apache-2.0 licensed and accepts sponsors via Patreon.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, uses gRPC for communication, supports multiple storage backends (local disk, cloud storage). Provides S3-compatible API and FUSE mount support.
en.hot: Gained 137 stars this week, reaching 34,465 total, ranking 19th on the Go weekly trending list. Its unique O(1) disk access design and multi-protocol support attract significant attention.
uses: Scenarios requiring massive small file storage with high throughput, such as log or image storage.
Applications needing both object storage and a file system with S3 compatibility.
Data lake platforms that require Iceberg table format support.

zh.tag: 基于 WireGuard 的安全组网与访问控制平台
zh.what: NetBird 是一个开源的零配置组网工具，利用 WireGuard 创建加密的 P2P 覆盖网络，自动连接设备，无需开放端口或配置防火墙。它同时提供集中式访问控制，支持 SSO、MFA 和细粒度权限策略，适用于企业和家庭网络。
zh.content: 仓库包含 NetBird 客户端、服务端、管理面板（dashboard）、公共 API 以及 agent-network 子目录（用于 AI 代理的身份感知访问控制）。提供完整的文档、Slack 社区和自托管部署指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 WireGuard 内核模块，支持 Linux、Windows、macOS 等平台。前端 dashboard 可能使用 React 等 Web 技术。
zh.hot: NetBird 以零配置、安全的 P2P 组网替代传统 VPN，在 GitHub 上获得近 3 万星标，今日新增 36 星，位列 Go 语言趋势榜第 4。其独特的 AI Agent 网络功能（Beta）也吸引了关注。
uses: 企业 IT 管理员：快速搭建安全的远程访问网络，无需管理 VPN 网关和复杂防火墙规则。
开发者和 DevOps 团队：在云、本地或混合环境中自动连接服务器和容器，简化基础设施管理。
家庭用户：轻松组建家庭私有网络，安全访问 NAS 或智能设备。
AI 应用开发者：利用 Agent Network 功能为 AI 代理提供无密钥的 LLM API 访问控制。

en.tag: Secure WireGuard-based overlay network with SSO, MFA, and access control
en.what: NetBird is an open-source, zero-config networking tool that creates an encrypted P2P overlay network using WireGuard, automatically connecting devices without port forwarding or complex firewall rules. It also provides centralized access control with SSO, MFA, and granular policies for enterprise and home networks.
en.content: The repository includes the NetBird client, server, dashboard UI, public API, and an agent-network subdirectory for identity-aware access control for AI agents. It offers comprehensive docs, Slack community, and self-hosting guides.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, leveraging WireGuard kernel modules, with support for Linux, Windows, macOS, and other platforms. The dashboard frontend likely uses web technologies like React.
en.hot: NetBird's zero-config, secure P2P networking as a VPN alternative has earned nearly 30k stars, with 36 new stars today, ranking #4 on the Go trending list. Its unique AI Agent Network feature (Beta) also draws attention.
uses: Enterprise IT admins: quickly set up secure remote access networks without managing VPN gateways or complex firewall rules.
Developers and DevOps teams: automatically connect servers and containers across cloud, on-prem, or hybrid environments to simplify infrastructure management.
Home users: easily create a private home network to securely access NAS or smart devices.
AI application developers: leverage the Agent Network feature for keyless access control to LLM APIs for AI agents.

zh.tag: 自托管 SSL 证书全生命周期自动化管理工具
zh.what: Certimate 是一个开源免费的自托管 SSL 证书 ACME 工具，提供可视化的界面来管理证书的申请、部署、续期和监控。它支持多种主流云厂商，帮助用户自动化处理证书的整个生命周期。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的后端服务，提供 Web UI 和 API，支持多种 ACME 客户端和云厂商集成，以及 Docker 部署方式。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 ACME 协议库和云厂商 SDK，支持 Docker 容器化部署。
zh.hot: 随着 HTTPS 普及，证书管理需求增长，Certimate 提供免费、自托管且可视化的解决方案，本周新增 74 星，总星数达 9280，登上 Go 周榜。
uses: 个人开发者或小团队希望免费自动化管理 SSL 证书，避免手动续期。
需要多域名或泛域名证书统一管理的运维人员。
对数据隐私敏感，希望自托管证书管理工具的用户。

en.tag: Self-hosted SSL certificate lifecycle automation with visual UI
en.what: Certimate is an open-source, free, self-hosted ACME tool for SSL certificates, offering a visual interface to manage issuance, deployment, renewal, and monitoring. It supports major cloud providers, automating the entire certificate lifecycle.
en.content: The repository contains a Go backend with a web UI and API, supporting multiple ACME clients and cloud provider integrations, plus Docker deployment.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, leveraging ACME protocol libraries and cloud provider SDKs, with Docker containerization support.
en.hot: With HTTPS adoption rising, Certimate offers a free, self-hosted, visual solution for certificate management, gaining 74 stars this week to reach 9280 total, ranking on the Go weekly trending list.
uses: Individual developers or small teams wanting free automated SSL certificate management to avoid manual renewals.
Ops professionals needing unified management of multi-domain or wildcard certificates.
Users who prefer self-hosted tools for data privacy in certificate management.

zh.tag: 专为 Kubernetes 设计的不可变、极简、安全 Linux 发行版
zh.what: Talos Linux 是一个专为 Kubernetes 打造的现代操作系统，它安全、不可变且极简。所有系统管理都通过 API 进行，没有 shell 或交互式控制台，从而减少了攻击面并消除了配置漂移。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Talos Linux 的源代码、文档、构建脚本和发布资源。项目采用 Go 编写，提供完整的 API 接口和 Kubernetes 集成。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Kubernetes 生态，支持 mTLS 安全通信，并采用不可变基础设施理念。
zh.hot: Talos 在 GitHub 上拥有超过 11k 星标，本周新增 60 星，位列 Go 语言周榜第 20 名。其独特的设计理念——无 shell 的 Kubernetes 专用 OS——吸引了大量关注。
uses: 适用于希望简化 Kubernetes 节点管理、提高安全性的 DevOps 工程师
适合构建不可变基础设施、追求极致稳定性的平台团队
可用于边缘计算或大规模集群部署，减少运维复杂度

en.tag: A secure, immutable, minimal Linux OS designed specifically for Kubernetes
en.what: Talos Linux is a modern OS built for Kubernetes, designed to be secure, immutable, and minimal. All system management is done via an API, with no shell or interactive console, reducing attack surface and eliminating configuration drift.
en.content: The repository contains the source code, documentation, build scripts, and release assets for Talos Linux. Written in Go, it provides a full API and Kubernetes integration.
en.stack: Developed primarily in Go, it leverages the Kubernetes ecosystem, supports mTLS for secure communication, and follows immutable infrastructure principles.
en.hot: With over 11k stars and 60 added this week, Talos ranks #20 on the Go trending list. Its unique approach—a shell-less OS dedicated to Kubernetes—has captured significant attention.
uses: For DevOps engineers seeking to simplify Kubernetes node management and enhance security
For platform teams building immutable infrastructure and pursuing maximum stability
For edge computing or large-scale cluster deployments to reduce operational complexity

zh.tag: 下一代爬虫与蜘蛛框架，支持无头浏览器
zh.what: Katana 是一个快速且高度可配置的网页爬虫框架，支持标准和 headless 两种模式，能够解析 JavaScript 并自动填充表单。它提供精细的范围控制、预配置字段和正则过滤，以及可定制的输出格式（如 JSON）。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的命令行工具，核心功能包括爬取、范围控制、过滤、输出定制，以及可选的机器学习模型用于页面类型和表单分类。
zh.stack: 主要基于 Go 语言，支持通过 Docker 运行，需要 Go 1.26+ 编译。无头模式依赖 Chrome，并可能使用机器学习模型（自动下载）。
zh.hot: 作为 ProjectDiscovery 生态的一部分，Katana 因其强大的爬虫能力和对现代 Web 应用（如 JavaScript 渲染）的适应性而广受欢迎，拥有超过 17k 星标。
uses: 安全研究人员用于侦察和漏洞挖掘，收集目标网站的 URL 和端点。
开发人员用于测试自己的 Web 应用，检查可访问性和资源结构。
需要自动化数据采集的爬虫开发者，可集成到自定义工作流中。

en.tag: A next-generation crawling and spidering framework with headless support
en.what: Katana is a fast and highly configurable web crawling framework that supports both standard and headless modes, with JavaScript parsing and automatic form filling. It offers fine-grained scope control, preconfigured field/regex filters, and customizable output formats such as JSON.
en.content: The repository contains a command-line tool written in Go, featuring crawling, scope control, filtering, output customization, and optional ML models for page type and form classification.
en.stack: Primarily built with Go, supports Docker deployment, requires Go 1.26+ for compilation. Headless mode relies on Chrome and may use machine learning models (auto-downloaded).
en.hot: As part of the ProjectDiscovery ecosystem, Katana is popular for its robust crawling capabilities and adaptability to modern web apps (e.g., JavaScript rendering), amassing over 17k stars.
uses: Security researchers use it for reconnaissance and vulnerability discovery, collecting URLs and endpoints from target sites.
Developers use it to test their own web applications, checking accessibility and resource structure.
Crawler developers needing automated data collection can integrate it into custom workflows.

zh.tag: 开源 Agent 优先的身份与访问管理平台，支持 MCP 网关
zh.what: Casdoor 是一个开源、自托管的身份与访问管理（IAM）平台，提供单点登录（SSO）和认证服务器，并带有 Web 管理控制台。它支持 OAuth 2.0、OIDC、SAML、CAS、LDAP、SCIM、WebAuthn、TOTP/MFA 等多种标准协议，并能连接 Google Workspace、Azure AD 等外部身份提供商。其 Agent-first 特性使其可作为 LLM MCP 和 Agent 网关，为 AI 应用提供认证与授权。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Go 后端服务、前端管理控制台（React）和用户登录界面，提供用户管理、组织管理、应用管理、提供商管理等功能。还包含 Docker 部署配置、文档和示例，支持通过 Web UI 进行可视化配置。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，前端基于 React，数据库支持 MySQL、PostgreSQL、SQL Server 等。依赖包括 Casbin 用于权限管理，支持多种身份验证协议和外部 IdP 集成。
zh.hot: 本周新增 67 星，总星数 14k+，在 Go 周榜排名第 23。其 Agent-first 定位和 MCP 网关支持使其在 AI 应用身份认证领域备受关注，满足了开发者对 AI 代理安全访问的需求。
uses: 为 AI 代理和 LLM 应用提供 MCP 网关和身份认证，确保安全访问
企业或开发者需要自托管 SSO 和用户管理，支持多种标准协议
需要集成 Google Workspace、Azure AD 等外部身份提供商的场景

en.tag: Open-source Agent-first IAM with MCP gateway, SSO & auth server
en.what: Casdoor is an open-source, self-hosted Identity and Access Management (IAM) platform with a web console, providing single sign-on (SSO) and authentication. It supports OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, CAS, LDAP, SCIM, WebAuthn, TOTP/MFA, and connects to Google Workspace, Azure AD, and other IdPs. Its Agent-first design enables it to act as an LLM MCP and agent gateway for AI application auth.
en.content: The repo contains a full Go backend service, a React-based admin console, and a user-facing login UI, offering user, organization, application, and provider management. It includes Docker deployment configs, documentation, and examples, all configurable via web UI.
en.stack: Built primarily with Go, frontend in React, supporting MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, etc. Uses Casbin for authorization and integrates multiple auth protocols and external IdPs.
en.hot: Gained 67 stars this week, total 14k+, ranking #23 on Go weekly trending. Its Agent-first positioning and MCP gateway support attract attention in AI app auth, meeting developers' need for secure AI agent access.
uses: Provide MCP gateway and auth for AI agents and LLM apps to ensure secure access
Organizations needing self-hosted SSO and user management with multiple standard protocols
Scenarios requiring integration with external IdPs like Google Workspace and Azure AD

zh.tag: 高性能 Unix 链接器，替代 lld 加速构建
zh.what: mold 是一个现代链接器，旨在加速大型 C/C++/Rust 项目的构建。它作为现有 Unix 链接器（如 lld）的即插即用替代品，在基准测试中比 lld 快 4.9 倍，比 wild 快 1.9 倍。
zh.content: 仓库包含 mold 链接器的完整源代码、构建脚本、基准测试套件和文档。支持多种 CPU 架构，如 x86-64、ARM、RISC-V 等。
zh.stack: 主要用 C++ 编写，依赖 CMake 构建系统，并利用多线程和并行算法实现高性能。
zh.hot: 由 LLVM lld 原作者开发，性能卓越，在大型项目（如 Chromium）中链接速度提升显著，因此广受关注。
uses: 大型 C/C++ 项目开发者，希望减少链接时间，加速构建流程
需要频繁调试-编辑-重建循环的开发者，快速迭代
系统级项目维护者，如浏览器、操作系统等，追求构建效率

en.tag: High-performance drop-in Unix linker, faster than lld
en.what: mold is a modern linker designed to speed up builds of large C/C++/Rust projects. As a drop-in replacement for existing Unix linkers like lld, it links 4.9x faster than lld and 1.9x faster than wild in benchmarks.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the mold linker, build scripts, benchmark suite, and documentation. It supports multiple CPU architectures including x86-64, ARM, RISC-V, and more.
en.stack: Written primarily in C++, built with CMake, and leverages multi-threading and parallel algorithms for high performance.
en.hot: Developed by the original author of LLVM lld, it offers exceptional performance, significantly speeding up linking for large projects like Chromium, hence its popularity.
uses: Developers of large C/C++ projects seeking to reduce link time and speed up builds
Developers in rapid debug-edit-rebuild cycles who need faster iteration
Maintainers of system-level projects like browsers or OSes aiming for build efficiency

zh.tag: Google 跨语言数据序列化标准
zh.what: Protocol Buffers（protobuf）是 Google 开发的语言中立、平台中立、可扩展的结构化数据序列化机制，用于高效编码和交换数据。它通过 .proto 文件定义数据结构，并生成多种语言的代码，广泛应用于 RPC 系统和数据存储。
zh.content: 仓库包含 protobuf 的完整实现，包括 C++ 编写的编译器（protoc）、各语言运行时库（如 C++、Java、Python、Go 等）、测试和文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写编译器，支持 Bazel 和 CMake 构建系统，并依赖多种语言运行时。
zh.hot: 作为数据序列化的行业标准，protobuf 拥有超过 7 万星标，今日新增 96 星，持续受到开发者关注，因其高效、跨语言特性成为微服务和分布式系统的基石。
uses: 后端开发人员：在微服务间定义高效、版本兼容的通信协议。
数据工程师：用于大数据管道和存储格式（如与 gRPC 结合）。
跨语言团队：需要统一数据交换格式，支持多语言生成代码。

en.tag: Google's cross-language data serialization standard
en.what: Protocol Buffers (protobuf) is Google's language-neutral, platform-neutral, extensible mechanism for serializing structured data. It defines data structures in .proto files and generates code in multiple languages, widely used in RPC systems and data storage.
en.content: The repository contains the full implementation of protobuf, including the compiler (protoc) written in C++, runtime libraries for various languages (C++, Java, Python, Go, etc.), tests, and documentation.
en.stack: The compiler is primarily written in C++, supporting Bazel and CMake build systems, with dependencies on various language runtimes.
en.hot: As an industry standard for data serialization, protobuf has over 71k stars, with 96 added today, continuing to attract developers due to its efficiency and cross-language capabilities, making it a cornerstone of microservices and distributed systems.
uses: Backend developers: define efficient, version-tolerant communication protocols between microservices.
Data engineers: use in big data pipelines and storage formats (e.g., with gRPC).
Cross-language teams: need a unified data interchange format with multi-language code generation.

zh.tag: 跨平台开源多轨音频编辑器与录音软件
zh.what: Audacity 是一款易用的多轨音频编辑器和录音软件，支持 Windows、macOS、GNU/Linux 等系统。它提供录音、编辑、混音、效果处理等功能，适合播客、音乐制作和音频修复等场景。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Audacity 的完整源代码，包括核心编辑器、音频引擎、效果插件、UI 资源等。当前正在开发 Audacity 4，采用全新 UI 并进行大规模重构，同时保留 3.x 分支供维护。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 wxWidgets（UI）、PortAudio（音频 I/O）等库。构建系统支持 CMake，并提供针对不同平台的构建脚本。
zh.hot: 作为老牌开源音频工具，Audacity 长期拥有稳定用户群。近期因 Audacity 4 的 UI 重构和功能更新引发关注，今日新增 272 星，位列 C++ 趋势榜第二。
uses: 播客制作者：录制和编辑多轨音频，添加效果和导出播客节目。
音乐爱好者：进行简单的录音、剪辑和混音，或修复老旧录音。
