zh.tag: 工业级可控零样本语音合成系统
zh.what: IndexTTS 是一个零样本文本转语音系统，能从单条参考音频克隆音色。最新版 IndexTTS-2.5 支持中英日西阿五种语言，具备细粒度情感、语速和发音控制，推理速度比前代更快。
zh.content: 仓库包含模型权重、推理代码、演示页面和文档，提供 ModelScope 与 HuggingFace 模型下载，以及在线 Demo 和 Studio 体验。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 实现，依赖深度学习框架（如 PyTorch）和音频处理库，支持多语言文本前端。
zh.hot: 月增近 1400 star，因工业级零样本克隆、多语言与精细控制能力而备受关注，适合内容创作与本地化场景。
uses: 内容创作者用于生成多语言配音或克隆自己的声音，提升视频制作效率。
开发者集成到应用中，实现个性化语音助手或有声书朗读功能。
本地化团队快速生成多语言音频，降低配音成本和时间。

en.tag: Industrial-grade controllable zero-shot TTS system
en.what: IndexTTS is a zero-shot text-to-speech system that clones a voice from a single reference audio clip. The latest IndexTTS-2.5 supports Chinese, English, Japanese, Spanish, and Arabic, with fine-grained emotion, speed, and pronunciation control, and faster inference than its predecessor.
en.content: The repository includes model weights, inference code, demo pages, and documentation, with models available on ModelScope and HuggingFace, plus online demos and a studio for hands-on experience.
en.stack: Implemented in Python, built on deep learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch) and audio processing libraries, with multilingual text frontends.
en.hot: Gaining nearly 1,400 stars this month, it attracts attention for industrial-grade zero-shot cloning, multilingual support, and fine-grained control, ideal for content creation and localization.
uses: Content creators can generate multilingual voiceovers or clone their own voice to boost video production efficiency.
Developers can integrate it into apps for personalized voice assistants or audiobook narration.
Localization teams can quickly produce multilingual audio, reducing dubbing costs and time.

zh.tag: 免费AI编码代理，多产品覆盖终端、桌面、网页与云端
zh.what: Freebuff 是一套免费的AI编码代理产品，包括桌面端、CLI、Web、云和聊天五种形态，无需订阅或API密钥即可使用。它通过专用代理和模型选择帮助用户编码、构建和研究。
zh.content: 仓库包含产品文档、快速入门指南、模型目录说明，以及各产品（桌面、CLI、Web、云、聊天）的详细介绍和安装链接。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 开发，CLI 通过 npm 安装，支持多种模型（如 DeepSeek、GPT-5.6 Luna 等），桌面端可集成本地 Claude Code 和 Codex 代理。
zh.hot: 免费且无需API密钥的AI编码工具，提供多产品覆盖和多种模型选择，今日新增105星，登上GitHub趋势榜。
uses: 开发者：在终端或桌面端快速进行AI辅助编码
全栈开发者：使用Web版构建和部署完整应用
研究者：通过聊天版进行AI驱动的研究与思考
团队：在GitHub仓库上运行云端代理进行协作

en.tag: Free AI coding agent suite across terminal, desktop, web, and cloud
en.what: Freebuff is a suite of free AI coding agents available as desktop, CLI, web, cloud, and chat products, requiring no subscription or API key. It uses specialized agents and a choice of models to assist with coding, building, and research.
en.content: The repository includes product documentation, quick start guides, model catalog details, and descriptions/links for each product (Desktop, CLI, Web, Cloud, Chat).
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, CLI installable via npm, supports multiple models (DeepSeek, GPT-5.6 Luna, etc.), and Desktop can integrate local Claude Code and Codex agents.
en.hot: Free AI coding tool with no API key required, offering multi-product coverage and model variety; gained 105 stars today and hit the GitHub trending list.
uses: Developers: AI-assisted coding from terminal or desktop
Full-stack developers: build and ship apps with the Web version
Researchers: AI-driven research and thinking via Chat
Teams: run cloud agents on GitHub repositories for collaboration

zh.tag: 把人的思维方式蒸馏成 Agent 可复用的技能档案
zh.what: Distilly 是一个本地优先的工具，用于将一个人的原始材料、工作习惯、判断力和表达风格转化为带版本管理的“Agent 人物档案”。这些档案可以在运行期间临时调用，也可以作为长期的主机技能安装，存储权始终保留在本地，无需额外的模型 API 密钥。
zh.content: 仓库包含 CLI 工具、插件系统以及多个主机兼容层（如 Codex、OpenClaw、Hermes）。默认分支为 distilly-plugin，提供开发者预览版，包含五个 MCP 工具，并支持多语言文档。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript，要求 Node.js 22.19+ 或 24，使用 pnpm 管理依赖，构建后通过 CLI 与 MCP 协议集成到 Codex 等宿主。
zh.hot: 24k+ stars，本月新增 3741，因其将个人知识蒸馏为 Agent 技能的理念新颖，且本地优先、无需额外 API key，吸引大量开发者关注。
uses: 希望将个人工作方法沉淀为 AI 助手可复用技能的开发者或知识工作者
需要为团队或客户创建定制化 Agent 行为档案的 AI 应用构建者
对本地优先、数据自主可控的 AI 工具链感兴趣的技术爱好者

en.tag: Distill how people think into reusable Skills for any Agent or Bot
en.what: Distilly is a local-first tool that turns a person's source material, working habits, judgment, and voice into a versioned 'Person Profile for Agents'. The profile can be recalled temporarily during a run or installed as a long-lived host Skill, with storage authority staying local and no extra model API key required.
en.content: The repo includes a CLI tool, plugin system, and compatibility layers for multiple hosts (Codex, OpenClaw, Hermes). The default branch is distilly-plugin, offering a Developer Preview with five MCP tools and multi-language docs.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, requires Node.js 22.19+ or 24, uses pnpm for dependencies, and integrates with hosts like Codex via CLI and MCP protocol.
en.hot: With 24k+ stars and 3,741 added this month, it's hot for its novel concept of distilling personal knowledge into Agent skills, plus local-first design and no extra API key needed.
uses: Developers or knowledge workers who want to turn personal working methods into reusable AI assistant skills
AI application builders who need to create customized agent behavior profiles for teams or clients
Tech enthusiasts interested in local-first, data-sovereign AI toolchains

zh.tag: 自托管个人图书馆与阅读平台
zh.what: BookOrbit 是一个自托管的图书馆和阅读平台，支持电子书、PDF、有声书和漫画。它提供网页阅读器、Kobo 和 KOReader 支持，并同步阅读进度、高亮和状态。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的服务端和前端代码，提供仪表盘、书架管理、阅读统计、成就系统、OPDS 和 Send-to-Kindle 等功能，并支持多用户和 OIDC/SSO 认证。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，基于现代 Web 技术栈构建，支持 Docker 部署，并集成多种第三方服务（如 Crowdin 翻译、Codecov 覆盖率）。
zh.hot: BookOrbit 在 GitHub 上迅速走红，今日新增 248 星，总星数达 2613，因其自托管、跨设备同步和丰富功能而备受关注。
uses: 喜欢自托管服务的阅读爱好者，希望完全掌控自己的书籍数据。
需要在不同设备（如 Kobo、KOReader）间无缝同步阅读进度的用户。
注重隐私和自主权的用户，希望避免依赖商业云服务。
开发者或技术爱好者，希望扩展或定制自己的阅读平台。

en.tag: Self-hosted library and reading platform for ebooks, PDFs, audiobooks, and comics
en.what: BookOrbit is a self-hosted library and reading platform for ebooks, PDFs, audiobooks, and comics. It offers a web reader, Kobo and KOReader support, and syncs progress, highlights, and reading status across devices.
en.content: The repository contains full server and frontend code, featuring a dashboard, bookshelf management, reading stats, achievements, OPDS and Send-to-Kindle delivery, multi-user accounts with OIDC/SSO, and automatic sync to Hardcover, Readwise, and StoryGraph.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, built on modern web technologies, supports Docker deployment, and integrates with third-party services like Crowdin for translation and Codecov for coverage.
en.hot: BookOrbit is rapidly gaining popularity on GitHub with 248 stars today and 2,613 total, thanks to its self-hosted nature, cross-device sync, and rich feature set.
uses: Reading enthusiasts who prefer self-hosted services and want full control over their book data.
Users who need seamless reading progress sync across devices like Kobo and KOReader.
Privacy-conscious individuals who want to avoid relying on commercial cloud services.
Developers or tech enthusiasts looking to extend or customize their reading platform.

zh.tag: 聚合34家免费LLM提供商的统一API网关
zh.what: FreeLLMAPI 是一个开源项目，将数十家免费 LLM 提供商的免费额度聚合到一个 OpenAI 兼容的 /v1 端点后面。它提供智能路由、自动故障转移和加密密钥管理，让开发者无需管理多个 API 密钥即可访问大量免费模型。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个 TypeScript 编写的 API 网关，支持 Docker 自托管、桌面应用（macOS/Windows）和 Android 应用。它提供了一个仪表板，用于监控每月 token 预算，并包含一个自动更新的模型目录。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，支持 Docker 部署，并提供桌面和移动端应用。依赖 OpenAI 兼容 API 标准，集成多个 LLM 提供商。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub 上迅速走红，已获得近 2 万星标，日增 174 星。它解决了开发者对免费 LLM 资源分散、难以管理的痛点，提供了一站式解决方案。
uses: 个人开发者：快速集成多个免费 LLM，无需单独注册和付费。
原型开发：在项目初期使用免费模型验证想法，降低开发成本。
学习与研究：探索不同 LLM 的能力，进行对比实验。
自动化工具：为聊天机器人、内容生成等应用提供统一 API 接口。

en.tag: Unified API gateway aggregating 34 free LLM providers
en.what: FreeLLMAPI is an open-source project that aggregates free tiers from dozens of LLM providers behind a single OpenAI-compatible /v1 endpoint. It offers smart routing, automatic failover, and encrypted key management, allowing developers to access a vast array of free models without managing multiple API keys.
en.content: The repository contains a TypeScript-based API gateway with Docker self-hosting, desktop apps for macOS/Windows, and an Android app. It includes a dashboard for monitoring monthly token budgets and an auto-updating model catalog.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, with Docker deployment and desktop/mobile apps. Relies on OpenAI-compatible API standards and integrates multiple LLM providers.
en.hot: The project has gained nearly 20k stars with 174 new stars today, addressing the pain point of scattered free LLM resources by offering a one-stop solution.
uses: Individual developers: Quickly integrate multiple free LLMs without separate registrations and payments.
Prototyping: Validate ideas with free models in early stages, reducing development costs.
Learning and research: Explore capabilities of different LLMs and run comparative experiments.
Automation tools: Provide a unified API for chatbots, content generation, and more.

zh.tag: 为编码代理打造的极简 Web GUI
zh.what: T3 Code 是一个轻量级的 Web 图形界面，用于运行和管理多个编码 AI 代理（如 Codex、Claude、Cursor、OpenCode）。它让开发者无需离开浏览器即可与这些代理交互，简化了编码工作流。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Web 应用源码、桌面应用构建配置、CLI 工具以及文档（入门指南、远程访问、架构概览等）。支持通过 npx 快速运行或安装桌面应用。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript，使用 Vite+（Vite 的增强版）构建，依赖各代理的 CLI 工具（Codex CLI、Claude Code 等）。
zh.hot: 本周新增 413 星，总星数 14459，位列 TypeScript 周榜第 18。它填补了多代理统一管理界面的空白，吸引了大量对 AI 编码工具感兴趣的开发者。
uses: 希望在一个界面中切换多个 AI 编码助手的开发者
需要远程访问编码代理的团队或个人
探索 AI 辅助编程工作流的早期采用者

en.tag: A minimal web GUI for coding agents
en.what: T3 Code is a lightweight web GUI for running and managing multiple coding AI agents (e.g., Codex, Claude, Cursor, OpenCode). It allows developers to interact with these agents without leaving the browser, streamlining the coding workflow.
en.content: The repo contains the web app source code, desktop app build config, CLI tool, and documentation (getting started, remote access, architecture overview, etc.). It can be run quickly via npx or installed as a desktop app.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript and Vite+ (enhanced Vite), depends on each agent's CLI tool (Codex CLI, Claude Code, etc.).
en.hot: Gained 413 stars this week, total 14459, ranked #18 on TypeScript weekly trending. It fills the gap for a unified multi-agent management UI, attracting many developers interested in AI coding tools.
uses: Developers who want to switch between multiple AI coding assistants in one interface
Teams or individuals needing remote access to coding agents
Early adopters exploring AI-assisted programming workflows

zh.tag: 让 AI 代理轻松调用上万网页抓取工具的 MCP 服务器
zh.what: Apify MCP 服务器是一个中间层，将 AI 代理（如 Claude、Cursor）与 Apify Store 上数千个现成的爬虫和自动化工具连接起来。它支持通过 OAuth 从 Claude.ai 或 VS Code 等客户端直接连接，并支持流式 HTTP 传输。
zh.content: 仓库包含 MCP 服务器的 TypeScript 源码、文档、配置示例，以及指向托管服务 mcp.apify.com 的说明。还支持代理支付（agentic payments）和多种客户端集成。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 构建，使用 Model Context Protocol (MCP) SDK，支持 OAuth 和流式 HTTP。依赖 Apify 平台及其 Actor 生态系统。
zh.hot: 本月新增 3473 星，总星数达 6086，跻身 TypeScript 趋势榜第 16 名。AI 代理需要实时网页数据，而 Apify 提供了现成的抓取工具，正好满足需求。
uses: 开发者想要为 AI 代理添加网页数据抓取能力，无需自己编写爬虫。
使用 Claude、Cursor 等 MCP 客户端的用户，需要从社交媒体、电商等网站提取结构化数据。
需要自动化数据采集流程，并希望与 AI 工作流集成的团队。

en.tag: MCP server enabling AI agents to use thousands of web scrapers via Apify
en.what: The Apify MCP server is a middleware that connects AI agents (like Claude, Cursor) to thousands of ready-made scrapers and automation tools on Apify Store. It supports OAuth for connecting from clients like Claude.ai or VS Code, and uses Streamable HTTP transport.
en.content: The repo contains TypeScript source code, docs, config examples, and instructions for the hosted service at mcp.apify.com. It also supports agentic payments and integration with various MCP clients.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, uses the Model Context Protocol (MCP) SDK, supports OAuth and Streamable HTTP. Depends on the Apify platform and its Actor ecosystem.
en.hot: Gained 3473 stars this month, reaching 6086 total, ranking #16 on TypeScript trending. AI agents need real-time web data, and Apify offers ready-made scrapers, perfectly meeting the demand.
uses: Developers who want to add web scraping capabilities to AI agents without writing crawlers themselves.
Users of MCP clients like Claude or Cursor who need structured data from social media, e-commerce, etc.
Teams that need to automate data collection and integrate it with AI workflows.

zh.tag: 终端 AI 编程代理，内置 IDE 能力
zh.what: oh-my-pi 是一个终端 AI 编程代理，将 IDE 的编辑能力集成到命令行中。它支持哈希锚定的编辑、优化的工具集、LSP、Python、浏览器和子代理等功能，旨在提供开箱即用且高度可定制的编码体验。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 Rust 代码库（约 8 万行）、TypeScript 编写的编码代理包，以及安装脚本和文档。提供 60+ 提供商、31 个内置工具、14 个 LSP 操作和 28 个 DAP 操作。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 和 TypeScript，运行时支持 Bun（推荐），并支持 macOS、Linux 和 Windows。依赖包括 LSP 和 DAP 协议，以及多种 AI 提供商。
zh.hot: 作为 Pi 的 fork，它提供了更强大的代理表面，并持续根据真实使用进行调优。本周新增 1739 星，总星数达 22525，位列 TypeScript 周榜第 16 名，反映了开发者对终端 AI 编码工具的高度关注。
uses: 开发者希望在终端中直接获得 AI 辅助编码，无需切换 IDE
需要高度可定制和可扩展的 AI 代理，支持多种提供商和工具
喜欢使用 Rust 和 TypeScript 构建高性能命令行工具的技术爱好者
希望利用 LSP 和 DAP 集成进行代码导航和调试的开发者

en.tag: Terminal AI coding agent with IDE wired in
en.what: oh-my-pi is a terminal AI coding agent that integrates IDE capabilities into the command line. It supports hash-anchored edits, an optimized tool harness, LSP, Python, browser, and subagents, aiming to provide an out-of-the-box yet deeply customizable coding experience.
en.content: The repository contains a core Rust codebase (~80k lines), a TypeScript coding agent package, and installation scripts and docs. It offers 60+ providers, 31 built-in tools, 14 LSP ops, and 28 DAP ops.
en.stack: Primarily Rust and TypeScript, with Bun as the recommended runtime, supporting macOS, Linux, and Windows. It leverages LSP and DAP protocols and integrates with multiple AI providers.
en.hot: As a fork of Pi, it offers a more capable agent surface and is continuously tuned by real-world use. With 1,739 stars added this week and a total of 22,525, ranking #16 on the TypeScript weekly trending, it reflects high developer interest in terminal AI coding tools.
uses: Developers who want AI-assisted coding directly in the terminal without switching IDEs
Those needing a highly customizable and extensible AI agent with multiple providers and tools
Tech enthusiasts interested in building high-performance CLI tools with Rust and TypeScript
Developers who want to leverage LSP and DAP integration for code navigation and debugging

zh.tag: 本地 GPU 驱动的图像/文字转 3D 模型桌面应用
zh.what: Modly 是一款开源的桌面应用，利用本地 AI 模型将照片或文字提示转换为 3D 网格模型。所有处理均在本地 GPU 上完成，无需云端服务，支持 Windows、Linux 和 Apple Silicon macOS。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Electron 前端（TypeScript）和 Python 后端（API），提供模型扩展系统，支持多种官方扩展如 Hunyuan3D 和 TripoSG。用户可导入网格并进行平滑、减面等优化操作。
zh.stack: 主要技术栈为 Electron + TypeScript 前端，Python 后端（FastAPI 等），依赖 npm 和 pip 管理。支持通过扩展机制集成不同 AI 模型。
zh.hot: 本月新增 2599 星，总星数达 7448，因提供本地、开源、GPU 加速的 3D 生成方案，满足用户对隐私和离线使用的需求。
uses: 3D 设计师和游戏开发者快速从照片或文字生成原型模型
对数据隐私敏感的用户，希望本地处理而不上传云端
AI 爱好者和研究者，探索图像转 3D 模型技术

en.tag: Desktop app for local GPU-powered image/prompt to 3D mesh generation
en.what: Modly is an open-source desktop app that converts photos or text prompts into 3D mesh models using local AI models. All processing runs entirely on your GPU, no cloud needed, supporting Windows, Linux, and Apple Silicon macOS.
en.content: The repo includes an Electron frontend (TypeScript) and a Python backend (API), with an extension system for models like Hunyuan3D and TripoSG. Users can import meshes and apply smoothing/decimation.
en.stack: Tech stack: Electron + TypeScript frontend, Python backend (FastAPI etc.), managed via npm and pip. Extensible to integrate different AI models.
en.hot: Gained 2599 stars this month (total 7448), popular for offering local, open-source, GPU-accelerated 3D generation, addressing privacy and offline needs.
uses: 3D designers and game developers quickly prototyping models from photos or text
Privacy-conscious users who prefer local processing over cloud uploads
AI enthusiasts and researchers exploring image-to-3D model generation

zh.tag: 为 AI 代理打造的幻灯片框架，用自然语言生成演示文稿
zh.what: open-slide 是一个专为 AI 代理设计的幻灯片框架，允许用户用自然语言描述演示文稿，代理自动生成 React 代码。它提供固定 1920×1080 画布、缩放、导航、热重载和演示模式，让代理专注于内容创作。
zh.content: 仓库包含 CLI 工具、内置技能（如 /create-slide 和 /slide-authoring）、浏览器内检查器、资源管理器、演示模式和导出功能。页面是任意 React 组件，而非受限的 DSL。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript，使用 React 渲染幻灯片，CLI 通过 npx 分发，集成 svgl 图标库，支持导出静态 HTML 和 PDF。
zh.hot: GitHub 星标数达 7452，本月新增 1395，位列 TypeScript 月榜第 13。它填补了代理生成演示文稿的运行时空白，让开发者无需离开聊天即可制作精美幻灯片。
uses: 开发者希望用 AI 代理快速生成演示文稿，无需手动编写 React 代码。
团队需要从自然语言描述创建一致的品牌化幻灯片，并支持迭代反馈。
演讲者需要专业演示模式，包括演讲者视图、计时器和静态导出。

en.tag: A slide framework built for agents: describe in natural language, agents write the React.
en.what: open-slide is a slide framework designed for AI agents, letting users describe a deck in natural language while the agent writes the React code. It provides a fixed 1920×1080 canvas, scaling, navigation, hot reload, and present mode so the agent can focus on content.
en.content: The repo includes a CLI tool, built-in skills (like /create-slide and /slide-authoring), an in-browser inspector, asset manager, present mode, and export features. Pages are arbitrary React components, not a constrained DSL.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, uses React for rendering slides, CLI distributed via npx, integrates svgl icon library, supports exporting to static HTML and PDF.
en.hot: With 7452 stars and 1395 added this month, it ranks #13 on the TypeScript monthly trending. It fills the missing runtime for agent-generated presentations, allowing developers to create polished decks without leaving the chat.
uses: Developers who want to generate presentations quickly with AI agents without manually writing React code.
Teams needing to create consistent branded slides from natural language descriptions with iterative feedback.
Presenters requiring professional presentation mode with speaker view, timer, and static export.

zh.tag: AI 智能体工具链：统一 LLM API、代理循环、TUI 与编程代理 CLI
zh.what: 提供模块化 AI 代理开发框架，整合多厂商 LLM API、代理运行时与终端交互界面。内置可自扩展的编程代理 CLI，支持工具调用、状态管理与交互式编码任务。
zh.content: 仓库采用 monorepo 结构，包含 pi-ai（统一 LLM 接口）、pi-agent-core（代理运行时）、pi-coding-agent（交互式编码 CLI）和 pi-tui（差分渲染终端 UI）四个核心包。README 还提供了容器化与沙箱隔离方案，以及面向人类和代理的协作规范。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 构建，使用 npm 管理 monorepo 依赖与生命周期脚本。支持 OpenAI、Anthropic、Google 等主流 LLM 提供商，并可通过 Docker 或 Gondolin micro-VM 进行容器化隔离。
zh.hot: 一周内新增 2,741 Star 使其冲上 TypeScript 周榜第 17 名，目前总 Star 数已突破 7.2 万。开发者对统一 LLM 接口与自扩展编程代理的结合表现出强烈兴趣。
uses: 需要构建多模型 AI 代理的开发者——统一接口降低集成成本
追求终端原生体验的 CLI 用户——内置 TUI 与差分渲染提升交互效率
关注代码安全隔离的团队——提供 Docker、micro-VM 等多种沙箱方案
希望人机与 AI 代理协作的项目维护者——贡献指南同时面向人类与 Agent

en.tag: AI agent toolkit with unified LLM API, agent loop, TUI and coding agent CLI
en.what: A modular AI agent development framework that unifies multi-provider LLM APIs, agent runtime, and terminal UI. It features a self-extensible coding agent CLI with tool calling, state management, and interactive coding capabilities.
en.content: The monorepo houses four core packages: pi-ai (unified LLM API), pi-agent-core (agent runtime), pi-coding-agent (interactive CLI), and pi-tui (diff-rendered terminal UI). It also includes containerization guides and contribution rules for both humans and agents.
en.stack: Built on TypeScript with npm-based monorepo tooling and lifecycle scripts. Supports major LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google) and offers containerization via Docker or Gondolin micro-VM.
en.hot: It gained 2,741 stars this week, landing at #17 on GitHub's TypeScript Weekly Trending with over 72.2k total stars. The combination of a unified LLM API and a self-extensible coding agent has drawn strong developer interest.
uses: Developers building multi-model AI agents — unified API reduces integration overhead
CLI users preferring terminal-native experiences — built-in TUI with diff rendering
Teams requiring secure isolation — supports Docker, micro-VM, and sandbox patterns
Project maintainers enabling human and AI co-contribution — guidelines cover both humans and agents

zh.tag: 高性能响应式 UI 库，无虚拟 DOM
zh.what: Solid 是一个声明式 JavaScript 库，用于构建用户界面。它不使用虚拟 DOM，而是将模板编译为真实 DOM 节点，并通过细粒度的响应式更新来高效管理状态变化。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心库 solid-js 的源代码、文档、示例和测试。主要提供响应式原语（如 createSignal）、渲染器以及 JSX 编译支持。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 开发，依赖 JSX 和现代 JavaScript 特性，支持浏览器和服务器端渲染。
zh.hot: Solid 以其卓越的性能和细粒度响应式著称，star 数高达 35.9k，本月新增 208，持续吸引开发者关注。
uses: 适合追求极致性能、希望避免虚拟 DOM 开销的前端开发者
适用于需要高效更新复杂界面的单页应用或交互组件
适合喜欢响应式编程范式、熟悉 React 但想尝试新思路的团队

en.tag: High-performance reactive UI library without Virtual DOM
en.what: Solid is a declarative JavaScript library for building user interfaces. Instead of using a Virtual DOM, it compiles templates to real DOM nodes and updates them with fine-grained reactions.
en.content: The repository contains the source code, docs, examples, and tests for the core library solid-js. It provides reactive primitives (like createSignal), a renderer, and JSX compilation support.
en.stack: Developed in TypeScript, relies on JSX and modern JavaScript features, supports browser and server-side rendering.
en.hot: Solid is renowned for its excellent performance and fine-grained reactivity, with 35.9k stars and 208 added this month, continuously attracting developers.
uses: For frontend developers seeking top performance and avoiding Virtual DOM overhead
For building single-page apps or interactive components with efficient updates
For teams familiar with React but interested in a reactive paradigm without Virtual DOM

zh.tag: 开源智能体操作系统，让 AI 代理自主运行
zh.what: elizaOS 是一个开源的 TypeScript 框架和产品栈，用于构建和运行自主 AI 代理。它提供核心运行时、Eliza 应用、CLI、云服务和原生桥接，支持从聊天、语音到设备控制等多种能力。
zh.content: 该仓库是一个 monorepo，包含核心运行时、Eliza 应用、CLI、云服务、原生桥接和第一方插件。可引导的 Linux 和 Android 发行版在单独的 elizaOS/os 仓库中。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，依赖 Bun 和 Node.js，使用 Turbo 进行构建，支持子模块和补丁。
zh.hot: 本周新增 115 颗星，总星数达 19064，登上 GitHub Trending 周榜（TypeScript）第 19 名。其“智能体操作系统”的定位和全栈能力吸引了大量开发者。
uses: 开发者：使用 CLI 和文档构建自定义 AI 代理或插件
企业：通过 Eliza Cloud 部署和管理 AI 代理
个人用户：下载 Eliza 应用用于个人助理、自动化等场景
研究者：探索自主代理和操作系统级集成的可能性

en.tag: Open-source agentic operating system for autonomous AI agents
en.what: elizaOS is an open-source TypeScript framework and product stack for building and running autonomous AI agents. It provides a core runtime, the Eliza app, CLI, cloud services, and native bridges, enabling capabilities from chat and voice to device control.
en.content: This repository is a monorepo containing the core runtime, the Eliza app, the CLI, cloud services, native bridges, and first-party plugins. Bootable Linux and Android distributions live in a separate elizaOS/os repository.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, with Bun and Node.js dependencies, built using Turbo, supporting submodules and patches.
en.hot: Gained 115 stars this week, reaching 19,064 total, ranking #19 on GitHub Trending (TypeScript) weekly. Its positioning as an 'agentic operating system' with full-stack capabilities attracts many developers.
uses: Developers: build custom AI agents or plugins using the CLI and docs
Enterprises: deploy and manage AI agents via Eliza Cloud
Individuals: download the Eliza app for personal assistant, automation, etc.
Researchers: explore autonomous agents and OS-level integration

zh.tag: AI 代理团队级记忆中枢，沉淀对话、文档与代码为可复用资产
zh.what: TencentDB Agent Memory 是一个为 AI 代理设计的团队级记忆中枢，将对话、文档和代码转化为四种可复用的记忆资产（聊天记忆、技能、LLM 维基、代码图谱），并支持跨代理和框架的治理、共享与装备。它旨在减少重复工作，让代理在团队中持续积累知识。
zh.content: 仓库包含部署脚本（一键启动 memory-core、memory-hub 和 proxy）、核心服务代码、迁移工具，以及详细的安装文档（中英文）。提供面板用于管理记忆资产。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript，依赖 Node.js >=22.16，支持 OpenClaw 和 Hermes 等代理框架，使用 TencentDB 作为存储后端。
zh.hot: 今日新增 1057 星，总星数达 16543，登顶 GitHub Trending 日榜。其“团队记忆”理念切中 AI 代理协作痛点，且提供一键部署，迅速吸引开发者关注。
uses: AI 代理开发者：为代理添加持久记忆，减少重复上下文输入。
团队协作场景：共享代理记忆，提升团队知识复用效率。
个人开发者：构建“一人公司”式的代理团队，自动化工作流。
研究爱好者：探索代理记忆管理与跨框架集成。

en.tag: Team-level memory hub for AI agents, turning conversations, docs, and code into reusable assets
en.what: TencentDB Agent Memory is a team-level memory hub for AI agents, transforming conversations, docs, and code into four reusable memory assets (Chat Memory, Skill, LLM-Wiki, Code-Graph) that are governed, shared, and equipped across agents and frameworks. It aims to reduce repetitive work by enabling agents to accumulate knowledge persistently.
en.content: The repo includes deployment scripts (one-click start for memory-core, memory-hub, and proxy), core service code, migration tools, and detailed installation docs (EN/CN). A panel is provided for managing memory assets.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, requires Node.js >=22.16, supports agent frameworks like OpenClaw and Hermes, and uses TencentDB as the storage backend.
en.hot: Gained 1,057 stars today, reaching 16,543 total, and topped the GitHub Trending daily chart. Its 'team memory' concept addresses the pain point of AI agent collaboration, and one-click deployment quickly attracts developers.
uses: AI agent developers: add persistent memory to agents, reducing repetitive context input.
Team collaboration: share agent memory to improve knowledge reuse efficiency.
Solo developers: build a 'one-person company' agent team for automated workflows.
Researchers/enthusiasts: explore agent memory management and cross-framework integration.

zh.tag: 插件化、无广告的免费音乐播放器
zh.what: MusicFree 是一款插件化、定制化、无广告的免费音乐播放器，目前支持 Android 和 Harmony OS。它本身不集成任何音源，所有搜索、播放、歌单导入等功能均通过插件实现，用户可自由安装第三方插件来扩展功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含播放器的完整源代码，采用 TypeScript 编写，包含 UI 组件、播放核心、插件管理模块等。同时提供插件开发文档和示例插件，方便开发者二次开发。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 开发，基于 AGPL 3.0 协议开源。依赖包括 React Native 或类似跨平台框架（根据项目结构推测），以及用于插件加载的 CommonJS 模块系统。
zh.hot: 凭借插件化设计实现高度定制和无广告体验，吸引了大量用户。本月新增 802 个 star，总 star 数达 26643，登上 GitHub Trending 月榜（TypeScript）第 14 名，反映出社区对自由音乐播放器的强烈需求。
uses: 适合追求无广告、可定制音乐播放体验的 Android 或 Harmony OS 用户。
适合希望自行控制音源、通过插件扩展功能的音乐爱好者。
适合对音乐播放器开发感兴趣的开发者，可参考其插件架构。

en.tag: A plugin-based, ad-free, free music player
en.what: MusicFree is a plugin-based, customizable, ad-free free music player that currently supports Android and Harmony OS. It does not integrate any music sources itself; all functions like search, playback, and playlist import are implemented via plugins, allowing users to freely install third-party plugins to extend functionality.
en.content: The repository contains the complete source code of the player, written in TypeScript, including UI components, playback core, plugin management modules, etc. It also provides plugin development documentation and example plugins for developers.
en.stack: Primarily developed in TypeScript, open-sourced under AGPL 3.0. Dependencies include a cross-platform framework like React Native (inferred from project structure), and CommonJS module system for plugin loading.
en.hot: With its plugin-based design enabling high customization and ad-free experience, it has attracted many users. Gaining 802 stars this month, reaching 26,643 total, and ranking 14th on GitHub Trending monthly (TypeScript), reflecting strong community demand for a free music player.
uses: Ideal for Android or Harmony OS users seeking an ad-free, customizable music playback experience.
Suitable for music enthusiasts who want to control their music sources and extend functionality via plugins.
Great for developers interested in music player development, offering insights into plugin architecture.

zh.tag: 为AI代理设计的极速共享浏览器，零配置
zh.what: ego lite 是一款专为 AI 代理设计的浏览器，允许用户和 AI 代理并行工作。代理可以在独立空间中运行多个浏览器任务，同时用户保留自己的标签页，且无需额外配置即可共享登录状态。
zh.content: 仓库包含 macOS 应用安装包（Apple Silicon 和 Intel）、文档链接、Discord 社区、X 账号以及演示视频。核心功能是通过 `ego-browser` 技能让代理访问真实登录状态和标签页。
zh.stack: 主语言为 JavaScript，基于浏览器技术构建，支持 macOS 平台，Windows 和 Linux 在路线图中。
zh.hot: 本周新增 2288 星，总星数 11863，因解决 AI 浏览器自动化中登录状态共享的痛点而迅速走红。
uses: AI 代理开发者：需要让代理执行浏览器任务并访问真实登录状态。
自动化测试工程师：希望在不干扰用户标签页的情况下并行运行测试。
个人用户：想用 AI 代理处理日常网页操作，同时保留自己的浏览会话。

en.tag: Fastest shared browser for AI agents, zero config
en.what: ego lite is a browser designed for AI agents to run browser automation in parallel with users. Agents operate in their own Spaces, while users keep their tabs, and logins are shared seamlessly without extra setup.
en.content: The repo provides macOS app downloads (Apple Silicon and Intel), docs, Discord, X handle, and demo video. Core feature is the `ego-browser` skill enabling agents to access real logins and tabs.
en.stack: Built with JavaScript, leveraging browser technologies, currently supports macOS, with Windows and Linux on roadmap.
en.hot: Gained 2288 stars this week, total 11863, popular for solving login-sharing pain in AI browser automation.
uses: AI agent developers: need agents to run browser tasks with real logins.
Automation testers: want parallel test runs without disturbing user tabs.
Personal users: want AI agents to handle web tasks while keeping their own session.

zh.tag: 模块化 SenseNova 技能，构建 AI 办公助手与生产力工作流
zh.what: 该仓库提供一系列模块化的 SenseNova 技能，用于构建 AI 驱动的办公助手和生产力工作流。每个技能独立成目录，通过 SKILL.md 声明触发条件、能力和执行流程，遵循 Agent Skills 约定。技能涵盖图像生成与可视化、PPT 生成、Excel 数据分析、深度研究等，可单独使用或组合成端到端工作流。
zh.content: 仓库包含多个技能目录，每个目录有 SKILL.md 定义元数据，还有文档示例（如 sn-infographic Gallery 展示近 100 个生成案例）和集成说明。技能可直接在 Raccoon 平台开箱使用。
zh.stack: 主要语言为 JavaScript，依赖 SenseNova 模型（如 SenseNova 6.7 Flash 和 U1），遵循 Agent Skills 标准，可接入 OpenClaw 和 hermes-agent 等代理运行时。
zh.hot: 本月新增 623 星，登上 GitHub Trending 月榜（JavaScript）第 19 名。其模块化技能设计降低了构建 AI 办公助手的门槛，且提供免费试用的 Raccoon 平台，吸引开发者快速体验。
uses: 希望快速为办公场景（如 PPT、Excel、研究）集成 AI 能力的开发者
需要构建自定义 AI 助手或工作流的团队，可复用现成技能模块
对 SenseNova 模型感兴趣的 AI 应用开发者，可参考技能实现

en.tag: Modular SenseNova skills for building AI-powered office assistants and productivity workflows
en.what: This repository provides a set of modular SenseNova skills for building AI-powered office assistants and productivity workflows. Each skill lives in its own directory and declares triggers, capabilities, and execution flow via a SKILL.md file, following the Agent Skills convention. Skills cover image generation & visualization, slide-deck (PPT) generation, Excel data analysis, and deep research, usable standalone or composed into end-to-end workflows.
en.content: The repository contains multiple skill directories, each with a SKILL.md defining metadata, plus documentation examples (like the sn-infographic Gallery showcasing nearly 100 generation cases) and integration guides. Skills are available out-of-the-box in the Raccoon platform.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, leveraging SenseNova models (e.g., SenseNova 6.7 Flash and U1), following the Agent Skills standard, and integrating with agent runtimes like OpenClaw and hermes-agent.
en.hot: Gained 623 stars this month, ranking #19 on GitHub Trending (JavaScript). Its modular skill design lowers the barrier to building AI office assistants, and the free-trial Raccoon platform attracts developers to try it quickly.
uses: Developers who want to quickly integrate AI capabilities into office scenarios like PPT, Excel, and research
Teams building custom AI assistants or workflows, who can reuse ready-made skill modules
AI application developers interested in SenseNova models, who can reference the skill implementations

zh.tag: 开源看板项目管理工具，实时协作
zh.what: PLANKA 是一款看板风格的项目管理工具，提供直观的拖拽界面来管理项目、看板、列表和卡片。它支持实时同步、Markdown 编辑和灵活的通知，适合团队协作。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的看板应用代码，包括前端界面、后端 API、数据库模型，以及 Docker 部署配置。还提供了文档、演示和 API 文档链接。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript，基于 Node.js 和 React 构建，使用 PostgreSQL 作为数据库，支持 Docker 部署。
zh.hot: 拥有 12k+ 星标，本周新增 102，登上 GitHub Trending 周榜。其自托管、实时协作和丰富功能吸引了大量用户。
uses: 团队项目管理，使用看板视图跟踪任务进度
个人任务管理，自托管部署保护数据隐私
需要实时协作和 Markdown 支持的项目团队
希望替代商业看板工具的开源用户

en.tag: Open-source Kanban project management with real-time collaboration
en.what: PLANKA is a Kanban-style project management tool with an intuitive drag-and-drop interface for managing projects, boards, lists, and cards. It features real-time sync, Markdown editing, and flexible notifications for team collaboration.
en.content: The repository contains the full Kanban app code, including frontend UI, backend API, database models, and Docker deployment configs. Links to docs, demo, and API docs are also provided.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, built on Node.js and React, uses PostgreSQL for database, supports Docker deployment.
en.hot: With 12k+ stars and 102 added this week, it's on GitHub Trending weekly. Its self-hosted, real-time collaboration and rich features attract many users.
uses: Team project management with Kanban view for tracking tasks
Personal task management with self-hosted deployment for data privacy
Teams needing real-time collaboration and Markdown support
Open-source users looking to replace commercial Kanban tools

zh.tag: 人生进阶与英语学习开放指南
zh.what: 这是一份从英语学习出发，写给普通人持续成长、重新掌握人生主动权的开放指南。它涵盖了英语学习系统、AI学习方法以及人生复盘样本，帮助用户建立长期训练系统。
zh.content: 仓库包含英语学习主线（认知、单词、听力、阅读、口语、写作）、AI学习与能力升级方法、人生复盘与创业故事，以及长期主义资源如词表和英文材料。
zh.stack: 基于JavaScript，主要使用Markdown文档组织内容，依赖GitHub Pages或静态站点部署。
zh.hot: 拥有56318颗星，今日新增103颗，因其全面的英语学习指南和人生进阶内容吸引了大量学习者，长期占据GitHub热门榜。
uses: 英语学习者——系统提升听说读写能力，建立长期训练系统
AI工具使用者——学习如何将ChatGPT、Gemini等融入学习流程
人生复盘者——从创业、失败、低谷恢复的真实故事中获取启发
长期主义者——寻找可执行的成长路线图和资源库

en.tag: An open guide to life advancement and English learning
en.what: An open guide starting from English learning, aimed at helping ordinary people grow continuously and regain control of their lives. It covers an English learning system, AI learning methods, and a life review sample.
en.content: The repo includes an English learning thread (cognition, vocabulary, listening, reading, speaking, writing), AI learning and skill upgrade methods, life review and entrepreneurship stories, and long-term resources like word lists and English materials.
en.stack: Built with JavaScript, primarily organized as Markdown documents, deployable via GitHub Pages or static site generators.
en.hot: With 56,318 stars and 103 new stars today, it attracts learners with its comprehensive English learning guide and life advancement content, consistently trending on GitHub.
uses: English learners — systematically improve listening, speaking, reading, writing, and build a long-term training system
AI tool users — learn to integrate ChatGPT, Gemini, etc. into learning workflows
Life reviewers — gain inspiration from real stories of entrepreneurship, failure, and recovery
Long-termists — find actionable growth roadmaps and resource repositories

zh.tag: 跨平台终端与远程连接客户端，支持多协议
zh.what: electerm 是一个免费开源的终端模拟器，集成了 SSH、SFTP、FTP、Telnet、串口、RDP、VNC 和 Spice 等多种远程连接协议。它支持 Linux、Mac、Windows、Android、HarmonyOS 和 iOS 等多个平台，甚至兼容老旧系统和中国国产 Linux 发行版。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面端应用源码（基于 Electron）、移动端版本（Android/HarmonyOS/iOS）以及 Web 版本，并提供主题、Docker 镜像、在线演示和 AI 集成等资源。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript（Electron 框架），同时涉及 React 等前端技术，并支持多种平台打包。
zh.hot: 本月新增 401 星，总星数达 15046，位列 JavaScript 趋势榜第 9。其跨平台兼容性（包括国产系统）和多功能集成是吸引用户的关键。
uses: 系统管理员和开发者需要跨平台远程管理服务器，支持 SSH、SFTP 等多种协议。
需要在老旧系统或国产 Linux（如 UOS、麒麟）上使用现代终端工具的用户。
移动办公人员希望在 Android、HarmonyOS 或 iOS 设备上连接远程主机。
偏好开源软件且希望定制主题或扩展功能的终端爱好者。

en.tag: Cross-platform terminal & remote client supporting SSH, SFTP, RDP, VNC and more
en.what: electerm is a free and open-source terminal emulator that integrates multiple remote connection protocols including SSH, SFTP, FTP, Telnet, serial port, RDP, VNC, and Spice. It supports Linux, Mac, Windows, Android, HarmonyOS, and iOS, and even works on older systems and Chinese domestic Linux distributions.
en.content: The repository contains the desktop app source code (Electron-based), mobile versions (Android/HarmonyOS/iOS), and a web version, along with themes, Docker images, online demo, and AI integration resources.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript with Electron framework, also uses React and other frontend technologies, with packaging support for multiple platforms.
en.hot: Gained 401 stars this month, total 15,046, ranking 9th on the JavaScript trending list. Its cross-platform compatibility (including domestic systems) and multi-protocol integration are key attractions.
uses: System administrators and developers needing cross-platform remote server management with SSH, SFTP, and more protocols.
Users who require modern terminal tools on older systems or domestic Linux distributions like UOS and Kylin.
Mobile workers who want to connect to remote hosts from Android, HarmonyOS, or iOS devices.
Open-source enthusiasts who prefer customizable themes and extensible terminal clients.

zh.tag: 开源模块化智能魔镜平台，把镜子变成个人助理
zh.what: MagicMirror² 是一个开源的模块化智能镜子平台，允许用户将普通镜子（如玄关镜或浴室镜）改造成个人助理。它基于 Electron 封装，无需额外安装 Web 服务器或浏览器即可运行。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心平台代码、模块系统、安装文档和贡献指南。核心采用模块化插件架构，支持大量可安装的第三方模块来扩展功能。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript，基于 Electron 框架，利用 Node.js 生态。依赖包括 npm 包管理、GitHub Actions 用于自动化测试。
zh.hot: 本月新增 129 星，总星数达 23.8k，位列 JavaScript 月榜第 19。作为智能家居和 DIY 项目的热门选择，社区活跃且贡献者众多。
uses: DIY 爱好者：想自制智能镜子，展示天气、日历、新闻等信息的个人项目。
智能家居玩家：将魔镜集成到家庭自动化系统中，作为信息中心或控制面板。
开发者：学习模块化架构和 Electron 应用开发，或贡献自己的模块。

en.tag: Open-source modular smart mirror platform turning mirrors into personal assistants
en.what: MagicMirror² is an open-source modular smart mirror platform that lets you turn a regular mirror (e.g., in a hallway or bathroom) into a personal assistant. It is built on Electron as an application wrapper, so no separate web server or browser installation is needed.
en.content: The repository contains the core platform code, a modular plugin system, installation documentation, and contribution guidelines. The core uses a modular plugin architecture, supporting a growing list of installable third-party modules to extend functionality.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, built on Electron, leveraging the Node.js ecosystem. Dependencies include npm for package management and GitHub Actions for automated testing.
en.hot: Gained 129 stars this month, reaching 23.8k total, ranking 19th on the JavaScript monthly trending. It's a popular choice for smart home and DIY projects, with an active community and many contributors.
uses: DIY enthusiasts: personal projects to build a smart mirror displaying weather, calendar, news, etc.
Smart home hobbyists: integrating the mirror into home automation as an info hub or control panel.
Developers: learning modular architecture and Electron app development, or contributing custom modules.

zh.tag: 高效开源广告拦截器，专注隐私与性能
zh.what: uBlock Origin 是一款轻量级、高效的浏览器扩展，用于拦截广告、跟踪器和恶意域名。它通过 CPU 和内存占用极低的方式，为用户提供更干净、更快的网页浏览体验。
zh.content: 仓库包含扩展的完整源代码，包括核心拦截引擎、过滤列表管理、用户界面（如弹出面板和设置页）、以及针对不同浏览器的构建配置。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript，结合 HTML/CSS 构建界面，并利用浏览器扩展 API（如 webRequest 和 declarativeNetRequest）实现网络请求拦截。
zh.hot: 随着主流浏览器逐步淘汰 Manifest V2，uBlock Origin 成为用户对抗广告和跟踪的重要工具，其高效性和可靠性使其在 GitHub 上持续受到关注，本月新增 890 星。
uses: 注重隐私的普通用户，希望拦截广告和跟踪器以加快浏览速度并保护隐私。
技术爱好者，希望自定义过滤规则或研究广告拦截技术。
开发者和维护者，需要参考或贡献于开源广告拦截解决方案。

en.tag: Efficient open-source ad blocker focused on privacy and performance
en.what: uBlock Origin is a lightweight and efficient browser extension that blocks ads, trackers, and malicious domains. It provides a cleaner and faster browsing experience with minimal CPU and memory usage.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the extension, including the core blocking engine, filter list management, user interface (popup panel and settings pages), and build configurations for various browsers.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, with HTML/CSS for the UI, and leverages browser extension APIs like webRequest and declarativeNetRequest for network request blocking.
en.hot: As major browsers phase out Manifest V2, uBlock Origin remains a crucial tool for users to fight ads and tracking. Its efficiency and reliability keep it popular on GitHub, gaining 890 stars this month.
uses: Privacy-conscious users who want to block ads and trackers for faster browsing and privacy protection.
Tech enthusiasts who want to customize filter rules or study ad-blocking techniques.
Developers and maintainers looking to reference or contribute to an open-source ad-blocking solution.

zh.tag: AI 代理全自动管理 YouTube 频道，免费 Gemini 可用
zh.what: 这是一个利用 AI 代理实现 YouTube 频道全自动管理的工具。它能够自动创建、优化并发布视频，全天候运行，无需人工干预。支持使用免费的 Gemini API 或 OpenAI，且无需编写代码。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的自动化流程：视频脚本生成、图像生成、语音合成、视频渲染（利用 FFmpeg）、以及 YouTube 发布队列。提供命令行工具（如 npm run setup、npm run walkthrough）进行配置和引导，支持多种 AI 提供商（OpenAI、Gemini、OpenRouter 等）。
zh.stack: 主要基于 Node.js（JavaScript），依赖 FFmpeg（通过 ffmpeg-static 捆绑）、dotenv 管理环境变量，并集成多个 AI 提供商的 API（OpenAI、Gemini、OpenRouter、Kimi、MiMo、GLM）。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub 上迅速走红，今日新增 164 星，总星数达 2010，位列 JavaScript 趋势榜第 4。其吸引力在于提供完全免费（使用 Gemini）的自动化 YouTube 频道管理，大幅降低内容创作门槛，且持续更新修复问题，社区反响热烈。
uses: 内容创作者：希望自动化视频生成和发布，节省时间。
营销人员：需要批量生成视频内容以扩大品牌影响力。
开发者：对 AI 代理工作流和自动化管道感兴趣，可二次开发。
初学者：无需编程经验，通过引导式设置即可上手。

en.tag: Fully automated YouTube channel management with AI agents, works with free Gemini or OpenAI
en.what: This is a tool that uses AI agents to fully automate YouTube channel management. It can automatically create, optimize, and publish videos, running 24/7 without manual intervention. It works with the free Gemini API or OpenAI, and requires no coding.
en.content: The repository contains a complete automation pipeline: video script generation, image generation, voice narration, video rendering (using FFmpeg), and a YouTube publishing queue. It provides CLI tools (e.g., npm run setup, npm run walkthrough) for configuration and guided setup, supporting multiple AI providers (OpenAI, Gemini, OpenRouter, etc.).
en.stack: Primarily built on Node.js (JavaScript), with dependencies on FFmpeg (bundled via ffmpeg-static), dotenv for environment variables, and integrations with multiple AI provider APIs (OpenAI, Gemini, OpenRouter, Kimi, MiMo, GLM).
en.hot: The project is rapidly gaining traction on GitHub, with 164 stars today and 2010 total, ranking #4 on the JavaScript trending list. Its appeal lies in offering fully automated YouTube channel management for free (using Gemini), significantly lowering the barrier to content creation, and its continuous updates and issue fixes have garnered strong community response.
uses: Content creators: who want to automate video generation and publishing to save time.
Marketers: needing to produce video content at scale for brand reach.
Developers: interested in AI agent workflows and automation pipelines, can customize.
Beginners: no coding experience needed, guided setup makes it easy to start.

zh.tag: 让 AI 写作更像人：检测并改写 AI 腔的智能体技能
zh.what: 这是一个可移植的 AI 代理技能，用于审计和重写内容，去除常见的 AI 写作模式（如“Certainly!”、空洞的修饰语等）。它支持重写、检测和原地编辑三种模式，并可选语音风格（casual/professional 等），兼容 Claude Code、OpenClaw、Codex 等主流代理。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个可安装的 skill 定义（SKILL.md）、检测引擎（JavaScript 实现）、演示 GIF 和文档。核心是一个规则驱动的检测器，可标记 13 类 AI 写作模式，并执行多轮重写以彻底清除残留。
zh.stack: 主语言为 JavaScript，采用规则/模式匹配而非机器学习，轻量且可嵌入任何 agentskills.io 兼容的代理。无外部依赖，MIT 许可。
zh.hot: 3,598 星且单日新增 133，登上 JavaScript 趋势榜第 8。AI 生成内容泛滥，开发者急需让输出“去 AI 味”的工具，而它恰好以 agent skill 形式即插即用。
uses: 内容创作者：用 Claude Code 等代理批量改写文章，去除 AI 腔，提升可读性。
开发者：在 CI 或本地用 Detect 模式审计 AI 生成的文档/提交信息，避免机械感。
团队：统一内容风格，通过 voice profile 定制专业、轻松或温暖等语气。
AI 代理开发者：集成此 skill 到自定义代理，增强文本后处理能力。

en.tag: Audit & rewrite AI-sounding text into natural prose, as a portable agent skill
en.what: A portable skill for AI agents that audits and rewrites content to remove common AI writing patterns ('AI-isms'). It offers three modes—rewrite, detect, and edit-in-place—plus optional voice profiles, and works with agents like Claude Code, OpenClaw, and Codex.
en.content: The repo contains a portable skill definition (SKILL.md), a JavaScript-based detection engine, a demo GIF, and docs. The core is a rule-driven detector that flags 13 categories of AI patterns and performs multi-pass rewriting to catch leftovers.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, using rule/pattern matching rather than ML, so it's lightweight and embeddable in any agentskills.io-compatible agent. No external dependencies, MIT licensed.
en.hot: With 3,598 stars and +133 today, it hit #8 on the JavaScript trending list. As AI-generated content floods the web, developers crave tools to make output sound human, and this skill plugs directly into their favorite agents.
uses: Content creators: use with Claude Code to rewrite articles in bulk, removing AI-isms for better readability.
Developers: run Detect mode in CI or locally to audit AI-generated docs/commit messages for robotic tone.
Teams: standardize content tone via voice profiles (casual, professional, warm, etc.).
Agent builders: integrate this skill into custom agents to enhance text post-processing.

zh.tag: 开源低代码平台，构建内部工具与AI代理
zh.what: ToolJet 是一个开源的低代码平台，用于快速构建内部工具、仪表盘、业务应用和工作流。它提供可视化拖拽界面，支持连接数据库、API 和 SaaS 应用，并集成了 AI 能力，可生成应用和智能代理。
zh.content: 仓库包含社区版（CE）的完整源代码，提供可视化应用构建器、内置数据库、80+ 数据源连接器、多页面应用和多人协作编辑等功能。还包含文档、CLI 工具和插件系统。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript，基于 React 和 Node.js 构建。支持 Docker、Kubernetes 等部署方式，并集成多种数据库和 API。
zh.hot: 凭借强大的低代码能力和 AI 集成，在开发者中广受欢迎。今日新增 241 星，总星数达 38.5k，位列 JavaScript 趋势榜第五。
uses: 开发内部工具和后台管理面板的团队
需要快速搭建业务应用的非技术用户
希望利用 AI 生成应用和自动化工作流的开发者
寻求自托管低代码解决方案的企业

en.tag: Open-source low-code platform for building internal tools and AI agents
en.what: ToolJet is an open-source low-code platform for rapidly building internal tools, dashboards, business applications, and workflows. It offers a visual drag-and-drop interface, connects to databases, APIs, and SaaS apps, and integrates AI capabilities for app generation and intelligent agents.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the Community Edition (CE), featuring a visual app builder, built-in database, 80+ data source connectors, multi-page apps, and multiplayer editing. It also includes documentation, CLI tools, and a plugin system.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, built with React and Node.js. Supports deployment via Docker, Kubernetes, and integrates with various databases and APIs.
en.hot: Popular among developers for its powerful low-code capabilities and AI integration. Gained 241 stars today, reaching 38.5k total, ranking 5th on the JavaScript trending list.
uses: Teams building internal tools and admin panels
Non-technical users needing to quickly create business apps
Developers looking to leverage AI for app generation and workflow automation
Enterprises seeking self-hosted low-code solutions

zh.tag: 拒绝白板面试的友好公司清单
zh.what: 这是一个收集不使用白板面试的公司的开源清单，旨在推广更贴近实际工作的招聘方式。它列出了那些采用真实问题讨论、结对编程或家庭作业等面试形式的公司，并鼓励社区贡献和反馈。

uses: 求职者：寻找不采用白板面试的公司，了解其招聘流程。
招聘者：参考清单中的公司实践，改进自己的面试方式。
技术社区成员：贡献或移除公司条目，维护清单的准确性。

en.tag: A list of companies that don't do whiteboard interviews
en.what: This is an open-source list of companies that avoid whiteboard interviews, promoting hiring practices that resemble real work. It includes companies that use real-world problem discussions, pair programming, or take-home assignments, and encourages community contributions and feedback.
en.content: The repository contains an alphabetically ordered list of companies with location and interview process descriptions. It also includes recommendation guidelines, discussion links, and contribution instructions.
en.stack: Primarily written in JavaScript, but content is stored in Markdown format, leveraging GitHub's collaboration features.
en.hot: With over 51k stars, it remains popular among developers as it reflects dissatisfaction with traditional tech interviews and a desire for fairer hiring practices.

Recruiters: Reference the listed companies' practices to improve their own interview methods.
Tech community members: Contribute or remove company entries to keep the list accurate.

zh.tag: 浏览器与 Node.js 的 Promise 版 HTTP 客户端
zh.what: axios 是一个基于 Promise 的 HTTP 客户端，可用于浏览器和 Node.js。它提供了简洁的 API 来发送异步请求，并自动处理 JSON 数据转换和错误处理。
zh.content: 仓库包含 axios 的核心源码、类型定义、文档和示例。主要文件包括 lib/ 目录下的核心逻辑，以及用于测试的 test/ 目录。
zh.stack: 使用 JavaScript 编写，依赖 Node.js 的 http/https 模块以及浏览器的 XMLHttpRequest。支持 TypeScript 类型定义。
zh.hot: axios 是 JavaScript 生态中最流行的 HTTP 客户端之一，拥有超过 10.9 万 star，本月新增 249 个，持续受到开发者信赖。
uses: 前端开发者：在浏览器中发送 AJAX 请求，处理响应数据。
Node.js 后端开发者：在服务端调用外部 API 或微服务。
全栈开发者：统一前后端 HTTP 请求的写法，便于维护。

en.tag: Promise-based HTTP client for the browser and node.js
en.what: Axios is a Promise-based HTTP client that works in both the browser and Node.js. It offers a clean API for making asynchronous requests, with automatic JSON transformation and error handling.
en.content: The repository contains the core source code, type definitions, documentation, and examples for axios. Key files include the core logic under lib/ and tests under test/.
en.stack: Written in JavaScript, it relies on Node.js's http/https modules and the browser's XMLHttpRequest. TypeScript type definitions are included.
en.hot: Axios is one of the most popular HTTP clients in the JavaScript ecosystem, with over 109k stars and 249 new stars this month, maintaining strong developer trust.
uses: Frontend developers: send AJAX requests in the browser and handle response data.
Node.js backend developers: call external APIs or microservices on the server.
Full-stack developers: unify HTTP request patterns across frontend and backend for easier maintenance.

zh.tag: 一条命令为你的硬件找到最合适的 LLM 模型
zh.what: llmfit 是一个终端工具，能根据你的系统 RAM、CPU 和 GPU 自动检测硬件，并为数百个模型和提供商评分，告诉你哪些模型能在你的机器上流畅运行。它提供交互式 TUI 和经典 CLI 两种模式，支持多 GPU、MoE 架构、动态量化选择、速度估算以及本地运行时提供商（如 Ollama、llama.cpp 等）。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 源码、TUI 和 CLI 实现、基准测试指南（docs/benchmarking.md）、TUI 指南（docs/tui.md），以及用于演示的 demo.gif 和图标资源。
zh.stack: 基于 Rust 构建，依赖终端 UI 库（如 ratatui）和模型推理后端（Ollama、llama.cpp、MLX 等），通过 crates.io 分发。
zh.hot: 星标数达 32k，今日新增近 200，因其解决了本地 LLM 选型的痛点，且新版本支持基准测试并贡献结果，让用户获得真实硬件上的实测数据，迅速走红。
uses: 本地 LLM 爱好者：快速找到适合自己电脑配置的模型，避免下载后跑不动的尴尬。
开发者：在开发环境中评估不同模型的性能，优化推理速度和资源占用。
硬件评测者：通过基准测试功能，分享自己机器上的实测数据，帮助社区完善模型适配信息。

en.tag: One command to find the right LLM for your hardware
en.what: llmfit is a terminal tool that detects your hardware and scores hundreds of models across quality, speed, fit, and context dimensions, telling you which ones will run well on your machine. It features an interactive TUI and classic CLI mode, supporting multi-GPU setups, MoE architectures, dynamic quantization, speed estimation, and local runtime providers like Ollama and llama.cpp.
en.content: The repo contains Rust source code, TUI and CLI implementations, benchmarking guide (docs/benchmarking.md), TUI guide (docs/tui.md), plus demo.gif and icon assets.
en.stack: Built with Rust, leveraging terminal UI libraries (e.g., ratatui) and model inference backends (Ollama, llama.cpp, MLX, etc.), distributed via crates.io.
en.hot: With 32k stars and ~200 new today, it solves the pain point of choosing the right local LLM, and the new benchmarking feature lets users contribute real measured data, driving its popularity.
uses: Local LLM enthusiasts: quickly find models that fit your hardware, avoiding downloads that won't run.
Developers: evaluate model performance in dev environments to optimize inference speed and resource usage.
Hardware reviewers: use benchmarking to share real measured data and improve community model-fit information.

zh.tag: 本地优先的极速微虚拟机运行时，秒级启动隔离环境
zh.what: Microsandbox 是一个用 Rust 编写的轻量级微虚拟机运行时，能在本地快速启动隔离环境，用于运行不可信代码，如 AI 代理、用户脚本、CI 任务等。它提供硬件级隔离，同时保持 Docker 类似的工作流，启动时间平均低于 100 毫秒。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 源码、文档、示例、Agent Skills 和 MCP 服务器集成，以及用于构建和发布的配置。核心是一个可嵌入的库，允许在代码中直接生成虚拟机，无需守护进程。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编程语言，依赖微虚拟机技术（如 Firecracker 或类似），支持 OCI 容器镜像，跨平台（Linux、macOS、Windows）。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 代理和不可信代码执行需求的增长，开发者需要快速、安全的隔离方案。Microsandbox 提供了低于 100 毫秒的启动时间和硬件级隔离，在 GitHub 上迅速获得关注，本月新增 959 星，总星数达 8021。
uses: AI 代理开发者：为代理提供安全的沙箱环境，执行用户代码或插件。
CI/CD 工程师：在隔离环境中运行测试或构建任务，防止恶意代码影响主机。
安全研究人员：分析不可信二进制或脚本，利用硬件隔离降低风险。
平台工程师：将微虚拟机嵌入应用，实现多租户隔离或动态代码执行。

en.tag: Fast, local-first microVM runtime for untrusted workloads
en.what: Microsandbox is a lightweight microVM runtime written in Rust that quickly launches isolated environments locally for untrusted workloads like AI agents, user code, CI jobs, and automation. It offers hardware-level isolation with Docker-like workflows and average boot times under 100 milliseconds.
en.content: The repository contains Rust source code, documentation, examples, integrations for Agent Skills and MCP server, and build/release configurations. The core is an embeddable library that spawns VMs directly in code without a daemon.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, leveraging microVM technology (like Firecracker), supports OCI container images, and is cross-platform (Linux, macOS, Windows).
en.hot: With the rise of AI agents and untrusted code execution, developers need fast, secure isolation. Microsandbox offers sub-100ms boot times and hardware-level isolation, quickly gaining traction with 959 stars this month, reaching 8,021 total.
uses: AI agent developers: provide secure sandboxes for agents to execute user code or plugins.
CI/CD engineers: run tests or build tasks in isolated environments to prevent malicious code from affecting the host.
Security researchers: analyze untrusted binaries or scripts with hardware isolation to reduce risk.
Platform engineers: embed microVMs into applications for multi-tenant isolation or dynamic code execution.

zh.tag: 快速、节省磁盘空间的 Node.js 包管理器
zh.what: pnpm 是一个快速且节省磁盘空间的 Node.js 包管理器，通过内容寻址存储来链接文件，避免重复下载。它支持 monorepo，提供严格的依赖访问控制，并具有确定性的锁文件。
zh.content: 仓库包含 pnpm 的完整源代码、文档、基准测试脚本，以及一个用 Rust 编写的实验性 CLI 移植版本（pacquet）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript/TypeScript 编写，并包含 Rust 组件（pacquet）。依赖 Node.js 生态，支持 Windows、Linux 和 macOS。
zh.hot: pnpm 因其卓越的性能和磁盘效率而广受欢迎，在 GitHub 上拥有 36,310 颗星，并持续获得关注。其 Rust 移植版本也吸引了开发者的兴趣。
uses: 适用于大型 monorepo 项目，可显著减少依赖安装时间和磁盘占用。
适合对包管理性能有严格要求的开发团队，尤其是 CI/CD 环境。
适合希望使用严格依赖隔离和确定性锁文件的 Node.js 开发者。

en.tag: Fast, disk space efficient package manager for Node.js
en.what: pnpm is a fast and disk space efficient package manager for Node.js. It links files from a single content-addressable storage to avoid duplication, supports monorepos, enforces strict dependency access, and provides deterministic lockfiles.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, documentation, benchmark scripts, and an experimental Rust port of the CLI called pacquet.
en.stack: Primarily written in JavaScript/TypeScript with a Rust component (pacquet). Depends on Node.js ecosystem, supports Windows, Linux, and macOS.
en.hot: pnpm is popular for its superior performance and disk efficiency, with 36,310 stars on GitHub and ongoing attention. Its Rust port also attracts developers.
uses: Ideal for large monorepo projects, significantly reducing install time and disk usage.
Suitable for teams with strict performance requirements, especially in CI/CD environments.
Great for Node.js developers who want strict dependency isolation and deterministic lockfiles.

zh.tag: 终端里的轻量 AI 编程代理
zh.what: Codex CLI 是 OpenAI 推出的本地运行编码代理，能在终端中直接执行代码任务。它支持与 ChatGPT 计划集成，也可通过 API 密钥使用，提供命令行交互体验。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的 CLI 工具，提供安装脚本、二进制发布包及文档，支持 npm、Homebrew 等安装方式。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言开发，依赖 OpenAI API 或 ChatGPT 认证，支持跨平台（macOS、Linux、Windows）。
zh.hot: 作为 OpenAI 官方开源项目，今日新增 2729 星，总星数突破 11 万，登顶 GitHub 日榜，开发者期待在终端中直接使用 AI 编程。
uses: 开发者希望在终端中快速执行 AI 辅助编码任务，无需离开命令行环境。
使用 ChatGPT Plus/Pro 等计划的用户，可无缝集成现有订阅进行编程。
需要轻量级、可脚本化的代码生成与修改工具的技术团队。

en.tag: Lightweight AI coding agent that runs in your terminal
en.what: Codex CLI is a coding agent from OpenAI that runs locally on your computer. It executes coding tasks directly in the terminal, integrates with ChatGPT plans, and can also be used with an API key.
en.content: The repository contains a Rust-based CLI tool, installation scripts, binary release assets, and documentation, with support for npm and Homebrew installation.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Rust, it relies on OpenAI API or ChatGPT authentication, and supports cross-platform (macOS, Linux, Windows).
en.hot: As an official OpenAI open-source project, it gained 2,729 stars today, surpassing 110k total stars and topping the daily GitHub trending list. Developers are eager to use AI coding directly in the terminal.
uses: Developers who want to perform AI-assisted coding tasks quickly in the terminal without leaving the command line.
Users with ChatGPT Plus/Pro plans who can seamlessly integrate their existing subscription for coding.
Tech teams needing a lightweight, scriptable tool for code generation and modification.

zh.tag: 开源远程桌面，自托管替代 TeamViewer
zh.what: RustDesk 是一款用 Rust 编写的开源远程桌面软件，开箱即用，无需配置。它允许用户完全控制自己的数据，支持自建中继/中转服务器，是 TeamViewer 的隐私友好替代品。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的客户端和服务器端代码，支持 Windows、macOS、Linux、Android、iOS 等多平台。提供二进制下载、Docker 构建方式，以及多语言翻译文件。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言，依赖 Flutter 用于跨平台 UI，使用 Sciter 或原生 GUI。服务器端基于 Rust 的异步网络框架。
zh.hot: 拥有 119k+ Stars，今日新增 121，因其完全开源、自托管、隐私安全且性能优异，成为 TeamViewer 等商业软件的热门替代。
uses: 个人用户：需要安全远程访问家庭或办公电脑
企业 IT：自建远程支持平台，保障数据隐私
开发者：定制远程桌面功能或集成到自有系统

en.tag: Open-source remote desktop, self-hosted alternative to TeamViewer
en.what: RustDesk is an open-source remote desktop application written in Rust, working out of the box with no configuration. It gives users full control over their data and supports self-hosted rendezvous/relay servers, serving as a privacy-friendly alternative to TeamViewer.
en.content: The repository contains full client and server code, supporting Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, iOS, and more. It offers binary downloads, Docker build instructions, and multilingual translation files.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, with Flutter for cross-platform UI and Sciter or native GUI. The server side uses Rust's async networking framework.
en.hot: With 119k+ stars and 121 new today, it's a hot alternative to commercial software like TeamViewer due to its fully open-source, self-hosted, privacy-focused, and high-performance nature.
uses: Individual users: secure remote access to home or office computers
Enterprise IT: self-hosted remote support platform with data privacy
Developers: customize remote desktop features or integrate into own systems

zh.tag: 零配置的终端 IDE，融合 VS Code 与 Sublime 的体验
zh.what: Fresh 是一款现代、功能全面的终端文本编辑器，主打零配置，提供熟悉的快捷键、鼠标支持和 IDE 级功能，无需学习曲线。它专为处理超大文件而优化，性能卓越。
zh.content: 仓库包含编辑器核心代码、安装脚本、文档和演示 GIF，涵盖命令面板、多光标编辑、主题定制、LSP 支持、Orchestrator 多任务等功能。
zh.stack: 使用 Rust 编写，依赖终端 UI 库（如 ratatui）和 LSP 协议实现，支持跨平台。
zh.hot: 本月新增 607 星，登上 GitHub Trending Rust 榜第 14 名。其零配置、易用性和高性能吸引了大量开发者，尤其是对终端编辑器感兴趣的用户。
uses: 适合喜欢在终端中工作但不想学习复杂快捷键的开发者，如 Vim/Emacs 新手。
需要处理超大文件（如日志文件）的开发者，Fresh 能高效加载。
希望获得 IDE 级功能（如 LSP、多光标）但偏好轻量级工具的用户。
对 Rust 和终端 UI 开发感兴趣的贡献者。

en.tag: Zero-config terminal IDE blending VS Code & Sublime UX
en.what: Fresh is a modern, full-featured terminal text editor with zero configuration, offering familiar keybindings, mouse support, and IDE-level features without a learning curve. It is optimized for handling huge files with high performance.
en.content: The repository includes the editor's core code, installation scripts, documentation, and demo GIFs, featuring command palette, multi-cursor editing, themes, LSP support, and the Orchestrator for multitasking.
en.stack: Written in Rust, leveraging terminal UI libraries (e.g., ratatui) and LSP protocol, cross-platform.
en.hot: Gained 607 stars this month, ranking #14 on GitHub Trending Rust. Its zero-config, ease of use, and high performance attract developers, especially terminal editor enthusiasts.
uses: Developers who prefer terminal work but dislike steep learning curves, e.g., Vim/Emacs beginners.
Those handling huge files (e.g., logs) that need efficient loading.
Users wanting IDE-level features (LSP, multi-cursor) in a lightweight tool.
Contributors interested in Rust and terminal UI development.

zh.tag: 数据中心级分布式推理服务编排层
zh.what: Dynamo 是一个开源的数据中心级推理服务框架，作为推理引擎（如 SGLang、TensorRT-LLM、vLLM）之上的编排层，将它们整合为协调的多节点推理系统。它通过分离式服务、智能路由、多级 KV 缓存和自动扩展，最大化吞吐量并最小化延迟，适用于 LLM、推理、多模态和视频生成等负载。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 核心、Python 扩展、文档、示例、recipes 和容器镜像，并提供设计提案和社区贡献指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 实现高性能，Python 提供可扩展性；依赖推理引擎如 SGLang、TensorRT-LLM 和 vLLM。
zh.hot: 本月新增 285 星，总星数 7813，登上 GitHub Trending（Rust）月榜第 20 名。作为 NVIDIA 支持的开源项目，它填补了推理引擎之上的编排层空白，吸引大量关注。
uses: AI 基础设施团队：构建大规模多节点推理服务，优化 GPU 利用率和成本。
模型部署工程师：需要为 LLM、多模态或视频生成模型设计高吞吐、低延迟的服务架构。
平台开发者：希望扩展或定制推理编排逻辑，利用 Rust 和 Python 的混合开发。
研究与实验：在数据中心规模下测试分离式推理、KV 缓存等先进技术。

en.tag: Datacenter-scale distributed inference serving orchestration layer
en.what: Dynamo is an open-source, datacenter-scale inference serving framework that acts as an orchestration layer above inference engines like SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, and vLLM, turning them into a coordinated multi-node inference system. It uses disaggregated serving, intelligent routing, multi-tier KV caching, and automatic scaling to maximize throughput and minimize latency for LLM, reasoning, multimodal, and video generation workloads.
en.content: The repository includes a Rust core, Python extensions, documentation, examples, recipes, and container images, along with design proposals and community contribution guidelines.
en.stack: Built in Rust for performance and Python for extensibility; relies on inference engines like SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, and vLLM.
en.hot: With 285 stars added this month and 7,813 total, it ranks #20 on GitHub Trending (Rust) monthly. As an NVIDIA-backed open-source project, it fills the orchestration gap above inference engines, drawing significant attention.
uses: AI infrastructure teams: building large-scale multi-node inference services to optimize GPU utilization and cost.
Model deployment engineers: designing high-throughput, low-latency serving architectures for LLMs, multimodal, or video generation models.
Platform developers: extending or customizing inference orchestration logic with Rust and Python.
Research and experimentation: testing advanced techniques like disaggregated serving and KV caching at datacenter scale.

zh.tag: 极速 DataFrame 查询引擎，Rust 编写，多语言绑定
zh.what: Polars 是一个用 Rust 编写的极速 DataFrame 分析查询引擎，提供多线程、向量化（SIMD）执行，支持惰性和急切执行，并能处理超过内存大小的数据集。它提供了丰富的表达式 API，支持 Python、Rust、Node.js、R 和 SQL 等多种语言。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Polars 的核心 Rust 实现、多语言绑定（Python、Node.js、R）、用户指南、文档以及用于扩展的插件系统。
zh.stack: 基于 Rust 编写，利用 Apache Arrow 列式格式实现零拷贝数据共享，支持 GPU 加速（NVIDIA）。
zh.hot: 凭借其卓越的性能和易用性，Polars 在数据科学社区迅速走红，GitHub 上已获得近 4 万星标，本月新增 441 星，成为 Rust 语言中最受欢迎的 DataFrame 库之一。
uses: 数据科学家和分析师需要快速处理大型数据集，进行数据清洗和探索性分析。
数据工程师构建高效的数据管道，处理超过内存容量的数据。
希望利用 Rust 性能优势同时使用 Python 或 R 进行数据分析的开发者。
需要与 Apache Arrow 生态无缝集成，实现零拷贝数据共享的应用。

en.tag: Blazing-fast DataFrame query engine in Rust with multi-language bindings
en.what: Polars is an extremely fast DataFrame analytical query engine written in Rust, featuring multi-threaded, vectorized (SIMD) execution, lazy and eager evaluation, and the ability to process datasets larger than RAM. It offers an expressive API and bindings for Python, Rust, Node.js, R, and SQL.
en.content: The repository contains the core Rust implementation, bindings for Python, Node.js, and R, user guides, documentation, and a plugin system for extensibility.
en.stack: Written in Rust, leverages Apache Arrow columnar format for zero-copy data sharing, and supports optional GPU acceleration on NVIDIA GPUs.
en.hot: Polars has gained rapid popularity in the data science community due to its exceptional performance and ease of use, amassing nearly 40k stars on GitHub with 441 new stars this month, making it one of the most popular DataFrame libraries in Rust.
uses: Data scientists and analysts who need to process large datasets quickly for data cleaning and exploratory analysis.
Data engineers building efficient data pipelines that handle datasets larger than memory.
Developers who want to leverage Rust's performance while using Python or R for data analysis.
Applications that require seamless integration with the Apache Arrow ecosystem for zero-copy data sharing.

zh.tag: 在终端里运行的真实浏览器，让 AI 代理直接上网
zh.what: terminal-browser 是一个在终端内运行的真实浏览器，基于 Chromium 渲染，支持鼠标键盘交互。它允许 AI 编码代理与浏览器同处一个终端标签页，代理可完全控制浏览器进行网页操作。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的 CLI 工具，提供安装脚本、快捷键、命令面板、开发者工具等，并支持 SSH 远程浏览和分屏视图。
zh.stack: 基于 Rust 和 Electron 的离屏渲染 API，利用终端图形协议（如 kitty graphics protocol）显示像素。
zh.hot: 本月新增 1864 星，总星数达 2710，因其让 AI 代理无缝使用网络而迅速走红。
uses: AI 编码代理需要浏览网页或与网站交互的场景
开发者想在终端内快速预览网页或远程服务器上的站点
需要将浏览器与编码环境集成在同一界面的高级用户

en.tag: A real browser inside your terminal, giving AI agents full web access
en.what: terminal-browser is a real browser that runs inside your terminal, rendered by Chromium with full mouse and keyboard interaction. It enables AI coding agents to share the same terminal tab and fully control the browser for web tasks.
en.content: The repo contains a Rust CLI tool with installation scripts, keyboard shortcuts, command palette, devtools, SSH support, and split-pane views.
en.stack: Built with Rust and Electron's offscreen rendering API, using terminal graphics protocols like kitty to display pixels.
en.hot: Gained 1864 stars this month (total 2710), trending due to its unique capability of giving AI agents seamless web access.
uses: AI coding agents that need to browse the web or interact with websites
Developers who want to preview web pages or remote sites quickly inside the terminal
Power users who want a browser integrated into their coding environment

zh.tag: 面向 AI 代理的编程语言，让代理少犯错
zh.what: BAML 是一种专为 AI 代理设计的编程语言，外观类似 TypeScript，但内置了类型系统、错误处理和测试框架，旨在让代理更可靠。它支持从 Python、TypeScript 等语言调用，可独立运行或增量采用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 BAML 编译器、CLI 工具、IDE 扩展、示例代码和文档。核心是用 Rust 编写的编译器，支持类型检查、代码生成和内置测试框架。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，提供 Python、TypeScript、Go、C#、Java 等语言的绑定。依赖包括 PyPI 包和 Homebrew 安装方式。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 代理开发火热，BAML 提供了专门的语言层，减少代理出错，吸引了大量关注。本月新增 366 星，总星数达 9139，位列 Rust 趋势榜第 18 名。
uses: AI 代理开发者：需要构建可靠、可测试的代理逻辑，避免输出垃圾数据。
团队希望用强类型语言定义代理工作流，并集成到现有 Python/TS 项目中。
对编程语言设计感兴趣，想了解如何为特定领域（AI）设计语言。

en.tag: A programming language for AI agents, designed to reduce mistakes
en.what: BAML is a programming language designed for AI agents, with a TypeScript-like syntax but a Rust-like type system, built-in error handling, and testing framework to make agents more reliable. It can be called from Python, TypeScript, and other languages, and can be used standalone or adopted incrementally.
en.content: The repository contains the BAML compiler, CLI tools, IDE extensions, examples, and documentation. The core is a Rust-written compiler with type checking, code generation, and built-in testing framework.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, with bindings for Python, TypeScript, Go, C#, Java, etc. Distributed via PyPI and Homebrew.
en.hot: As AI agent development surges, BAML offers a dedicated language layer to reduce agent mistakes, gaining significant attention. With 366 new stars this month and 9,139 total, it ranks #18 on the Rust trending list.
uses: AI agent developers who need reliable, testable agent logic and avoid garbage outputs.
Teams wanting to define agent workflows in a strongly-typed language and integrate into existing Python/TS projects.
Language design enthusiasts interested in domain-specific languages for AI.

zh.tag: 高性能多人协作代码编辑器，Atom 与 Tree-sitter 作者打造
zh.what: Zed 是一款由 Atom 和 Tree-sitter 原作者打造的高性能多人协作代码编辑器，主打极速响应与实时协作。它支持 macOS、Linux 和 Windows，并可通过包管理器安装。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Zed 编辑器的完整源代码，涵盖核心编辑器、协作功能、界面以及跨平台支持。还提供构建指南、贡献指南和许可证管理脚本。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，利用 GPUI 框架构建界面，并依赖 Tree-sitter 进行语法解析。支持 macOS、Linux 和 Windows 平台。
zh.hot: 凭借其极致的性能和多人协作特性，Zed 在开发者中迅速走红，GitHub 星标已接近 9 万，本月新增近 2000 星，位列 Rust 趋势榜前列。
uses: 追求极致编辑速度和流畅体验的开发者，希望替代传统编辑器。
需要实时多人协作编码的团队，用于结对编程或远程协作。
对 Rust 和系统编程感兴趣的开发者，可学习高性能编辑器架构。
喜欢尝鲜、关注编辑器前沿技术的爱好者，可体验最新特性。

en.tag: High-performance multiplayer code editor from the creators of Atom and Tree-sitter
en.what: Zed is a high-performance, multiplayer code editor created by the original authors of Atom and Tree-sitter, emphasizing speed and real-time collaboration. It supports macOS, Linux, and Windows, and can be installed via package managers.
en.content: The repository contains the complete source code of the Zed editor, including the core editor, collaboration features, UI, and cross-platform support. It also provides build guides, contribution guidelines, and license management scripts.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, using the GPUI framework for the UI and Tree-sitter for syntax parsing. Supports macOS, Linux, and Windows platforms.
en.hot: With its extreme performance and multiplayer collaboration features, Zed has quickly gained popularity among developers, amassing nearly 90k stars on GitHub, with ~2k new stars this month, ranking high on the Rust trending list.
uses: Developers who crave ultimate editing speed and smooth experience, looking to replace traditional editors.
Teams needing real-time collaborative coding for pair programming or remote collaboration.
Developers interested in Rust and systems programming, to learn high-performance editor architecture.
Enthusiasts who love trying new things and following cutting-edge editor technology.

zh.tag: Git 仓库密钥扫描与泄露检测工具
zh.what: Gitleaks 是一个用于检测 Git 仓库、文件或标准输入中是否存在密码、API 密钥、令牌等敏感信息的工具。它通过正则表达式和熵分析来识别潜在的泄露，并输出详细的报告，包括文件、行号、提交等信息。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的命令行工具，支持通过 Homebrew、Docker、Go 或二进制安装，并可集成到 pre-commit 钩子或 GitHub Action 中。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖正则表达式库和熵计算，支持多种平台和容器化部署。
zh.hot: 本周新增 215 星，总星数达 28786，位列 GitHub 周榜（Go）第一。其功能完善且维护者宣布转向新项目，引发关注。
uses: 开发者在 CI/CD 流程中自动扫描代码泄露
安全团队审计历史提交中的敏感信息
个人开发者本地检查仓库泄露风险

en.tag: Scan git repos for secrets, passwords, API keys, and tokens
en.what: Gitleaks is a tool for detecting secrets like passwords, API keys, and tokens in git repos, files, and stdin. It uses regex and entropy analysis to identify potential leaks and outputs detailed reports including file, line, commit, and more.
en.content: The repo contains a Go-based CLI tool, installable via Homebrew, Docker, Go, or binaries, and can be integrated into pre-commit hooks or GitHub Actions.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, leveraging regex and entropy calculation, with support for multiple platforms and containerized deployment.
en.hot: Gained 215 stars this week, total 28,786, ranking #1 on GitHub Trending (Go). Its feature-complete status and maintainer's shift to a new project drew attention.
uses: Developers scanning for leaks in CI/CD pipelines
Security teams auditing historical commits for sensitive data
Individual developers checking repos locally for exposure

zh.tag: 默认 HTTPS 的极速可扩展 Web 服务器
zh.what: Caddy 是一个快速、可扩展、跨平台的 Web 服务器，支持 HTTP/1.1、HTTP/2 和 HTTP/3，并默认启用 TLS，自动为站点配置 HTTPS 证书。它旨在让 HTTPS 成为每个网站的默认配置，简化部署和运维。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Caddy 的完整源代码、文档、示例配置和构建脚本。核心是一个基于 Go 的模块化服务器，通过 Caddyfile 或 JSON 配置，支持丰富的插件和中间件。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 CertMagic 库进行自动 HTTPS 证书管理，支持多种平台（Windows、macOS、Linux 等）。
zh.hot: Caddy 因其自动 HTTPS 和易用性而广受欢迎，本月新增近千 star，总 star 数超过 7.4 万，在 Go 语言趋势榜中名列前茅。
uses: 个人开发者或小团队快速部署静态网站或反向代理，无需手动配置证书
需要自动 HTTPS 和 HTTP/3 支持的生产环境 Web 服务器
作为微服务或容器化应用的反向代理和负载均衡器
学习和研究 Go 语言高性能服务器开发的参考项目

en.tag: Fast, extensible web server with automatic HTTPS by default
en.what: Caddy is a fast, extensible, multi-platform web server supporting HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2, and HTTP/3, with TLS enabled by default and automatic HTTPS certificate management. It aims to make HTTPS the default for every site, simplifying deployment and operations.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, documentation, example configurations, and build scripts for Caddy. The core is a modular Go-based server configured via Caddyfile or JSON, supporting a rich ecosystem of plugins and middleware.
en.stack: Developed primarily in Go, leveraging the CertMagic library for automatic HTTPS certificate management, and supports multiple platforms including Windows, macOS, and Linux.
en.hot: Caddy is popular for its automatic HTTPS and ease of use, gaining nearly a thousand stars this month and over 74k total, ranking high on the Go trending list.
uses: Individual developers or small teams quickly deploying static sites or reverse proxies without manual certificate setup
Production web servers requiring automatic HTTPS and HTTP/3 support
Reverse proxy and load balancer for microservices or containerized applications
Reference project for learning high-performance server development in Go

zh.tag: 高密度多路复用、亚秒级挂起/恢复的 Agent 运行时基础设施
zh.what: Agent Substrate 是一个为大规模 Agent 部署提供高性能、高密度运行时环境的系统。它通过控制平面管理 Agent 沙箱的完整生命周期，支持亚秒级的挂起/恢复操作，并允许将大量 Agent 多路复用到底层计算基础设施上。该系统并非用于构建 Agent 的 SDK，而是用于大规模运行 Agent 的底层系统。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心控制平面实现，支持多种沙箱技术（如 microVM 和 gVisor），并基于 Kubernetes 进行基础设施供给和 Worker 生命周期管理。提供演示视频和详细文档，展示如何将约 250 个有状态 Actor 多路复用到 8 个物理 Pod 上。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Kubernetes（Pod 和自动扩缩容）进行基础设施管理，并集成 microVM 和 gVisor 等沙箱技术。

en.tag: High-density, sub-second suspend/resume runtime infrastructure for large-scale agent deployments
en.what: Agent Substrate is a system that provides a performant, high-density runtime environment for large-scale agent deployments. Its control plane manages the full lifecycle of agent sandboxes, enabling sub-second suspend/resume operations and heavy multiplexing of agents onto shared compute infrastructure. It is not an SDK for building agents but a system for running them at scale.
en.content: The repository contains the core control plane implementation, supporting multiple sandbox technologies (e.g., microVMs and gVisor), and leverages Kubernetes for infrastructure provisioning and worker lifecycle management. It includes a demo video and detailed documentation showing how to multiplex ~250 stateful actors across just 8 physical pods.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, it leverages Kubernetes (Pods and autoscaling) for infrastructure management and integrates sandbox technologies like microVMs and gVisor.
en.hot: Ranked #3 on GitHub Trending (Go) daily, gaining 26 stars today to reach 1270 total. Its key selling points—sub-second suspend/resume and high-density multiplexing—address critical pain points in agent deployment, driving significant interest.
uses: Teams deploying AI agents at scale, aiming to reduce infrastructure costs and improve resource utilization
Developers building agent orchestration platforms that require underlying lifecycle management and traffic routing
Engineers working on reinforcement learning (RL) scenarios needing unified management of agentic, inference, and training infrastructure
